item.title: LPGA commish calls Good Good Callaway driver ad fallout ‘brutal’
item.description: LPGA commissioner Craig Kessler called the controversy surrounding Good Good Golf's Callaway ad "brutal" and "heartbreaking," while arguing that people should have a chance to learn from serious mistakes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LPGA commissioner Craig Kessler called the controversy surrounding Good Good Golf's Callaway ad "brutal" and "heartbreaking," while arguing that people should have a chance to learn from serious mistakes. Kessler addressed the August advertisement Tuesday at the Front Office Sports Tuned In summit. The video promoting a co-branded Callaway driver showed Good Good co-founder Garrett Clark shoving fellow content creator Alexis Miestowski to the ground after she reached for the club. The spot drew widespread criticism over its depiction of violence against women and was quickly removed. Good Good claimed the spot was intended as a parody of the horror movie "Obsession." "The fact that someone thought that was a good idea, and it came to life, just shows you that while society has made enormous progress, we have a very, very long way to go," Kessler said. Callaway ended its relationship with Good Good and pledged $1 million to organizations working to prevent violence against women. Good Good also withdrew as title sponsor of a PGA Tour event, while retailers pulled its merchandise and Golf Channel canceled the 2026 season of its reality competition series "Big Break x Good Good." The LPGA did not have a partnership with Good Good. Kessler acknowledged the criticism but argued that people should have opportunities to admit mistakes and learn from them. "Good people make mistakes, and we have to leave room in society for someone to say, ‘I made a massive mistake. Please forgive me. Here's what I learned, and it won't happen again,'" Kessler said. Kessler drew a parallel to criticism he received earlier this year after canceling the final round of the LPGA's season opener because of cold weather, a decision for which he later apologized. "Brutal that it happened -- awful -- my heart goes out to anybody who was affected, and I think a lot of lessons were learned," Kessler said of the Good Good controversy. --Field Level Media

item.title: アップル、スマートホーム端末発表 ＡＩ機能で家庭向け市場開拓
item.description:
Stephen Nellis Anhata Rooprai
[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米アップルは１３日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アップル、スマートホーム端末発表　ＡＩ機能で家庭向け市場開拓 7:32 配信

米アップルが13日に発表した、スマート製品「HomeView（ホームビュー）」。米ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

Stephen Nellis　Anhata Rooprai

[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米アップルは１３日、「ＨｏｍｅＶｉｅｗ（ホームビュー）」と呼ぶｉＰａｄに似た端末を含む一連のスマート製品を発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）で機能を強化した仮想アシスタント「Ｓｉｒｉ（シリ）」を活用し、競争の激しいスマートホーム市場でシェア拡大を狙う。

ホームビューの価格は２９９ドルからで、１１月に出荷を開始する。７インチの画面と顔認識機能を備え、ドアベルやサーモスタット、スマートロックを操作できる。

アップルがこれらの製品を投入する背景には、競合他社に対抗する狙いがある。従来からのライバルであるアマゾン・ドット・コムは、スマートスピーカー「エコー」やドアベル「リング」に多額の投資を行い、先週にはプレミアムタブレットも投入した。さらにＡＩ分野の新興企業オープンＡＩも独自のハードウエア展開を目指している。

ＰＰフォーサイトのアナリスト、パオロ・ペスカトーレ氏は「アップルは自社のＡＩ機能が基本的な音声操作にとどまらず、日常の作業を簡素化し、家庭内の機器をより賢くすることで、実質的なメリットをもたらせると示す必要がある」と述べた。

アップルはホームビューに加え、スマートスピーカー「ホームポッド」とアップルＴＶの最新版も発表した。また、ＬＧとシュナイダーエレクトリックが製造し、アップルの支援を受けて設計されたドアベル、カメラ、サーモスタットなど一連の周辺機器も発表した。

両社と協力し、ホームビューと併せて一連の製品を販売するのは、家庭へのスマートホーム製品の導入を容易にするためだ。

アップルは実演動画で、壁掛けや卓上での使用を想定したホームビューとシリが、家族の複数のメンバーからの音声による依頼を同時に処理する様子を紹介した。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）では規制によりＡＩ版シリが引き続き利用できないため、ホームビューの販売は行わない。

item.title: Dodgers' dynasty on the ropes as bats go cold against Brewers
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers have spent the last two Octobers spraying champagne. This year they may be facing an early winter.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Dodgers have spent the last two Octobers spraying champagne. This year they may be facing an early winter. The two-time defending World Series champions trail the Milwaukee Brewers 2-0 in the National League Championship Series after a 7-4 loss on Monday. Their pitching has wobbled and their lineup has barely made a sound. On Monday, Milwaukee shattered Yoshinobu Yamamoto's aura of postseason invincibility. Christian Yelich hit a two-run single to knock out the 2025 World Series MVP after just 2-2/3 innings. A day earlier, the Brewers chased prized midseason acquisition Tarik Skubal after five innings on their way to a 2-1 win in Game One. Still, the mound is not the Dodgers' biggest problem. Their star-studded lineup is hitting .193 this postseason and is 2-for-26 with runners in scoring position. On Monday they managed three hits. Shohei Ohtani’s bat has also gone quiet. The four-time MVP has been playing through problems with his left knee, right biceps and neck, and it shows. He went 0-for-4 with two strikeouts on Monday. He is now batting .150 (3-for-20) in the postseason, with seven strikeouts and no extra-base hits. The slump is bad enough that Dodgers manager Dave Roberts is reportedly considering what once seemed unthinkable: benching Ohtani for Game Three in Los Angeles on Wednesday. Rookie Josue De Paula would likely replace him at designated hitter. "Obviously it hasn't been good," Roberts told The Athletic after the loss. "He doesn't feel great. I think for me, it's having a conversation with him tomorrow, kind of try to figure out what's best for him, what's best for us." The Dodgers have escaped tight spots before. In last year's Fall Classic, they trailed the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2 and won the last two games to take the title. Shortstop Mookie Betts had a simple answer. "We just have to figure out a way to get hits," he said. "That's really it. There's no magic to it."

item.title: オープンＡＩ従業員を逮捕、会議室に録音機器設置容疑 ＦＢＩが捜査
item.description:
Jaspreet Singh
[１３日 ロイター] - 米捜査当局は、人工知能（ＡＩ）企業オープンＡＩの幹部用会議室に...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ従業員を逮捕、会議室に録音機器設置容疑　ＦＢＩが捜査 7:19 配信

オープンAIのロゴ。6月11日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Jaspreet Singh

[１３日 ロイター] - 米捜査当局は、人工知能（ＡＩ）企業オープンＡＩの幹部用会議室に録音機器をひそかに設置したとして、同社の技術者でサウジアラビア国籍の男を逮捕・訴追した。米司法省が１３日に明らかにした。

今回の事件は、経済的・戦略的優位をもたらし得る人材や技術を巡り、企業や政府が激しく競争する中、機密性の高いＡＩ研究に関するセキュリティー上の懸念が高まっていることを浮き彫りにしている。

司法省の声明によると、アブドゥルラフマン・アルフォザン容疑者（３５）は２０２５年７月からオープンＡＩでエンジニアとして勤務していた。

同省によると、オープンＡＩは９月３０日、サンフランシスコにある同社の建物の一つで、幹部用会議室のテレビ背面のＵＳＢポートに接続された録音機器を発見した。

米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の訴追状によると、機器は親指ほどの大きさで、マイクを備え、カメラへの接続も可能だった。トイレットペーパーに包まれ隠された状態で、９月２８日ごろに設置されたという。保存データは暗号化され、アクセスできない状態だった。捜査当局はその後、容疑者の私物のかばんから、同様にカスタマイズされた機器を発見した。

オープンＡＩはＸへの投稿で、社内のＡＩモデルを使い、機器を設置した人物の特定と機器の出所の追跡を行ったと明らかにした。

同社は、この従業員が会議をひそかに録音するため、社内の機密性の高いエリアに録音機器を追加で設置しようとしていた証拠があると説明した。

「現時点で、この人物がモデルの重みやソースコード、顧客データに不正にアクセスしたり、外部に持ち出したりした形跡はない。当該従業員は解雇した」と述べた。

オープンＡＩはこの件をＦＢＩに通報し、ＦＢＩが捜査を続けている。在米サウジアラビア大使館はロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

ＦＢＩのパテル長官は声明で「アブドゥルラフマン・アルフォザン容疑者は、勤務先の超知能技術に関する機密のやり取りをひそかに録音するため、幹部用会議室内に録音機器を隠した疑いがある」と述べた。

訴追状によると、容疑者は９月１６日までの約１カ月間、業務効率化用のＡＩエージェントを使い、会議室の予定や機能について調べていた。同容疑者は２０年９月から米国の合法的な永住者となっている。

有罪となれば、最長５年の禁錮刑と２５万ドルの罰金、３年間の監督付き釈放が科される可能性がある。

item.title: GameStop CEO Cohen buys shares worth nearly $23 million
item.description: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen bought about $22.8 million worth of the videogame retailer's shares, a regulatory filing showed on Tuesday, raising his total ownership to 9.1%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: GameStop (GME.N) CEO Ryan Cohen bought about $22.8 million worth of the videogame retailer's shares, a regulatory filing showed on Tuesday, raising his total ownership to 9.1%. Here are more details: Cohen bought 844,130 shares between $26.75 and $27 apiece, increasing his stake to 46.2 million shares This marks Cohen's [USN:L6N45O14A TEXT:"second purchase"] of GameStop stock this month. He bought $17.1 million worth of shares, according to an SEC filing on October 2 Analysts generally view insider purchases as a sign that executives are confident in a company's prospects and believe its shares are undervalued Earlier this year, GameStop sought to acquire eBay, roughly four times its market value, for about $56 billion. EBay [USN:L4N4470RD TEXT:"rejected"] the offer as "neither credible nor attractive" In August, Bloomberg news reported that Cohen was [USN:L4N4470RD TEXT:"considering"] abandoning his pursuit of eBay and instead pursuing a partnership or joint venture with the ecommerce major GameStop's shares have risen 35.6% so far this year

item.title: US top diplomat Marco Rubio to visit India and Uzbekistan
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will depart on Saturday on a five-day trip to India and Uzbekistan, the State Department said, adding that he will discuss energy cooperation in India.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will depart on Saturday on a five-day trip to India and Uzbekistan, the State Department said, adding that he will discuss energy cooperation in India. Rubio will travel to Samarkand in Uzbekistan and to Mumbai and Jamnagar in India, the State Department said in a statement on Tuesday. In India, Rubio will meet government officials to "exchange views on regional and global dynamics, and discuss prospects for enhanced energy cooperation," the statement said. Indian and American officials [USN:L1N45S0MJ TEXT:"indicated earlier this month"] that long-running efforts to finalize a bilateral trade agreement have stalled again. US-India ties [USN:L4N45S0BG TEXT:"have been rocky this past year"] over issues including President Donald Trump's repeated claim of brokering an India-Pakistan ceasefire and a [USN:SPN42H00F TEXT:"US military attack"] on a ship off Oman that killed three Indian seafarers. New Delhi has also [USN:L1N45G03K TEXT:"raised concerns"] over US legislation allowing Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries that purchase Russian energy, part of Washington's efforts to pressure Moscow over its invasion of Ukraine. India only briefly reduced purchases from Russia in early 2026 but they have since jumped, especially since the supply shock that followed the US-Israeli war on Iran . The announcement of Rubio's visit also comes during ongoing protests in India [USN:L4N45Z0IJ TEXT:"over the removal of 130 million voters"] from electoral rolls. Washington has thus far not commented on the demonstrations. In Uzbekistan, Rubio will participate in bilateral engagements with officials from Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Kyrgyzstan, and lead a delegation of over 200 business leaders, the State Department said.

item.title: サウジ、国際投資会議「ＦＩＩ」のオンライン参加容認も＝関係者
item.description:
Timour Azhari
[リヤド １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari

[リヤド １３日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアが主催する国際投資会議「フューチャー・インベストメント・イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」について、同国政府は対面とオンラインを組み合わせたハイブリッド形式での開催を検討している。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。週末に首都リヤドの空港が攻撃を受けて死者が発生し、参加者の間で渡航計画を見直す動きが広がっていることが背景にある。

第１０回となるＦＩＩは今月後半、リヤド西部にあるキング・アブドルアジズ国際会議センターで開催される予定。今回の措置により、現地参加を見送る企業関係者もオンラインで会議に参加できるようになる見込みだ。一方関係者の１人によると、一部の参加者は予定通り渡航する見通しで、リヤド以外の空港や近隣の湾岸諸国に到着した後、車でリヤド入りする案も検討されている。

サウジ政府メディア局はロイターのコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

週末の攻撃前に公表されたＦＩＩインスティテュートの声明には「数千人の代表団をリヤドに迎える第１０回ＦＩＩの開催に向け、参加者の安全と健康を最優先事項としている」と記されている。また主催者側は攻撃発生後、会議を予定通り開催すると表明していた。

世界の首脳や大企業の経営者、金融関係者が多数参加することから、ＦＩＩは世界経済フォーラム年次総会になぞらえて「砂漠のダボス会議」と呼ばれている。

ＦＩＩのウェブサイトに６日付で掲載されたプログラム案によると、米金融大手ゴールドマン・サックス のデービッド・ソロモン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）兼会長、英スタンダード・チャータード銀行 のビル・ウィンターズＣＥＯ、米シティグループのジェーン・フレーザーＣＥＯらが講演者として参加する予定となっている。

シティグループとゴールドマン・サックスは両ＣＥＯの出席についてコメントを控え、スタンダード・チャータード銀行も直ちにはコメントしていない。

item.title: Japanese PM’s reflationist label is hard to shake
item.description: Sanae Takaichi dislikes the depiction of her year-old administration. But a $2 trln investment splurge and profligate budget are more apt to stoke inflation. Mooted tax cuts push up bond yields while her central bank choices weaken the yen. The biggest risk is that she succeeds.
item.dc:creator: Hudson Lockett
item.content:encoded: Sanae Takaichi chafes at the word "reflationist". Top officials in the Japanese prime minister's administration [USN:P8N3KU036 TEXT:"argue her policies"], which include a $2.3 trillion investment splurge and looser budgeting processes, will not intensify the inflation she vowed to tame on the campaign trail. They're probably wrong: the biggest risk to Japan's economy is that she succeeds. Since the country's first female leader [USN:L6N3VN03G TEXT:"took charge"] 12 months ago it has become clear that her policy program, dubbed “Takaichinomics”, is based on a misunderstanding of what drives Japan's growth. As she readies to pass her first national budget since an [USN:L6N3Z502S TEXT:"electoral landslide"] in February, this mistake threatens not only to further lift prices but also to undermine the virtuous economic cycle which has delivered the Asian country from decades in the doldrums. Bond and currency markets have been rattled repeatedly by Takaichi’s attempts to shrug off the structural limitations imposed on her recent predecessors by Japan's looming debt and graying workforce. But where the late Prime Minister Shinzo Abe used monetary and fiscal stimulus to rouse the economy from a deflationary stupor, the current incumbent wants sharply higher spending to turbo-charge growth at a time when prices are already rising. To her credit, there are signs she is partially changing course. After a year of [USN:L6N42O0IO TEXT:"tacitly pressuring"] the Bank of Japan to slow-roll rate rises in order to keep government funding costs down, Takaichi is now attempting to [USN:L4N45S0EK TEXT:"shed her reputation"] as a monetary reflationist. The shift is in part due to the sliding yen, combined with a government bond selloff that has pushed up yields and invited [USN:L6N45A09Y TEXT:"public pressure"] from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. Ayano Sato, one of two central bank board appointees who unnerved markets by voting against last month’s hike, even [USN:L4N45S1J9 TEXT:"voiced tepid support"] for more rate rises in a recent Reuters interview. That’s potentially positive for the Japanese currency, which has weakened about 7% against the dollar since Takaichi took charge of the Liberal Democratic Party. Yet the prime minister still [USN:SPN45900X TEXT:"refuses to fully explain"] how she plans to cover the revenue shortfall from scrapping food taxes for at least two years — her flagship measure for providing inflationary relief to households. This is one reason why yields on 30-year Japanese government bonds recently hit a record high of more than 4.2%. Official reassurances that fiscal policy will be both “responsible and proactive” have failed to assuage investors worried by the implications of sharply higher spending for sovereign debt, which is near 200% of GDP. The 65-year-old believes large-scale government-led investment is the only prescription for the economic malady of lacklustre growth she diagnosed in February, after her party regained control of the legislature’s powerful lower house. However, while the contribution to growth from increases in the capital stock may be lower than in the 1980s boom, average annual investment over the past decade still clocks in at 25% of Japanese GDP, per Capital Economics, the highest level among the Group of Seven rich economies. Additional government investment is more likely to intensify inflation. Previous administrations focused instead on improving labour mobility and bringing in overseas workers to offset Japan’s shrinking population. These efforts helped free up more productive workers to seek better-paying jobs, while also providing [USN:L6N4340H3 TEXT:"enough ready hands"] for private investment projects. The upshot has been a return of wage-driven inflation which, though disquieting for households used to stable prices, helped spur Japan’s economic revival. By contrast, Takaichi has thrown up new barriers to long-term residency for imported labour while delaying her predecessor’s plans to raise Japan's minimum wage. In July she downplayed the role of inflation in driving growth in her first economic policy blueprint , blaming “chronically insufficient investment in the future” for kneecapping potential GDP. Her proposed solution envisages a 370 trillion yen ($2.3 trillion) public-private investment plan to [USN:L6N45205U TEXT:"more than double GDP growth"] by 2040, as well as removing limits on annual budget requests by government ministries. Their latest submissions imply spending will jump by 14% to a [USN:L4N44V0T2 TEXT:"record 143 trillion yen"] for the 2027 fiscal year. The sharp increase is supposed to partly reflect outlays previously left to supplementary budgets, which Takaichi wants to scrap. But emergency spending packages may endure given their utility for voter-pleasing initiatives, such as the June move to [USN:L4N42A1YD TEXT:"subsidise fuel costs"]. Rising interest rates further complicate the picture. Increased borrowing costs not only raise the burden of funding the government but also servicing its existing debt, which is set to reach about 37 trillion yen next year. Ayako Fujita, Japan chief economist at JPMorgan, estimates the bond issuance necessary to cover both the prime minister's budget plans and interest payments will likely lead to an increase in Japan’s debt-to-GDP ratio during the 2027 fiscal year, ending four straight years of decline. That risks triggering a vicious cycle as investors dump longer-dated government bonds and push yields still higher. The bank estimates this could help push the closely watched ratio back above 200% by 2031. Supporters of the prime minister’s policies shrug off inflation concerns and argue higher growth will expand the tax base to offset any revenue lost from tax cuts, while returns on government-led investments will help cover further outlays. Yet new plans to [USN:L4N45U03W TEXT:"reboot"] Japan's version of the [USN:L6N3WX0YY TEXT:"now-defunct"] US Department of Government Efficiency in order to scrounge for unused government funds suggest mounting pressure to cover spending. And as countries like China have [USN:L4N43V09D TEXT:"learned the hard way"], the investment success rate for state-backed projects is low. A massive injection of government funding into Japan’s financial system may instead crowd out private investment as the shrinking labour force creates a bottleneck for viable projects. That could prompt domestic investors to seek returns overseas, undermining Tokyo’s efforts to repatriate capital and increasing downward pressure on the yen. Far from delivering a growth boost, Takaichi’s investment drive looks more likely to distort markets and undermine the factors behind Japan’s recent economic renaissance. The best-case scenario is for the prime minister’s audacious plan to either fail or be diverted. Otherwise she may attract far worse labels than "reflationist". Follow Hudson Lockett on Bluesky and X .

item.title: UK finance minister Healey to target online marketplaces in tax crackdown, The Times reports
item.description: Britain plans to make online marketplaces including Amazon , eBay and Temu responsible for collecting tax owed by retailers selling on their platforms, The Times reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain plans to make online marketplaces including Amazon (AMZN.O) , eBay (EBAY.O) and Temu responsible for collecting tax owed by retailers selling on their platforms, The Times reported on Tuesday. Finance Minister John Healey is expected to announce the measure as part of a crackdown on foreign sellers that avoid value-added tax, a move expected to raise up to £1 billion ($1.33 billion) and help fund business rate cuts for physical stores, the newspaper said. The move comes as traditional British retailers have stepped up calls for action against [USN:L8N4240E8 TEXT:"overseas online sellers"], arguing that tax and customs loopholes give them an unfair advantage Healey said in June Britain will [USN:SPN42U01S TEXT:"scrap customs"] duty relief on low-value imports from October 2028 targeting a tax loophole that benefits online retailers such as China's Shein The Treasury declined to comment on The Times report, saying decisions on tax are a matter for Healey to set out at fiscal events. Amazon, eBay, and Temu did not immediately respond to requests for comment The newspaper said online marketplaces would be required to collect VAT at source for business sellers with annual turnover above £90,000 Amazon welcomed the proposal, according to The Times, and estimated the change could raise about £700 million for the Treasury Ministers are understood to have looked at plans for a warehouse tax but rejected them, the report said Healey, who took office in July, is due to deliver his first budget on October 28 ($1 = 0.7545 pounds)

item.title: Russian missile attack on Kyiv kills two, Zelenskiy says no warning received
item.description: Russian forces struck the Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles on Tuesday, killing two people in a high-rise apartment and hitting a thermal power plant in the second attack in 24 hours without warning from Kyiv's Western allies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian forces struck the Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles on Tuesday, killing two people in a high-rise apartment and hitting a thermal power plant in the second attack in 24 hours without warning from Kyiv's Western allies. President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said the main target was energy infrastructure. He said it was unfair that Kyiv was enduring attacks without warnings from partners and said intelligence showed that more strikes were likely. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the strike on the nine-storey building had killed two people and injured 21. Sixteen were being treated in hospital and four were in a serious condition. Emergency crews were battling fires in apartments throughout the building and residents were being evacuated. Reuters pictures and TV footage showed firefighters training hoses on the building's shattered facade. "Once again, no advance warning from our partners. The main target was energy infrastructure, specifically thermal plant No. 4," Zelenskiy said on Telegram. "According to our intelligence, the Russians are preparing further ballistic missile launches." "The facts show that the Russians do not consider themselves bound to abide by what the president of the United States said," he added, referring to US President Donald Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire at the weekend. "And it is certainly unfair that they are destroying our energy infrastructure while Ukraine is not even receiving warnings about ballistic missile launches." Zelenskiy had [USN:L1N45Z0GP TEXT:"earlier said"] that Ukraine had received no warning from Western partners before a previous overnight attack on the capital. Trump said Washington was still sharing intelligence even as he pressured Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries. Reuters and other media have reported that US officials have threatened to cut off intelligence sharing and weapons sales to Ukraine unless it stops attacking Russian refineries. Kyiv relies heavily on US intelligence for early warnings of missile strikes, experts and officials say.

item.title: Tresoldi treble stuns Inter, Bayern held as Barcelona rally
item.description: Nicolo Tresoldi's hat-trick powered Club Brugge to a stunning 4-3 Champions League victory at Inter Milan on a night of scares for Europe's heavyweights on Tuesday, with Bayern Munich held 3-3 at Viking Stavanger while Barcelona recovered to beat Galatasaray 4-1.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: Nicolo Tresoldi's hat-trick powered Club Brugge to a stunning 4-3 Champions League victory at Inter Milan on a night of scares for Europe's heavyweights on Tuesday, with Bayern Munich held 3-3 at Viking Stavanger while Barcelona recovered to beat Galatasaray 4-1. Bayern fought back from two goals down to lead in Norway but Michael Olise's dismissal left them exposed and Herman Johan Haugen struck in added time to earn Viking a point. Barcelona proved more convincing in Istanbul, overturning a first-half deficit with Lamine Yamal supplying two assists, while Atletico Madrid won 2-0 against Manchester United, who had Leny Yoro sent off, and Arsenal scored three times in seven minutes to defeat Lille 3-0. TRESOLDI PUNISHES INTER Tresoldi, who had already hit the post, put Brugge ahead with a penalty on the half-hour mark after Hakan Calhanoglu fouled Carlos Forbs. Lautaro Martinez equalised before halftime, holding off his marker and turning to finish after Marcus Thuram and Federico Dimarco combined down the left. But a misunderstanding between Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez and his defence allowed Carlos Forbs to knock the ball through the keeper's legs, leaving Tresoldi to tap into an empty net and restore Brugge’s lead. Tresoldi completed his hat-trick in the 74th minute before Martinez's second goal seven minutes later revived Inter's hopes. Romeo Vermant made it 4-2 in the 87th minute, leaving Ange-Yoan Bonny's reply deep into added time as scant consolation for the home supporters. BAYERN DENIED LATE Gianni Stensness headed Viking ahead from a second-minute corner and the hosts doubled their advantage in the 38th with a sweeping counter-attack as Bayern pressed for an equaliser. Harry Kane began the comeback with a 54th-minute penalty following a lengthy VAR review of Kristoffer Haugen's foul on Konrad Laimer, then headed Bayern level six minutes later. Kane has now scored in nine successive Champions League matches, equalling the competition's second-longest scoring run, behind Cristiano Ronaldo's 11. Luis Diaz put Bayern ahead in the 71st minute, but Olise received his second yellow card three minutes later and Haugen's late equaliser denied the visitors victory. Barcelona also trailed after Alexey Batrakov scored for Galatasaray in the 28th minute. The hosts thought they had doubled their lead through a Baris Yilmaz header, only for VAR to identify an offside in the build-up. Joao Cancelo equalised just before halftime and Yamal then set up Fermin Lopez and Anthony Gordon to score in the 50th and 53rd minutes. Karim Adeyemi completed the victory. ATLETICO STRIKE EARLY Atletico needed only 50 seconds to punish Manchester United's high defensive line, Alex Baena breaking clear down the left before squaring for Pablo Barrios to finish. United threatened through Bryan Mbeumo, who shot narrowly wide and later forced a close-range save from Jan Oblak, while Marcus Rashford also squandered an opportunity. Atletico had a Johnny Cardoso effort disallowed for a Marcos Llorente handball before the break and Julian Alvarez volleyed against the post early in the second half. United's task became harder when Yoro was sent off in the 74th minute for denying Jonathan David a goalscoring opportunity. Five minutes later, Ademola Lookman tapped into an empty net after David's shot was saved. Arsenal had to wait until the 64th minute for Jurrien Timber to break Lille's resistance from Noni Madueke's pass. Substitute Bukayo Saka then set up Eberechi Eze's goal before Kai Havertz supplied Saka for the third in the 71st minute. Villarreal recovered to beat Napoli 3-1 with goals from Georges Mikautadze, Santiago Mourino and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi. Brajan Gruda's 75th-minute strike gave RB Leipzig a 1-0 win over PSV Eindhoven after goalkeeper Maarten Vandevoordt saved Ivan Perisic's early penalty with his boot. Earlier, Sabah Baku beat Slavia Prague 2-0 through second-half goals from Kaheem Parris and Joy-Lance Mickels, while Luis Suarez and Issa Doumbia secured Sporting's 2-0 victory at Lens.

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（13日）ドル下落、ナスダック続落 長期債利回り小幅低下
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。原油価格の下落や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）利上げ観測の後退に加え...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（13日）ドル下落、ナスダック続落　長期債利回り小幅低下 6:43 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。原油価格の下落や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）利上げ観測の後退に加え、米国資産の需要を支えてきた人工知能（ＡＩ）に関連した相場上昇を見直す動きが出ていることがドルの重荷になった。

ＦＲＢの今後の利上げの道筋を巡る新たな手掛かりを見極めようとする動きが出る中、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が、年内にあと１回の利上げを実施することが適切になるとの見方を変えていないものの、２０２７年に一段の利上げは必要ないとの考えを示したことを受け、ドル相場は一段安となった。

終盤の取引で円は対ドルで０．１８％高の１５８．３３円。日銀が発表した９月の企業物価指数（ＣＧＰＩ）速報によると、国内企業物価指数は前年比６．８％上昇し、国内企業物価指数は前年比６．８％上昇し、ロイターがまとめた民間調査機関の予測中央値の７．６％を下回った。ただ、日銀による一段の金融引き締め観測に加え、急激な為替変動に対する政府・日銀の為替介入への警戒感も引き続き円相場の支援材料になっている。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 長期債利回りが小幅に低下した。投資家の安全資産志向を背景とする欧州債利回りの低下に追随した。一方、重要な米インフレ指標の発表を翌日に控え、２年債利回りは上昇した。

１０年債利回りは一時、１０月２日以来の低水準を付けた後、低下幅を縮小した。前週には根強いインフレへの懸念から２４年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

長期債利回りは米国の午後の取引までに低下幅を縮小していたが、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁の発言を受け、一時再び低下した。ウィリアムズ総裁はブルームバーグ・ニュースに対し、年内にあと１回の利上げが適切との見方を依然として維持しているものの、現時点で連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２０２７年に再び利上げする必要があるとは考えていないと述べた。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは、直近で２．１ｂｐ低下の５．２２３％。一時は１０月初め以来の低水準となる５．１７２７％まで低下した。

３０年債利回りは３．３ｂｐ低下の５．５６６％。一時５．５３５５％を付けた。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利見通しに敏感な２年債利回りは０．９ｂｐ上昇の４．８％。一時は４．７５７４％まで低下していた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ナスダック総合が続落して取引を終えた。半導体株の下落が続く中、投資家はシティグループなど米大手銀行のまちまちな四半期決算を見極めた。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）は０．２３％下落し、５営業日続落した。ブロードコムのホック・タン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１２日、半導体業界への投資資金流入の一部を「カジノでの賭博」になぞらえた。また、中国のメモリー半導体メーカーＣＸＭＴの技術進歩に関する報道も、競争激化への懸念を浮き彫りにした。

マイクロン・テクノロジーは３．６％安、アプライド・マテリアルズは７％近く下落した。ブロードコムは０．７％上昇した。

シティグループは５．６％安、ゴールドマン・サックスは０．２％安。両行とも利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、株価は下落した。

ウェルズ・ファーゴは純金利収入が市場予想に届かず、３．１％下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースは利益が珍しく市場予想を下回り、０．９％安で引けた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米国のインフレ指標や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）議長の発言を控え、様子見姿勢が強まる中、下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．３％安の１オンス＝４１７７．３０ドル。スポット価格も０．３％安の４１５７．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ まちまち。米ロのディーゼル（軽油）合意でロシアからの供給拡大への期待が広がる一方、サウジアラビアとイエメンでの攻撃が供給の一段の混乱を招くとの懸念が意識された。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が前日比０．９６ドル（０．９％）安の１バレル＝１０５．６９ドル。前日は９月１５日以来の高値を付けていた。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４０ドル（０．４％）高の９４．１４ドルと、９月２４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: Fed Governor Cook's lawyer denounces Trump's latest attempt to remove her
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook's lawyer questioned the objectivity of a White House probe into allegations she committed mortgage fraud, according to a letter seen by Reuters on Tuesday, challenging President Donald Trump's latest attempt to remove her from her role.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook's lawyer questioned the objectivity of a White House [USN:L1N45V0HR TEXT:"probe"] into allegations she committed mortgage fraud, according to a letter seen by Reuters on Tuesday, challenging President Donald Trump's latest attempt to remove her from her role. Trump has been trying to fire Cook for more than a year as he moves to exert more control over a central bank he says is refusing for political reasons to lower interest rates. Cook denies any wrongdoing and has sued to keep her job. Earlier this month Trump announced a fresh inquiry into Cook and the appointment of a three-person committee to hold a hearing. The president later told reporters he would proceed with her firing if the committee recommended it. Cook's lawyers have said a fair hearing would show there is no legal basis for firing her. In Tuesday's letter, Cook's lawyer, Abbe Lowell, noted that one of the proposed members of the committee, White House economic policy advisor Kevin Hassett, had previously pressured Cook to take leave from her office and suggested Trump had "cause" to fire her. "A hearing with demonstrably biased members, unspecified additional allegations, and an unclear schedule for the disclosure of any additional evidence – with no explanation for why it was not previously produced – is not a process that respects the appearance or history of independence," Lowell wrote. Lowell said Cook would not be able to attend a hearing on the November 5 date announced by the White House because she would be fulfilling her duties in Europe "at financial and monetary policy meetings." The earliest that Cook could attend any hearing would be after the Fed's policy meeting scheduled for December 8-9, he wrote. A Supreme Court ruling in Cook's case earlier this year barred Trump from firing a Fed governor at will, noting the need for the Fed to remain politically independent both in fact and in appearance in order to do its job. But the ruling also laid out a path for a possible removal if a Fed official is given a fair chance to see the evidence of what is alleged and has a chance to refute it. The White House appears to be pursuing that path. The Fed raised its policy rate in September and is expected to do so again at its final meeting of the year.

item.title: Zelenskiy visits Britain as Burnham pledges fresh support for Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy will meet British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in London on Wednesday as Britain looks to reaffirm its support for Ukraine, including with the promise of a new package of surface-to-air missiles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy will meet British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in London on Wednesday as Britain looks to reaffirm its support for Ukraine, including with the promise of a new package of surface-to-air missiles. The meeting comes at a difficult time for Zelenskiy. US President Donald Trump said at the weekend he [USN:L6N45W06G TEXT:"should be replaced"] as Ukraine's leader, days after cutting a deal with Moscow to [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"lift sanctions"] on Russian diesel exports. Britain has said it does not support the US-Russia diesel deal, and called for allies to keep up the economic pressure on Moscow. "My message to the Ukrainian people could not be clearer, we are with you for as long as it takes, and we will go further and faster in our support to back your courageous fight for peace in Europe," Burnham said in a statement before the meeting. Burnham said backing for Ukraine was vital to keeping people in Britain safe and pledged further military support. He announced the planned delivery of £45 million ($59.60 million) of surface-to-air missiles used to target jet-powered Russian drones, with £10 million of that package fast-tracked to meet an urgent need in Ukraine. Burnham has asked officials to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal support, and his foreign and finance ministers have been lobbying allies to follow Britain in banning maritime services that support Russian liquefied natural gas exports. ($1 = 0.7551 pounds)

item.title: Rio Tinto on track to release $5 billion in capital after Q3 iron ore sales top estimates
item.description: Rio Tinto , said on Wednesday it was on track to release about $5 billion in capital by the end of 2026, as strong mine performance helped lift third-quarter Pilbara iron ore sales by 2%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) , (RIO.L) said on Wednesday it was on track to release about $5 billion in capital by the end of 2026, as strong mine performance helped lift third-quarter Pilbara iron ore sales by 2%. The world's largest iron ore producer sold 85.7 million metric tons of the steel-making commodity from its Pilbara operations in the three months ended September 30, beating the Visible Alpha consensus estimate of 84.41 Mt. This compares with 84.3 Mt sold last year. Rio said it had released more than $2 billion in capital this year under a $5 billion to $10 billion programme unveiled at its 2025 Capital Markets Day, aimed at funding higher-return growth opportunities. Quarterly copper output was broadly flat at 205,000 metric tons, as a 27% rise at Mongolia's Oyu Tolgoi mine offset lower production at Chile's Escondida and weaker refined copper output from Kennecott in the United States. Rio maintained its 2026 Pilbara iron ore sales forecast of 323 million to 338 million tons. It has shipped 243.4 million tons so far this year, leaving it needing 79.6 million tons in the fourth quarter to reach the bottom of the range. The fourth quarter is typically Rio's strongest. The miner said full-year lithium production was now expected at the lower end of its 61,000-64,000-ton forecast, citing a slower-than-expected ramp-up at its Sal de Vida project in Argentina. Rio's Simandou project in Guinea sold 1.7 million wet metric tons of iron ore in the first nine months, leaving it needing about 3.3 million tons in the fourth quarter to reach the bottom of its 5 million-10 million-ton full-year forecast.

item.title: Video de relámpagos en la Ciudad de México no se grabó en septiembre de 2026
item.description: Un video antiguo de relámpagos en la Ciudad de México se comparte erróneamente en redes sociales como un registro de un rayo en la capital el 30 de septiembre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un video antiguo de relámpagos en la Ciudad de México se comparte erróneamente en redes sociales como un registro de un rayo en la capital el 30 de septiembre. Una publicación en la red social X con el video dice: “Rayo provoca fuerte estruendo en #CDMX y activa falsa alerta de microsismo”. Sin embargo, el clip no tiene relación con el rayo que se registró ese día. El video lleva una etiqueta que menciona al usuario de YouTube Sevenguest, que lo publicó en su canal el 21 de mayo de 2026. El clip fue grabado desde la alcaldía Azcapotzalco, al norte de la ciudad, según la descripción, y muestra las antenas del cerro del Chiquihuite. Consultado a través de mensajes de TikTok el 6 de octubre, Sevenguest dijo que subió el clip en mayo: “Hace unos días que cayó un fuerte rayo muchos medios lo pusieron como si fuera el de ese día”. Protección Civil de la Ciudad de México emitió una alerta naranja por lluvias fuertes en 5 alcaldías para la tarde del 30 de septiembre y una alerta amarilla para las 11 demarcaciones restantes. Webcams de México, un sitio que ofrece videos en vivo de diferentes ciudades, publicó el mismo día en X un clip con marca de tiempo de las 16:56 horas, en el que se observa un rayo seguido de un estruendo. La cuenta dijo que se grabó en el centro de la ciudad. La aplicación de alerta temprana SkyAlert envió a esa hora una notificación sobre un “posible sismo local” en Mixcoac al oeste de la ciudad y dio un aviso en X. La empresa dijo el 7 de octubre en un correo que registró el movimiento del terreno de ese día y que no emitió una alerta sísmica anticipada, sino una “notificación informativa correspondiente a una funcionalidad experimental”. El Servicio Sismológico Nacional (SSN) dijo el 7 de octubre en un correo que no registraron sismos generados en el Valle de México el 30 de septiembre. Añadió que sus instrumentos de monitoreo pueden registrar diversos tipos de perturbaciones, incluso por estímulos meteorológicos, pero que el SSN solo se enfoca en los de origen tectónico. VEREDICTO Falta contexto. El video antiguo de un rayo en la Ciudad de México no tiene relación con el rayo seguido de un estruendo en la capital en septiembre. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Apple's HomeView brings personalized Siri to smart home, takes on Amazon and Google
item.description: Apple on Tuesday unveiled a smart-home hub that taps iPhone user data to make Siri more personal, but promised privacy safeguards designed to keep that information out of the company's hands.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Apple (AAPL.O) on Tuesday unveiled a smart-home hub that taps iPhone user data to make Siri more personal, but promised privacy safeguards designed to keep that information out of the company's hands. The HomeView smart-home hub, which [USN:L6N45Y122 TEXT:"took center stage"] at an event in New York, is an important test of Apple's AI strategy as it tries to close the gap with rivals Amazon (AMZN.O) and Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, while reinforcing its reputation for user privacy. In a series of demonstrations, Apple showed Siri AI recognizing a user's face and performing personalized tasks such as fetching recipes from text messages, finding a nearby farmer's market for missing ingredients and then updating shopping lists. When a different member of the household steps in, the HomeView recognizes that user's face and switches to their personal data, for example fetching information from text messages about when a friend's early morning flight lands and how long it will take them to arrive, then teeing up a coffee maker a few minutes ahead of time. The new device and Siri AI lean on the iPhone to make those personalized features happen, reflecting new CEO John Ternus' vision of Apple's best-selling product as an "intelligent personal hub" laid out at Apple's iPhone launch [USN:L6N45206Y TEXT:"event last month"]. Siri AI's usefulness hinges on how much it knows about a user. HomeView draws on a personal search index stored on the user's iPhone to personalize responses. "That will give you what's more relevant, what's more timely, what's important to you, because it's coming from your iPhone," Kaiann Drance, Apple's vice president of product marketing for home products, said in an interview. PRIVACY SAFEGUARDS AND ENCRYPTION HomeView has its own operating system and runs on Apple's A18 chip, designed to process encrypted user data in a walled-off part of the chip. To access private data, a user's iPhone has to be connected to the same home network as HomeView, and no private data is stored on the HomeView device itself. Apple said none of the data is used for marketing, including first-party advertising efforts. "One of the things we talked about is not building a marketing profile," Drance said. "Our intent is to provide users a helpful experience that adheres to simplicity, being personal, being intelligent, and continuing our commitment to privacy." A key difference between Siri AI and rival systems is that it does not end each interaction with a follow-up question designed to elicit more information from the user, a practice that Lilian Rincon, vice president of product marketing for AI, said was a deliberate choice on Apple's part. "For us, it's really about creating these really great products for consumers, which is why we're not in this game of getting you to engage and continue the conversation in many, many, many turns," Rincon said. HomeView also required Apple to figure out how to make Siri personal on a device shared by multiple people in communal spaces such as a kitchen. Apple demonstrated HomeView juggling requests from family members during the morning rush to school and work. While the device can recognize up to six voices and faces to show private data, Apple said it will make decisions on which user to prioritize based on who last touched the device and other factors, and that some features such as weather and thermostat controls will be available to any user. "There is a logic built in to kind of manage that experience," Drance said. "There was thought put into the nature of that communal computer sharing of the voice and the face recognition."

item.title: ＦＲＢ当局者、金利上昇が一部金融機関に課題もたらすと認識＝ボストン連銀総裁
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - 米ボストン地区連銀のコリンズ総裁は１３日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者は金利上昇が一部...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ当局者、金利上昇が一部金融機関に課題もたらすと認識＝ボストン連銀総裁 6:17 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

[１３日　ロイター] - 米ボストン地区連銀のコリンズ総裁は１３日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者は金利上昇が一部の金融機関に問題をもたらす可能性があることを認識していると述べた。

コリンズ総裁は同地区連銀での会議で「政策当局者としてわれわれは、金利の上昇が機会をもたらす一方で、いくつかの課題ももたらすことを十分に認識しており、その点について警戒し、留意していきたい」と語った。

また、金融政策のスタンスが変化する中で「適切に運営される銀行は、そうした側面について包括的に考える必要がある」と述べた。

さらに総裁は、インフレデータの動向に注目しており、インフレ圧力がどの程度広範に及んでいるかを注視していると述べた。

item.title: US appeals court limits felon gun ban, allows for violent cases
item.description: A US appeals court concluded on Tuesday that a federal law barring felons from owning guns can only be constitutionally applied when a person's prior conviction involved violence or threats suggesting a risk of firearms misuse.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A US appeals court concluded on Tuesday that a federal law barring felons from owning guns can only be constitutionally applied when a person's prior conviction involved violence or threats suggesting a risk of firearms misuse. The full Philadelphia-based 3rd US Circuit Court of Appeals in a pair of decisions ruled that in such cases, the primary federal law used to keep guns out of felons' hands does not violate the US Constitution's Second Amendment. The court, which now has a conservative majority following recent appointments by Republican President Donald Trump, said the law could be used to disarm a man convicted in a carjacking case but not against another man whose conviction stemmed from a DUI conviction. The decisions came in the latest in a series of court cases grappling with whether modern firearms restrictions remain valid after the Supreme Court handed down a landmark Second Amendment ruling in 2022 that expanded gun rights. The 6-3 conservative majority's [USN:L1N2YB1OL TEXT:"decision"], New York State Rifle & Pistol Association v. Bruen, held that modern gun restrictions must be "consistent with this nation's historical tradition of firearm regulation." One of the cases before the 3rd Circuit concerned James Bost, who had pleaded guilty to terroristic threats and criminal conspiracy charges in Pennsylvania state court arising out of a 2002 carjacking. When he was later indicted for possessing a gun despite his convictions, he moved to dismiss the case, arguing the ban, which dates to the 1960s, ran afoul of his right to keep and bear arms under the Second Amendment. But US Circuit Judge Stephanos Bibas, writing for the majority in Bost's case, said individuals convicted of crimes like Bost's that demonstrate a risk of physical violence from misusing guns may presumptively be disarmed based on their convictions alone. "The right to keep and bear arms has limits, and this is one: Those who pose a risk of physical violence from misusing guns can be disarmed before that risk becomes a reality," wrote Bibas, a Trump appointee, for a 12-2 court. But the 3rd Circuit split 8-6 along ideological lines in the separate case of Edward Williams, who had two convictions for driving under the influence of alcohol in the early 2000s, including one that triggered the federal ban, which covers offenses that are punishable by at least one year in prison. Williams had been sentenced to 90 days to two years, which he served in home confinement. Upon learning the conviction barred him from owning guns, he sued in order to secure a declaration that the law was unconstitutional as applied to his offense. In a majority decision joined only by Republican-appointed judges, Trump-appointed US Circuit Judge Paul Matey agreed as he rejected the Justice Department's contention that historical laws targeting "habitual drunkards" showed the law fell within the nation's tradition of firearms regulation. Matey called Williams "a peaceable citizen, capable of bearing arms consistent with the design of the Second Amendment." "And with that rehabilitation comes restoration of the civic privileges guaranteed to citizens by the Constitution, and the freedom to again exercise the natural right of armed defense against threats and tyranny," he wrote. The six dissenting judges were all appointed by Democratic presidents, including US Circuit Judge Arianna Freeman, who said she parted ways "from the majority opinion when it says a prior conviction is disarming on its face only if it involved violence or threats." While convictions that require violence or threats certainly qualify, the judge said, so do other offenses, including for drunk driving, "that show a person poses a credible threat to the physical safety of others." Joshua Prince, a lawyer for Williams, welcomed the ruling, which he said made clear "there does not exist any historical tradition of stripping individuals with non-violent convictions of their Second Amendment rights and whom do not pose a threat to the public in possession of a firearm." The cases in the 3rd US Circuit Court of Appeals are United States v Bost, No. 24-1719, and Williams v Attorney General, No. 24-1091. For the United States in Bost: Donovan Cocas of the US Attorney's Office for the Western District of Pennsylvania For the United States in Williams: Vivek Suri of the US Department of Justice For Bost: Jasmine Sola of the Federal Public Defender's Office for the Western District of Pennsylvania For Williams: Joshua Prince of Prince Law Offices

item.title: Bears DE Montez Sweat suspended 2 games for PED violation
item.description: The NFL suspended Chicago Bears defensive end Montez Sweat two games without pay on Tuesday for a violation of its performance-enhancing substance policy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL suspended Chicago Bears defensive end Montez Sweat two games without pay on Tuesday for a violation of its performance-enhancing substance policy. Shemar Turner was activated off of the physically unable to perform list and replaces Sweat on the 53-man roster. The Bears had until Thursday to activate Turner, whose 21-day practice window opened Sept. 23. Sweat will miss the Bears' contest at the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday followed by a Thursday night home game against the New England Patriots. He would be eligible to return for Week 8, when the Bears visit the Seattle Seahawks on "Monday Night Football" Nov. 2. Sweat, 30, is a one-time Pro Bowler in his third full season with the Bears. He has two sacks through five games after compiling 10 sacks a year ago. Drafted in the first round (No. 26 overall) by Washington in 2019, Sweat was traded to the Bears in 2023, the year of his first and only Pro Bowl selection. Across 114 career games (all starts) with the two franchises, Sweat has amassed 59 sacks, 314 tackles (75 for loss), 133 quarterback hits, 15 forced fumbles, 21 pass breakups, and one interception. Turner has been working back from a torn ACL he suffered on Oct. 26, 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Funcionário da OpenAI é preso acusado de porte de dispositivo de escuta, diz empresa
item.description: A OpenAI anunciou nesta terça-feira que a polícia federal dos Estados Unidos (FBI) prendeu um de seus funcionários em conexão com um sofisticado dispositivo de escuta encontrado escondido em um dos escritórios da empresa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A OpenAI anunciou nesta terça-feira que a polícia federal dos Estados Unidos (FBI) prendeu um de seus funcionários em conexão com um sofisticado dispositivo de escuta encontrado escondido em um dos escritórios da empresa. A criadora do ChatGPT utilizou seus modelos internos de IA para identificar o indivíduo responsável por instalar o dispositivo e rastrear sua origem, informou a companhia na rede social X. “No momento, não temos indícios de que esse indivíduo tenha acessado indevidamente ou extraído modelos, código-fonte ou dados de clientes. O funcionário foi demitido”, afirmou a companhia de inteligência artificial. A OpenAI afirmou que seu programa de segurança foi projetado para proteger contra uma ampla gama de agentes de ameaças, desde riscos internos até criminosos externos e Estados-nação. A empresa disse que encaminhou o caso ao FBI, que continua investigando. A descoberta ocorre em um momento em que a OpenAI enfrenta críticas sobre incidentes de segurança envolvendo seus sistemas de IA. No início deste mês, a Reuters e outros veículos de comunicação noticiaram que a OpenAI informou aos investidores que sua receita anualizada para setembro era de quase US$50 bilhões, uma queda em relação ao que havia sido sinalizado anteriormente. (Por Jaspreet Singh)

item.title: Activist investor Ancora pushes Big Yellow to explore sale
item.description: Activist investor Ancora Holdings has urged Britain-listed Big Yellow Group to launch a strategic review, including a potential sale of the self-storage company.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Activist investor Ancora Holdings has urged Britain-listed Big Yellow Group (BYG.L) to launch a strategic review, including a potential sale of the self-storage company. A sale represents the best risk-adjusted outcome for shareholders, Ancora, which has a more than 4% stake in Big Yellow, said in a presentation on Tuesday. Ancora said Big Yellow shares, which have fallen 23.6% so far this year, trade at an "unwarranted" discount to net asset value Big Yellow did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment Ancora estimates Big Yellow is worth £12.36 ($16.38) per share; Its shares closed at £7.99 on Tuesday, giving the company a market value of about £1.6 billion Ancora's push comes nearly a year after Big Yellow terminated discussions with Blackstone (BX.N) for a takeover at an undisclosed offer price Ancora said on Tuesday Blackstone had offered Big Yellow 50% above the current stock price and that if the company were to solicit interest from parties now, a deal could likely occur at a valuation above what Blackstone offered Blackstone did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on its 2025 offer for Big Yellow Big Yellow is "an attractive asset for both financial sponsors and strategic acquirers given the company's relative cheapness" compared to US storage REITs and the "scarcity value" of its UK portfolio, Ancora said Ancora is among a growing number of activists pressing companies to pursue asset sales or takeovers as M&A activity rebounds and pressure mounts on boards to unlock shareholder value. It had in June urged specialty chemicals maker Ashland (ASH.N) to [USN:L1N42H0S6 TEXT:"explore a sale"] ($1 = 0.7545 pounds)

item.title: Mexicano Grupo Televisa comprará filial de AT&T en México por 2,000 mln dlr
item.description: El mexicano Grupo Televisa anunció el martes que un consorcio que integra junto con Fintech Holdings Inc. alcanzó un acuerdo con AT&T para adquirir su filial en México por 2,000 millones de dólares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mexicano Grupo Televisa anunció el martes que un consorcio que integra junto con Fintech Holdings Inc. alcanzó un acuerdo con AT&T para adquirir su filial en México por 2,000 millones de dólares. Televisa (TLEVISACPO.MX) dijo que el consorcio espera financiar la adquisición de negocio de AT&T (T.N) a través de una combinación de efectivo disponible y un financiamiento de deuda garantizada. Televisa dijo que AT&T México es el segundo más grande operador móvil en México, con aproximadamente 24.7 millones de suscriptores al 31 de diciembre de 2025, y provee servicios integrados de telecomunicaciones incluyendo telefonía móvil, internet, y servicios de valor agregado Se espera que la transacción, sujeta a la obtención de aprobaciones regulatorias, se cierre en el primer trimestre de 2027. Las acciones de Televisa cerraron el martes antes del anuncio en 8.10 pesos en la bolsa local, una pérdida del 0.49%. Los títulos de AT&T cerraron con un alza del 1.60% en el NYSE, a 22.85 dólares, también antes de la noticia.

item.title: TRADING DAY Earnings season debuts to mixed reviews
item.description: Wall Street stocks were muted on Tuesday after big banks reported mixed earnings and investors looked ahead to Wednesday's crucial inflation report. The S&P 500 ended essentially flat, while Nasdaq closed slightly lower, weighed by chip weakness.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp
item.content:encoded: Wall Street stocks were muted on Tuesday after big banks reported mixed earnings and investors looked ahead to Wednesday's crucial inflation report. The S&P 500 ended essentially flat, while Nasdaq closed slightly lower, weighed by chip weakness. Third-quarter earnings optimism has been propping up the market, helping it soldier through geopolitical turmoil, surging bond yields and mounting inflation worries. Analysts currently expect year-on-year S&P 500 earnings growth of 30.6% for the July-September period, according to LSEG data. I will go into more detail on today's market moves below. If you have more time to read, here are a few articles I recommend to help you make sense of what happened in markets today. [USN:L6N45Z0RN TEXT:"Wall Street's big banks posted uneven third-quarter results, as equity and bond markets were roiled by ongoing wars, inflation worries and massive AI outlays"] [USN:L4N45Z0V1 TEXT:"JPMorgan Chase fell short of quarterly profit estimates for the first time in nearly three years"] [USN:L4N45Z0U6 TEXT:"Goldman Sachs beats third-quarter profit expectations on dealmaking and equities revenue"] [USN:L1N45Z0J7 TEXT:"US existing home sales unexpectedly increased in September as rising inventories offered buyers more choice"] [USN:L4N45Z1B2 TEXT:"US chipmakers slid, led by memory-related firms after reports of a technological advance by China's CXMT raised competition fears"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: [USN:L6N45Z0KI TEXT:"US stocks"] were muted following mixed bank earnings; [USN:L6N45Z0EP TEXT:"European"] shares pulled lower by AI selloff SECTORS/SHARES: Energy shares gain as WTI settles higher, homebuilders gain following upbeat housing data, chips extend Monday's loss; healthcare stocks, commercial airlines among the day's clear underperformers FX: The [USN:L6N45Z014 TEXT:"dollar"] slipped against a basket of world currencies as Brent crude prices eased and investors awaited new clues on the path forward for the Federal Reserve's monetary policy BONDS: Long-dated US Treasury yields eased as investors eyed European bond markets, while 2-year yields turned positive on the eve of Wednesday's key CPI report COMMODITIES/METALS: WTI [USN:L4N45Y1C0 TEXT:"crude"] settled up 0.4% while Brent settled down 0.9% as US-Russia diesel deal offset Saudi Yemen attacks; [USN:L4N45Z00T TEXT:"gold prices"] eased ahead of Wednesday's CPI report Today's Talking Points * Anthropic warns AI models may soon self-replicate without access to data centers Anthropic said on Monday that its experiments suggest small AI models could be [USN:L6N45Z08Z TEXT:"months away from self-replicating"] on internet-enabled items such as smart ovens and TV boxes. The experiments were aimed at determining whether AI models could find and copy themselves into vulnerable devices, then continue to spread. Replicating models would be difficult to shut down, as there is no central switch-off, and unlike non-AI malware, they could figure out unfamiliar devices on their own, potentially targeting data center processors, Anthropic warned. * A Democratic rout in November could lead to greater scrutiny of Wall Street, crypto firms Should the US midterm election [USN:L4N45K1IR TEXT:"give Democrats control"] of one or both congressional chambers, the party could gain subpoena power, and powerful tools to probe Wall Street, prediction markets and cryptocurrency companies. Polls suggest Democrats are poised to win the House of Representatives and have an edge in the race for the Senate. If the party prevails, it could call agency heads and CEOs to testify, and create headaches and legal entanglements for those under scrutiny. Democrats are already preparing to investigate President Donald Trump's and his family's ties to crypto and prediction markets, [USN:L6N45E0PR TEXT:"Reuters reported"]. * Iran is currently reviewing the US response to its Hormuz proposal, will respond once review is complete [USN:S8N43Z00A TEXT:"Tehran is still reviewing Washington's proposal"] regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and will respond to it via intermediaries when the review is over, according to Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei. After a June [USN:L1N42P0Q6 TEXT:"interim ceasefire"] fell apart, Iran presented its proposal in mid-September and later confirmed receipt of a US response. But [USN:S8N44Y00Z TEXT:"Iran’s security chief"] said on Sunday that Washington’s response did not sufficiently address Tehran’s seven [USN:S8N43Z003 TEXT:"conditions for reopening"] the Strait of Hormuz and returning to negotiations. * AI may be rocket fuel for US stocks, less so for GDP Wall Street is not the economy, so we are told. Nowhere is this clearer than the AI revolution, which is firing US stocks to record highs while, simultaneously, [USN:L6N45Y0TW TEXT:"weighing on real gross domestic product"] growth. Demand for all the equipment that goes into building US AI data centers and infrastructure is surging, but much of it is directed toward imports. This is widening the trade deficit, which, in turn, is a drag on growth; not enough to slow the economy to a halt, but enough to ensure it doesn't accelerate too fast. What could move markets tomorrow? item.title: ウクライナ、ＥＵ加盟交渉で前進 ハンガリーが反対撤回＝アイルランド閣外相
item.description: [ブリュッセル １３日ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル　１３日ロイター] - ウクライナは１３日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟に向けた取り組みで一歩前進し、ＥＵとの域内市場と競争力に関する基準を巡る協議を開始した。ハンガリーが反対を撤回したことを受けた。アイルランドのバーン欧州問題担当閣外相が明らかにした。

ハンガリー政府は、ウクライナ議会が１２日、ハンガリー語話者やその他の少数民族が母語で教育を受ける権利を拡充する法案を可決したことを受けて、今回の措置を支持した。

ＥＵ加盟手続きは通常、複雑な交渉が何年もかけて行われるが、ウクライナの場合は戦争が続いていることで、事態はさらに複雑化している。

手続きの一環として、加盟候補国は政策の「章」について交渉する。各章は基本的権利、ＥＵの域内市場、対外関係など６つのテーマ別クラスターに分類されている。

ＥＵは６月、司法制度や民主的機関の機能といった、最初の一連の政策課題についてウクライナとの交渉を開始した。７月には対外関係のクラスターに関する交渉を開始した。

item.title: Nneka Ogwumike wins sportsmanship honor for fifth time
item.description: Los Angeles Sparks forward Nneka Ogwumike was named winner of the Kim Perrot Sportsmanship Award on Tuesday, extending her record for winning the award to five times.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Sparks forward Nneka Ogwumike was named winner of the Kim Perrot Sportsmanship Award on Tuesday, extending her record for winning the award to five times. This marks the second straight season in which the 36-year-old Ogwumike won the award. She previously won it three straight times from 2019-21. Ogwumike previously announced the 2026 season would be her 15th and final campaign. She averaged 17.3 points, 9.0 rebounds and 3.1 assists in 43 games this season. Ogwumike received 38 votes in balloting of a panel of 74 sportswriters and broadcasters. Rebecca Allen (seven) of the New York Liberty was second and Kelsey Mitchell (six) of the Indiana Fever placed third. Ogwumike finished her career ranked fourth in WNBA history in points (8,047) and steals (718) and third in rebounds (3,657). She was an 11-time All-Star while playing for the Sparks (2012-23, 2026) and Seattle Storm (2024-25) and was league MVP in 2016 while leading Los Angeles to the WNBA title. The award is named after Kim Perrot, who won two WNBA championships with the Houston Comets (1997-98) before passing away in August 1999 after a battle with cancer. She was 32. --Field Level Media

item.title: ローマ教皇、肺腺がんと診断 右肺下葉切除＝教皇庁
item.description:
Joshua McElwee Matteo Negri
[ローマ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joshua McElwee　Matteo Negri

[ローマ　１３日　ロイター] -  ローマ教皇レオ１４世は１３日、入院先のイタリア・ローマ市内の病院で右肺の下葉を切除する手術を受け、一般的な肺がんの一種とされる肺腺がんと診断された。教皇庁（バチカン）が公表した医療報告で明らかにした。

報告によると、７１歳の教皇は肺腺がんを患っており、手術中に行われた組織検査で、術前検査の段階で医師団が疑っていた診断が確認された。

レオ１４世は肺にできた小さな結節を切除する手術を受けるため、この日にローマ市内のジェメッリ病院に入院した。教皇庁は夕方、手術が成功したと発表。その後、ジェメッリ病院胸部外科部長で執刀医のステファノ・マルガリトーラ教授による詳細な説明を公表した。

マルガリトーラ教授は「根治を目的として、胸腔鏡を用いた手術により右肺下葉を切除した」とし、「術中に実施した迅速病理検査で、術前検査で疑われていた肺腺がんとの診断が確認された」と述べた。

教皇庁によると、手術は約９０分で終了し、合併症はなかった。レオ１４世は覚醒しており、病室で静養しているという。教皇庁はこれ以上の情報は明らかにしていない。

教皇庁は今週初め、レオ１４世は約１週間入院するとの見通しを示していた。レオ１４世の全ての公式行事は２０日まで中止されている。

item.title: Ex-líder de gangue é condenado à prisão perpétua pelo assassinato de Tupac Shakur
item.description: Um ex-líder de gangue foi condenado nesta terça-feira a uma pena de prisão perpétua, com possibilidade de condicional após cumprir 40 anos, por orquestrar o assassinato do astro do hip-hop Tupac Shakur, ocorrido em 1996 em Las Vegas, encerrando o processo judicial do homicídio há muito não resolvido que marcou a era de ouro do rap.
item.dc:creator: Jack Queen, Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: Um ex-líder de gangue foi condenado nesta terça-feira a uma pena de prisão perpétua, com possibilidade de condicional após cumprir 40 anos, por orquestrar o assassinato do astro do hip-hop Tupac Shakur, ocorrido em 1996 em Las Vegas, encerrando o processo judicial do homicídio há muito não resolvido que marcou a era de ouro do rap. Duane “Keffe D” Davis, de 63 anos, considerado culpado de homicídio doloso em agosto, recebeu a sentença durante uma audiência nesta terça em um tribunal de Las Vegas. Em depoimento emocionado perante a juíza Carli Kierny, a irmã mais nova de Shakur, Sekyiwa Shakur, disse que sua mãe o criou para ser um ativista dos direitos humanos e o tratava como se ele tivesse o potencial de mudar o mundo. “Ele acreditava nela”, disse Sekyiwa Shakur, vestindo uma blusa preta. “Ele saiu pelo mundo para fazer isso. E acredito que ele teria conseguido.” Até a prisão de Davis em 2023, o assassinato de Shakur -- morto a tiros no banco do passageiro de um SUV dirigido por seu executivo da gravadora, Marion “Suge” Knight -- permaneceu por quase três décadas como um dos casos não resolvidos mais notórios dos Estados Unidos. O assassinato, que silenciou um dos artistas de rap mais influentes e bem-sucedidos comercialmente, reforçou a imagem de violência que permeava a cultura hip-hop dos anos 1990, ao mesmo tempo em que alimentava a infame rivalidade entre o rap “gangsta” da Costa Leste e da Costa Oeste dos EUA na época. Apesar da condenação de Davis, a questão de quem puxou o gatilho no disparo fatal contra a lenda do rap de 25 anos nunca foi decidida de forma conclusiva. Davis foi julgado e condenado por planejar o assassinato para vingar a agressão sofrida por seu sobrinho por parte de Shakur e membros da comitiva do rapper dentro do cassino MGM Grand, na Las Vegas Strip, em 7 de setembro de 1996. Davis afirmou que deve recorrer da condenação. MUNDO NUNCA ESQUECEU Autoridades afirmaram que acreditavam no envolvimento de Davis, mas não tinham provas suficientes para acusá-lo. Isso mudou quando ele tornou pública sua versão dos fatos em aparições na mídia e em um livro de memórias que, juntamente com gravações de suas reuniões secretas com os investigadores, constituiu a maior parte do processo de homicídio da acusação. Em seu livro, “Compton Street Legend”, o próprio Davis escreveu que era considerado suspeito dos assassinatos tanto de Shakur quanto de Christopher Wallace, um rapper rival. Dirigindo-se a Davis nesta terça-feira, a juíza disse que suas alegações de que ele havia mudado desde a década de 1990 não eram suficientes. “Você não tem o direito de tirar um homem de sua família”, disse Kierny, referindo-se a Shakur. “O mundo nunca se esqueceu dele.” BRIGA EM CASSINO O confronto no cassino teve origem na hostilidade entre duas gangues de rua da região de Los Angeles -- os South Side Compton Crips, dos quais Davis se autodenominava líder, e os Mob Piru, associados a Shakur, Knight e sua gravadora, a Death Row Records. Membros dos dois grupos estavam em Las Vegas para assistir, naquela noite, a uma luta pelo título mundial de boxe na categoria peso-pesado entre Mike Tyson e Bruce Seldon. Poucas horas após a briga no cassino, Davis colocou seu sobrinho e dois outros comparsas em um Cadillac branco e saiu em busca de Shakur e Knight, determinado a acertar as contas, de acordo com um depoimento prestado por Davis à polícia em uma investigação posterior não relacionada ao caso, mas citada pelos promotores durante o julgamento por homicídio. Davis disse que passou uma arma para os dois homens sentados atrás dele no Cadillac, um dos quais responsável por disparar pela janela quando se colocaram ao lado do veículo de Knight e Shakur no trânsito. Shakur foi atingido quatro vezes e morreu em um hospital seis dias depois. Knight, que sofreu um ferimento leve causado por um fragmento de bala que lhe raspou a cabeça, cumpre atualmente uma pena de 28 anos de prisão por uma condenação não relacionada por homicídio doloso. Embora Davis nunca tenha sido acusado de realmente disparar os tiros que mataram Shakur -- a lei de Nevada permite que alguém seja acusado de homicídio por participação no crime --, os promotores nunca identificaram um suspeito de ter disparado. Todos os outros três homens que estavam no Cadillac com Davis naquela noite já faleceram.

item.title: Report: Celtics sign G Payton Pritchard to 2-year, $44.2M extension
item.description: The Boston Celtics agreed to a two-year, $44.2-million contract extension with guard Payton Pritchard that will begin in the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Boston Celtics agreed to a two-year, $44.2-million contract extension with guard Payton Pritchard that will begin in the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported Tuesday. Pritchard, 28, delivered the best season of his six-year career in 2025-26 when he averaged career bests with 17.0 points, 5.2 assists and 3.9 rebounds. He played in 79 games while making 50 starts after making 17 total starts over his first five seasons. The deal for the 2024-25 Sixth Man of the Year, includes a mutual option for the 2029-30 season. His current deal in Boston runs through the 2027-28 season. A first-round draft pick (26th overall) by the Celtics in 2020 out of Oregon, Pritchard has averaged 10.6 points with 3.0 assists and 3.0 rebounds in 426 games (67 starts) all in Boston. During the Celtics' run to the NBA title in 2024, Pritchard averaged 6.4 points with 2.1 assists and 1.9 rebounds in 19 playoff games. --Field Level Media

item.title: OpenAI hit with proposed class action over collection of children’s data
item.description: OpenAI illegally profits from the personal information and data minors share with ChatGPT, a mother whose two children use the chatbot alleged in a proposed class action filed in San Francisco federal court on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: OpenAI illegally profits from the personal information and data minors share with ChatGPT, a mother whose two children use the chatbot alleged in a proposed class action filed in San Francisco federal court on Tuesday. • The lawsuit, filed on behalf of minors who have used ChatGPT, claims the chatbot is designed to collect data and information from minors, which is then used to train OpenAI's AI models • The chatbot elicits information about personal problems from minors in chats full of emojis and slang that kids use • Minors can’t consent to the use of their data under California law, lawsuit claims • Lawsuit wants OpenAI equity awarded to minors who use ChatGPT and a declaration that the site's terms of use are void for minors • A representative for OpenAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment, but on its website the company says that it gives users control over whether their data is available to train other AI models • The lawsuit comes after a series of cases against OpenAI that [USN:L6N45K0T3 TEXT:"have"] [USN:L6N45D0ZP TEXT:"been"] [USN:L6N43O111 TEXT:"filed"] in US state and federal courts in recent months over claims that ChatGPT facilitated violence The case is Jane Doe et al v. OpenAI Foundation et al, US District Court for the Northern District of California, case number 3:26-cv-11781. For plaintiffs: R. Paul Yetter of Yetter Coleman For OpenAI: unavailable

item.title: Bank of England's Bailey says companies are focusing on costs
item.description: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said companies in Britain are focusing intensely on containing their costs amid the surge in energy prices caused by the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said companies in Britain are focusing intensely on containing their costs amid the surge in energy prices caused by the Iran war . In an interview with CNN broadcast on Tuesday, Bailey reiterated his previous comments that pressure on broader inflation in the UK from the energy shock had so far been subdued, "but the longer this goes on, the harder it gets." While the BoE would take into consideration the resilience to date of the UK economy, Bailey said there were signs of companies taking a cautious stance. "When I go around the country — and I do a lot of talking to firms, and my colleagues do — there's a very big focus on cost containment in terms of when they're looking at the increase in their costs," he said. A focus on cost-cutting could affect the labour market, although it was still "early days" for assessing the impact of the energy price surge in areas such as wages, Bailey added. The BoE has kept borrowing costs on hold since the start of the Iran war, unlike the European Central Bank and the US Federal Reserve, which have both raised rates. However, investors are pricing the chance of a quarter-point rate hike by the BoE next month as a near certainty.

item.title: Watkins on target to keep Al-Hilal perfect in Asian Champions League
item.description: Al-Hilal secured a 2-0 win over Qatar's Al-Sadd in Doha on Tuesday with Ollie Watkins' improvised finish sending the Saudi Pro League outfit on their way to a second successive Asian Champions League Elite win.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Al-Hilal secured a 2-0 win over Qatar's Al-Sadd in Doha on Tuesday with Ollie Watkins' improvised finish sending the Saudi Pro League outfit on their way to a second successive Asian Champions League Elite win. The former Aston Villa striker netted in the 40th minute to give Al-Hilal the lead, calmly steering the ball home while lying on the turf after being upended in the penalty area by Agustin Soria. "I felt like I worked hard for the team, I got my goal and that's what I'm here to do, get goals for the team and ultimately work hard and put everything into the game," said Watkins. The win followed Al-Hilal's opening victory over Al-Gharafa in the western league phase of the competition last month and was sealed when Ruben Neves scored from the penalty spot in the 65th minute. Al-Hilal were joined on six points by Shabab Al-Ahli after the side from the United Arab Emirates beat former champions Al-Ittihad 2-1 in Jeddah. Sardar Azmoun struck twice in the opening 16 minutes, converting from close range in the seventh before the Iran international ran from just inside the Al-Ittihad half before finishing. Richard Rios pulled one back for the hosts in the 66th minute but Shabab Al-Ahli held on to take the points. "We were very focused and we believed we can win this game," said Azmoun. "We analysed them well and we worked on the pitch very hard and that's why we won the game." Al-Ain from the UAE and Iran's Esteghlal also have perfect records after two rounds of the eight-match league phase. The top eight finishers in both the west and east regions advance to the last 16.

item.title: Petrolera estadounidense NABEP dice que recibió dos taladros en Venezuela
item.description: La empresa energética estadounidense NABEP, que recientemente anunció una asociación con el gobierno de Estados Unidos para operar en Venezuela, informó el martes que la semana pasada recibió dos taladros de perforación en el país sudamericano, los cuales contribuirán a aumentar la producción.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La empresa energética estadounidense NABEP, que recientemente anunció una asociación con el gobierno de Estados Unidos para operar en Venezuela, informó el martes que la semana pasada recibió dos taladros de perforación en el país sudamericano, los cuales contribuirán a aumentar la producción. Asimismo, está desplegando en el país otros 11 equipos nuevos de reacondicionamiento de pozos de 550 caballos de fuerza, según indicó la compañía en un comunicado, añadiendo que ha adquirido por separado 60 equipos, 30 calderas de vapor y 70 unidades de maquinaria pesada para ampliar su flota en la región. "NABEP está logrando avances serios y constantes en el aumento de la producción petrolera. Cada equipo que llega a Venezuela nos acerca más a alcanzar nuestras metas de producción y a revitalizar la economía del país", declaró el director ejecutivo de NABEP, el empresario venezolano Alejandro Betancourt.

item.title: Zealand Pharma, Generate strike AI obesity drug deal worth up to $1.2 billion
item.description: Danish obesity-drug developer Zealand Pharma has partnered with US biotechnology company Generate Biomedicines to develop protein-based treatments for obesity and other metabolic diseases using AI, in a deal worth up to $1.2 billion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Danish obesity-drug developer Zealand Pharma (ZELA.CO) has partnered with US biotechnology company Generate Biomedicines (GENB.O) to develop protein-based treatments for obesity and other metabolic diseases using AI, in a deal worth up to $1.2 billion. Generate will receive $30 million upfront and up to $35 million in early preclinical milestones, and is eligible for total milestone payments of nearly $1.2 billion, the companies said on Tuesday. Generate's shares were up about 5% in extended trading. The deal comes as drugmakers race to develop new obesity treatments beyond the blockbuster GLP-1 weight-loss drugs sold by Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) and Eli Lilly (LLY.N) . The success of those medicines has fueled investment across the obesity market, with companies testing new approaches aimed at improving effectiveness, convenience or side-effect profiles. Generate, a Flagship Pioneering-backed biotechnology company that [USN:L6N3ZN02T TEXT:"went public earlier this year"], uses AI-driven technology to develop protein-based medicines. Under the agreement, Generate will lead research through candidate selection, while Zealand will handle clinical development, regulatory submissions and worldwide commercialization. The collaboration will focus on multispecific protein therapies, medicines designed to act on more than one biological target at a time. Zealand said those treatments could target several disease pathways linked to obesity within a single medicine, an approach drugmakers are increasingly exploring as they seek more effective treatments. Zealand, which has traditionally focused on peptide-based medicines, is jointly developing obesity drug petrelintide with Roche (ROPC.S) as part of an up to $5.3 billion agreement signed last year. Earlier this month, Zealand [USN:L4N45T1D8 TEXT:"reported positive mid-stage trial results"] showing the treatment helped overweight and obese patients with type 2 diabetes lose up to 9.2% of their body weight.

item.title: 原油先物まちまち、米ロの軽油合意巡る期待と中東情勢懸念が交錯
item.description:
Scott DiSavino
[１３日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物はまちまち。米ロのディーゼル（軽油）合意で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物まちまち、米ロの軽油合意巡る期待と中東情勢懸念が交錯 5:41 配信

オマーン沿岸沖を航行する石油タンカー。オマーン・ムサンダムから６月撮影。REUTERS/Stringer

Scott DiSavino

[１３日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物はまちまち。米ロのディーゼル（軽油）合意でロシアからの供給拡大への期待が広がる一方、サウジアラビアとイエメンでの攻撃が供給の一段の混乱を招くとの懸念が意識された。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が前日比０．９６ドル（０．９％）安の１バレル＝１０５．６９ドル。前日は９月１５日以来の高値を付けていた。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４０ドル（０．４％）高の９４．１４ドルと、９月２４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。

ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）は、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給するとトランプ米大統領が発表した合意について、ウクライナ和平協議に対するロシアの立場とは直接的な関連はないとの見解を示した。 ロシアとウクライナの戦争を終結させる合意が成立すれば、ロシアはエネルギーの輸出を拡大できる可能性がある。

一方、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１３日、サウジアラビアが首都サヌアを攻撃していると発表。これに先立ち、サウジアラビア主導の連合軍は、サヌアにあるイエメン石油会社のサバハ中央給油所について、安全確保のため周辺住民に退避するよう呼びかけていた。
