item.title: BofA fined $1.2 billion by US government for failing to police suspicious activity
item.description: Bank of America has been fined $1.21 billion by US regulators for widespread failures to detect potential money laundering and other illicit activity, a penalty the bank said will hurt third-quarter earnings.
item.dc:creator: Pete Schroeder, Ismail Shakil, Saeed Azhar
item.content:encoded: Bank of America (BAC.N) has been fined $1.21 billion by US regulators for widespread failures to detect potential money laundering and other illicit activity, a penalty the bank said will hurt third-quarter earnings. The Treasury Department said the fine, the third-largest in department history, is due to the bank's failure to report more than $5 billion in suspicious activity to the government, including $1 billion that posed national security-related and other priority illicit finance risks. "Financial institutions are on the front lines of protecting our economic and national security," Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement. "When a bank of this size fails to meet its anti-money laundering and sanctions obligations, the consequences extend far beyond its own walls, exposing the entire US financial system to significant illicit finance risks." The Treasury said the bank "prioritized its revenues" in building compliance programs, and overly relied on inquiries from outside parties like law enforcement and other financial institutions instead of its own internal controls. The consent order requires Bank of America to hire an independent third party to review past transactions, identify suspicious activity that the bank failed to detect at the time, and report those transactions to FinCEN. "Financial crime compliance is serious, and we are responsible for getting it right," said a Bank of America spokesperson in a statement. "We have invested billions of dollars in technology and dedicated thousands of employees to combat financial crime, and our team is far along with and committed to completing the work required to address the issues raised by our regulators." The spokesperson added that the bank's third-quarter results due for release on Wednesday will include a non-tax-deductible charge of $1.2 billion, which will reduce quarterly net income by approximately 17 cents a share. Analysts have estimated adjusted EPS of $1.10, according to mean estimates compiled by LSEG, but that excludes one-offs like this fine. Shares were down 2.7% in after-hours trading after closing the day down 1.1%. The penalty is likely to add to negative investor sentiment and raise concerns about higher expenses and whether Bank of America can maintain its roughly $6 billion quarterly share buyback pace, UBS analyst Erika Najarian said in a note. With earnings due on Wednesday, "we think shares likely underperforming at open," she said. She noted there was no asset cap, a regulatory penalty that would limit how large the bank could grow. REGULATOR SAYS COMPLIANCE PROGRAM 'DEFICIENT AND INEFFECTIVE' As part of the fine, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency levied a $750 million civil penalty against the lender, the largest ever for the regulator, citing failures to address shortcomings in its anti-money laundering programs that were identified as part of a 2024 cease-and-desist order from the watchdog. The regulator said the bank's compliance program was "deficient and ineffective," and its transaction monitoring system caused the bank to delay filing suspicious activity reports on billions of dollars of transactions. In addition, the bank paid an $11.6 million fine to the Office of Foreign Assets Control for over 400 apparent violations of numerous sanctions programs. The Treasury said the bank mistakenly processed millions of dollars in payments that violated sanctions programs targeting countries including Russia and Iran. The fine comes days after American Express [USN:L6N45U1AT TEXT:"was also hit with a $350 million penalty"] for similar anti-money laundering shortcomings.

item.title: Nasdaq fecha em baixa com queda das fabricantes de chips e divulgação de resultados de bancos
item.description: O Nasdaq fechou em baixa nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips ampliando as perdas recentes e os investidores analisando os resultados trimestrais mistos do Citigroup e de outros grandes bancos dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: O Nasdaq fechou em baixa nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips ampliando as perdas recentes e os investidores analisando os resultados trimestrais mistos do Citigroup e de outros grandes bancos dos EUA. O índice de chips da PHLX (.SOX) caiu 0,23%, queda pela quinta sessão consecutiva, depois que o presidente-executivo da Broadcom (AVGO.O) , Hock Tan, comparou na segunda-feira parte do fluxo de investimentos no setor a “apostas em cassinos”. Além disso, reportagens sobre avanços tecnológicos da empresa chinesa de chips de memória CXMT reforçaram as preocupações com o aumento da concorrência. A Micron Technology (MU.O) perdeu 3,6% e a Applied Materials (AMAT.O) tombou quase 7%. A Broadcom subiu 0,7%. O Citigroup (C.N) tombou 5,6% e o Goldman Sachs (GS.N) perdeu 0,2% depois que ambos os bancos superaram as estimativas de lucro. O Wells Fargo (WFC.N) caiu 3,1% depois que sua margem financeira líquida ficou abaixo das estimativas, enquanto o JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) encerrou o dia com queda de 0,9% após um raro resultado abaixo do esperado. A Apple (AAPL.O) atingiu uma alta recorde intradia de US$348,15 antes de fechar com alta de 0,1%, a US$341,27, elevando seu valor de mercado para US$4,98 trilhões. Analistas preveem, em média, que os lucros do terceiro trimestre do S&P 500 cresçam mais de 30%, impulsionados em grande parte por empresas de tecnologia relacionadas à IA, de acordo com dados da LSEG. As expectativas de uma forte temporada de resultados compensaram as preocupações com a guerra dos EUA contra o Irã, o aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos e a inflação relacionada aos altos preços do petróleo. “Muitos investidores estão sentindo um alívio, pois os mercados podem começar a se concentrar mais nos lucros e menos no mercado de títulos, menos nos preços do petróleo mais altos por mais tempo e menos nas altas taxas de juros”, disse Jake Dollarhide, presidente-executivo da Longbow Asset Management em Tulsa, Oklahoma. O S&P 500 teve variação negativa de 0,02%, encerrando o pregão em 7.805,45 pontos. O Nasdaq recuou 0,15%, para 27.204,38 pontos, enquanto o Dow Jones Industrial Average caiu 0,35%, para 51.670,10 pontos. O S&P 500 acumula alta de 14% em 2026, impulsionado pelas ações de tecnologia relacionadas à IA. No entanto, a mediana das ações do índice subiu menos de 5% e mais de 200 componentes do S&P 500 apresentam queda no ano. O índice de chips PHLX perdeu mais de 8% nas últimas cinco sessões, mas continua com alta de mais de 70% no acumulado do ano. O índice de saúde do S&P 500 (.SPXHC) caiu 1,3% nesta terça-feira, com a Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) registrando queda de 5,7%, apesar de ter superado as estimativas de lucro. A Bumble (BMBL.O) disparou quase 57% depois que a operadora do aplicativo de namoro concordou em fechar seu capital em um negócio de US$1,3 bilhão. A Domino’s Pizza (DPZ.O) registrou queda de 4,8% após revisar para baixo sua previsão de vendas para o ano inteiro.

item.title: León se sometió a la extirpación de un lóbulo pulmonar tras diagnóstico de cáncer, dice el Vaticano
item.description: El papa León se sometió el martes a una intervención quirúrgica en la que se le extirpó el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho y se le diagnosticó un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, un tipo común de cáncer de pulmón, informó el Vaticano en un boletín médico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León se sometió el martes a una intervención quirúrgica en la que se le extirpó el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho y se le diagnosticó un adenocarcinoma pulmonar, un tipo común de cáncer de pulmón, informó el Vaticano en un boletín médico. León, de 71 años, ingresó el martes en el hospital Gemelli de Roma para someterse a una intervención quirúrgica destinada a extirpar un nódulo pulmonar que los médicos le detectaron en un reciente reconocimiento médico. La intervención quirúrgica del martes duró unos 90 minutos y se desarrolló con éxito, sin complicaciones, según informó el Vaticano. El papa se despertó con normalidad y está descansando en su habitación del hospital. El Vaticano había indicado anteriormente que se esperaba que el papa pasara una semana en el hospital recuperándose.

item.title: 年内追加利上げ適切、インフレなお高水準＝米ボストン連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米ボストン地区連銀のコリンズ総裁は１３日、な...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
年内追加利上げ適切、インフレなお高水準＝米ボストン連銀総裁 5:29 配信

４月１４日撮影　 REUTERS/Evan Vucci

Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 米ボストン地区連銀のコリンズ総裁は１３日、なお高水準にあるインフレ率を押し下げるため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は年内に追加利上げを実施する必要があるとの考えを示した。

コリンズ氏はボストン連銀開催の銀行会議向けの講演で、連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）が９月の会合で決定した利上げを支持したとした上で、「インフレ率を適時かつ持続的にＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すために、年末までに金利を若干引き上げることが適切になる」と述べた。

その上で、追加的な政策対応の必要性と、その適切な時期についての見方は、今後発表される一連の経済指標が見通しやリスクバランスに及ぼす影響に大きく左右されると指摘。経済と労働市場が堅調に推移していることから、ＦＲＢはインフレ目標の達成に政策運営の重点を置くことができると述べた。

経済見通しについては全体的に楽観的な見方を示したものの、いくつかのリスク要因が存在すると指摘。「最も可能性が高いシナリオは、労働市場がほぼ完全雇用の状態を維持する中で、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）が健全な成長を続けるというものだ」とし、「このシナリオの下では、継続的な効率化の進展が需要と供給の均衡を支え、ディスインフレに寄与することで、インフレ率は徐々に２％に低下する」と述べた。

同時に、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラの整備に向けた技術投資の拡大のほか、関税の影響、中東での戦争を背景としたエネルギーコスト上昇で、インフレ抑制に向けた取り組みが複雑化する可能性があると警告。「ジェット燃料やディーゼル（軽油）、暖房用燃料油など精製エネルギー製品の価格が最近上昇していることを踏まえると、総合インフレ率とコアインフレ率はいずれも向こう数カ月にわたりＦＲＢの２％目標を上回って推移する可能性がある」との見方を示した。

ＦＲＢは９月１５─１６日のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。決定は全会一致で、利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりだった。同会合で公表されたＦＯＭＣ参加者の金利見通しでは、年末までにあと１回の追加利上げが示された。複数のＦＲＢ当局者はここ数週間、追加利上げは今月２７─２８日の会合ではなく、その次の１２月の会合で決定されるとの見方を強く示唆している。

コリンズ総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：3月のマイナス解除、否定しなかった植田総裁会見の本音 コラム：日銀金融政策の「その先」、政策金利が中立化した後の課題とは＝井上哲也氏 コラム：ウォーシュ氏、問われる「有言実行」　市場の信頼回復は道半ば 最終更新: 10/14(水) 5:29 ロイター

item.title: AT&T sells Mexico unit to Televisa, Fintech for $2 billion
item.description: US carrier AT&T said on Tuesday it agreed to sell its Mexican unit to a consortium made up of Mexico's Grupo Televisa and Fintech Holdings for $2 billion in cash, as it sharpens its focus on domestic fiber and 5G networks and also leans into AI.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US carrier AT&T (T.N) said on Tuesday it agreed to sell its Mexican unit to a consortium made up of Mexico's Grupo Televisa (TLEVISACPO.MX) and Fintech Holdings for $2 billion in cash, as it sharpens its focus on domestic fiber and 5G networks and also leans into AI. The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, pending regulatory approvals in Mexico, AT&T said. Its Mexican unit, the country's second-largest mobile operator, had approximately 24.7 million subscribers as of December 2025, according to Televisa. The deal's purchase price is subject to adjustments, plus additional contractual and contingent benefits, and will be funded through available cash and non-recourse secured debt financing, Televisa said. Televisa and Fintech Holdings each own a 50% stake of the purchasing consortium. Televisa is Mexico's largest broadcaster and the world's largest producer of Spanish-language content. Fintech is a private investment firm and holding company owned by the Mexican billionaire David Martinez. "We have articulated a strong belief that the AI future will run on converged networks with dense fiber assets," AT&T Chairman and CEO John Stankey said in a statement. "This move positions AT&T Mexico to participate in that evolution." Shares in Grupo Televisa rose 5.3% in after-hours trading on the New York Stock Exchange following the announcement on Tuesday, while AT&T gained 1.6% to close at $22.85. The deal ends AT&T's push into Mexico, which began with the 2014 purchase of lusacell and included the acquisition in 2015 of Nextel Mexico to take on America Movil's Telcel, the country's dominant wireless carrier. AT&T's Mexican unit ended 2025 with revenue of 85.4 billion pesos ($4.65 billion) and operating income of 1.4 billion pesos ($76.3 million), Televisa said. The sale of AT&T's Mexico unit follows the Mexico departure of Spanish telecoms giant Telefonica Movistar, which in April [USN:L6N40R03P TEXT:"sold its Mexico business"] to a US-led consortium for $450 million as it shifts its focus onto core markets in Europe. ($1 = 18.36 Mexican pesos)

item.title: Papa Leão teve lobo do pulmão removido após médicos detectarem câncer, diz Vaticano
item.description: O papa Leão foi diagnosticado com uma forma comum de câncer de pulmão depois que os médicos removeram o lobo inferior do pulmão direito durante uma cirurgia realizada nesta terça-feira, informou o Vaticano em um boletim médico.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee, Matteo Negri
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão foi diagnosticado com uma forma comum de câncer de pulmão depois que os médicos removeram o lobo inferior do pulmão direito durante uma cirurgia realizada nesta terça-feira, informou o Vaticano em um boletim médico. O pontífice, de 71 anos, tem adenocarcinoma pulmonar. Exames de tecido realizados durante a operação confirmaram o que os médicos já suspeitavam com base nos exames preparatórios, informou o boletim. Leão, de 71 anos, foi internado no Hospital Gemelli, em Roma, nesta terça-feira, para uma cirurgia destinada a remover um nódulo no pulmão que os médicos detectaram em um exame médico recente. O Vaticano havia informado na noite desta terça-feira que a operação havia sido bem-sucedida, antes de divulgar uma atualização mais detalhada do cirurgião-chefe do papa, dr. Stefano Margaritora, e de seu médico pessoal, dr. Luigi Carbone. “Para que o procedimento fosse curativo, o lobo inferior do pulmão direito foi removido por meio de uma técnica assistida por vídeo”, informou o comunicado médico, deixando claro que o objetivo era eliminar todo o tecido canceroso. Os pulmões humanos têm cinco lobos — três no pulmão direito e dois no esquerdo. “Um rápido exame histológico intraoperatório confirmou o diagnóstico de adenocarcinoma pulmonar, conforme já se suspeitava com base nos exames pré-operatórios”, acrescentou. A cirurgia realizada nesta terça-feira durou cerca de 90 minutos e foi bem-sucedida, sem complicações, informou o Vaticano. O papa acordou normalmente e está descansando em seu quarto no hospital. Especialistas médicos afirmaram que, para avaliar o caso do papa, precisariam saber o tamanho do tumor removido e se o câncer havia se espalhado para os gânglios linfáticos — informações que o Vaticano não forneceu imediatamente. “Embora tenhamos o diagnóstico, ainda não sabemos o estágio da doença. Isso é fundamental para o prognóstico e o tratamento”, disse o dr. Stephen Liu, especialista em câncer de pulmão da Universidade de Georgetown, em Washington, e chefe da divisão de hematologia-oncologia do MedStar Georgetown University Hospital. “Se for um câncer de pulmão pequeno, sem envolvimento dos gânglios linfáticos, a cirurgia por si só provavelmente será curativa”, disse ele à Reuters. “Mas se a análise final revelar um envolvimento maior do câncer, isso indica um prognóstico mais desfavorável.” PREVISÃO DE PERMANÊNCIA NO HOSPITAL POR UMA SEMANA Leão deixou o Vaticano antes da cirurgia, pouco antes das 13h em Roma, e foi visto acenando da parte de trás de um SUV preto enquanto sua comitiva dirigia cerca de 9 km ao norte do Vaticano, em direção ao Gemelli. Ao chegar ao hospital, Leão apertou a mão de várias autoridades, passou diante de uma multidão de simpatizantes que o aguardava — alguns dos quais gritavam “Auguri” (melhores votos) — e entrou pela entrada principal. O Vaticano informou no início desta semana que o papa deveria passar cerca de uma semana em recuperação no hospital. Todos os seus compromissos públicos foram cancelados até 20 de outubro. Leão, eleito pelos cardeais de todo o mundo em maio de 2025, é relativamente jovem para um líder da Igreja. Ele gosta de esportes, incluindo tênis, e não é conhecido por ser fumante nem por ter tido problemas de saúde recentes. O falecido papa Francisco, predecessor de Leão, foi hospitalizado várias vezes à medida que sua saúde se debilitava nos últimos anos de vida. Ele faleceu aos 88 anos em abril de 2025. Leão, que falou com voz firme e clara em seu único evento público na segunda-feira, mantém uma agenda muito ocupada. Ele deve realizar uma viagem de 11 dias pelo Uruguai, Argentina e Peru, de 6 a 17 de novembro. FEBRE TIFOIDE O papa é a máxima autoridade terrena para os 1,4 bilhão de católicos do mundo e não tem um substituto que assuma suas funções quando ele fica doente. Quando um papa fica incapacitado, os trabalhos da vasta burocracia do Vaticano seguem normalmente, adiando quaisquer decisões que exijam aprovação papal. Leão, nascido em Chicago em 1955 como Robert Prevost, atuou por décadas como missionário e bispo no Peru antes de se tornar papa. Em 1985, quando era um jovem padre, contraiu febre tifoide em Chulucanas, no Peru, e foi hospitalizado. Ele relatou a experiência em sua única grande entrevista concedida como papa, em um livro publicado pela Penguin Peru. Leão disse que a dor era tão forte que pediu a Deus para morrer, em vez de continuar sofrendo. Ele interpretou sua sobrevivência como um sinal de Deus de que “precisamos de você aqui (na Terra)”, disse ele. “Nunca mais olhei para trás”, disse Leão.

item.title: Cornell bans fraternity parties for rest of academic year after alleged gang rape
item.description: Cornell University will ban parties and social events at fraternity houses until the end of the academic year, its president said on Tuesday, responding to the outcry over an alleged gang rape on campus in 2024.
item.dc:creator: Maria Tsvetkova
item.content:encoded: Cornell University will ban parties and social events at fraternity houses until the end of the academic year, its president said on Tuesday, responding to the outcry over an alleged gang rape on campus in 2024. The measure is the strongest reaction yet from Cornell's leadership to a lawsuit [USN:L1N45T0PE TEXT:"filed by a former undergraduate"], Jane Doe, alleging seven men sexually assaulted her during a party. Over the last several weeks, the Ivy League school in Ithaca, New York, and its president, Michael Kotlikoff, have come under heavy criticism from students, faculty and donors over its response to the allegations. The suspension of parties and social events will apply to Interfraternity Council houses. The council website says Cornell currently has 34 fraternity houses. "These measures will provide time for a thorough review of fraternity life at Cornell to determine whether and how it can safely continue," Kotlikoff said in the statement. The Cornell Interfraternity Council did not immediately reply to a request for comment. Prosecutors reopened the investigation into the alleged gang rape after the lawsuit was filed. New York state Governor Kathy Hochul appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James as an independent special prosecutor in the case, citing the earlier failure to protect the alleged victim. President Donald Trump repeated on Tuesday his call to take James, his longtime critic and an elected Democrat, off the case. "The Governor should take James off this case, immediately," Trump posted on Truth Social. Trump first questioned James' appointment in early October, but his comments did not prompt any action by officials. The offices of Hochul and the attorney general did not immediately reply to requests for comment. Since the [USN:L1N45K0ML TEXT:"lawsuit"] against seven fraternity members, the university and others was filed in September, the Cornell administration has faced student protests, a pending no-confidence resolution from faculty, criticism by alumni and a public assembly where students blamed university officials for tolerating what they described as a culture of sexual violence. None of the men named in the lawsuit have been criminally charged. "I have spent the past weeks listening to students, faculty, staff, parents, alumni, and trustees, who have shared their feelings of deep connection and sympathy with Jane Doe, anger and frustration that this could happen at Cornell," Kotlikoff said. "Women on our campus continue to question whether they are safe," he said, adding that additional staff would be hired to support survivors of sexual assault. Cornell will also work with New York State Police to investigate incidents, he said, and accelerate previous recommendations put forward by a task force on sexual violence. Thirty-five percent of undergraduate women reported experiencing non-consensual sexual contact involving force or incapacitation since entering Cornell, according to a university survey conducted in 2025 and published on its website. "We must meet this moment by acknowledging where we have fallen short and taking meaningful action," Kotlikoff said.

item.title: Pope Leo had lobe of lung removed as doctors found cancer, Vatican says
item.description: Pope Leo had a lower lobe of his right lung removed during surgery on Tuesday and was diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, a common form of lung cancer, the Vatican said in a medical bulletin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo had a lower lobe of his right lung removed during surgery on Tuesday and was diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, a common form of lung cancer, the Vatican said in a medical bulletin. Leo, 71, was admitted to Rome's Gemelli hospital on Tuesday for surgery to remove a growth on his lung that doctors found in a recent health checkup. Tuesday's surgery lasted about 90 minutes and was successful with no complications, the Vatican said. The pope has woken up normally and is resting in his hospital room. The Vatican said previously that the pope was expected to spend a week in hospital recovering.

item.title: Galeão deve receber investimentos de R$1 bi nos próximos 3 anos
item.description: O aeroporto internacional do Rio de Janeiro, Galeão, deve receber investimentos privados de ao menos R$1 bilhão nos próximos três anos, disse o presidente no Brasil da nova concessionária do terminal, a espanhola Aena , Santiago Yus, nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Viga Gaier
item.content:encoded: O aeroporto internacional do Rio de Janeiro, Galeão, deve receber investimentos privados de ao menos R$1 bilhão nos próximos três anos, disse o presidente no Brasil da nova concessionária do terminal, a espanhola Aena (AENA.MC) , Santiago Yus, nesta terça-feira. Segundo ele, esses investimentos incluem um novo hotel de bandeira internacional com mais de 200 quartos, centro de testes da montadora BYD (002594.SZ) , novos hangares e galpões e um novo terminal de cargas. Os investimentos não contemplam futuros aportes Aena que assumiu oficialmente o controle do terminal na semana passada. O Galeão deve fechar o ano com um novo fluxo recorde de passageiros podendo alcançar 19 milhões de pessoas ante 17 milhões em 2025. Ainda sim, está longe da capacidade total que beira os 37 milhões de passageiros por ano. "No mundo trabalhamos com mais de 200 companhias aéreas e achamos que temos condições de trazer mais empresas para cá, ampliando frequências e destinos", afirmou o presidente da Aena no Brasil. O crescimento nos passageiros que passam pelo Galeão ocorre após o governo federal criar um teto de voos no aeroporto Santos Dumont, provocando uma migração de voos para o terminal internacional que antes da medida chegou a ter menos passageiros que o Santos Dumont. A flexibilização do teto de 6,5 milhões de passageiros para o Santos Dumont está em discussão pelo governo federal. O terminal na região central do Rio de Janeiro é a principal fonte de recursos da Infraero, estatal aeroportuária do governo federal. Uma futura concessão do Santos Dumont será analisada pela Aena, disse Yus. "Para a Aena, o Brasil é um mercado estratégico...então interesse (no Santos Dumont) no mínimo existirá", afirmou. A empresa de origem espanhola já administra 18 aeroportos no Brasil sendo Galeão e Congonhas, em São Paulo, os de maior destaque.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック続落、半導体株安続く 銀行決算まちまち
item.description:
Noel Randewich
［１３日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合が続落して取引を終えた。半導体株の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック続落、半導体株安続く　銀行決算まちまち 5:13 配信

2026年7月6日撮影。REUTERS/Jordan Tovin

Noel Randewich

［１３日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合が続落して取引を終えた。半導体株の下落が続く中、投資家はシティグループなど米大手銀行のまちまちな四半期決算を見極めた。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）は０．２３％下落し、５営業日続落した。ブロードコムのホック・タン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１２日、半導体業界への投資資金流入の一部を「カジノでの賭博」になぞらえた。また、中国のメモリー半導体メーカーＣＸＭＴの技術進歩に関する報道も、競争激化への懸念を浮き彫りにした。

マイクロン・テクノロジーは３．６％安、アプライド・マテリアルズは７％近く下落した。ブロードコムは０．７％上昇した。

シティグループは５．６％安、ゴールドマン・サックスは０．２％安。両行とも利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、株価は下落した。

ウェルズ・ファーゴは純金利収入が市場予想に届かず、３．１％下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースは利益が珍しく市場予想を下回り、０．９％安で引けた。

アップルは取引時間中に３４８．１５ドルと過去最高値を付けた後、０．１％高の３４１．２７ドルで終了。時価総額は４兆９８００億ドルとなった。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種構成企業の第３・四半期利益について、主に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のテクノロジー企業にけん引され、前年同期比３０％超増加すると予想している。

好調な企業決算への期待が、米国とイランの戦争や債券利回りの急上昇、原油高に伴うインフレへの懸念を相殺している。

ロングボウ・アセット・マネジメントのジェイク・ダラーハイドＣＥＯは「市場が債券市場や原油価格の高止まり、高金利よりも企業業績に目を向け始めるかもしれないと、多くの投資家が安堵している」と述べた。

ＳＯＸ指数は過去５営業日で８％超下落したが、年初来ではなお７０％超上昇している。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種のヘルスケア指数はこの日、１．３％下落した。ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）は利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、５．７％下落した。

出会い系アプリ運営のバンブルは５７％近く急伸。１３億ドルの取引で株式を非公開化することで合意した。

ドミノ・ピザは通期の売上高見通しを引き下げ、４．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数の比率は１．１対１だった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１４８億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７６億株。

item.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends down as chipmakers fall and bank earnings roll in
item.description: In a recent trading session, the Nasdaq index took a hit as chip stocks continued their downward spiral, amid diverging results from major banks like Citigroup and Goldman Sachs. The PHLX chip index faced a substantial decline, sparking fears surrounding competition in this sector. Despite the turbulence, analysts express optimism about future earnings linked to AI-driven innovations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Nasdaq ended lower on Tuesday, as chip stocks added to recent losses and investors parsed mixed quarterly results from Citigroup and other big US banks.The PHLX chip index fell for a fifth straight session, after Broadcom CEO Hock Tan on Monday likened some of the investment flow into the sector to casino gambling. Additionally, reports of technological advances by Chinese memory chip company CXMT underscored concerns about rising competition.Micron Technology and Applied Materials both fell sharply. Broadcom rose.Citigroup dipped and Goldman Sachs rose after both banks topped profit estimates.Wells Fargo fell after its net interest income missed estimates, while JPMorgan Chase swung between gains and losses following a rare profit miss.Apple hit an intraday record high.Analysts on average see S&P 500 third-quarter earnings surging over 30%, fueled largely by AI-related technology companies, according to LSEG data.Expectations of a strong earnings season have offset worries about the US war with Iran, surging bond yields and inflation related to high oil prices.Also Read | NY Fed President Williams sees no need for a rate hike in 2027 A lot of investors are feeling a sense of relief that markets might start looking at earnings and less at the bond market, less at higher-for-longer oil prices and less at high interest rates, said Jake Dollarhide, CEO of Longbow Asset Management in Tulsa, Oklahoma.According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 lost 1.41 points, or 0.02%, to end at 7,805.83 points, while the Nasdaq Composite lost 42.37 points, or 0.15%, to 27,203.53. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 173.10 points, or 0.33%, to 51,677.45.The S&P 500 has rallied about 14% in 2026, lifted by AI-related technology stocks. However, the median stock in the index is up less than 5% and over 200 S&P 500 components are down for the year.Reflecting expectations of strong corporate earnings from AI heavyweights, the S&P 500 is trading at under 19 times expected earnings, its lowest since 2023.The PHLX chip index has lost more than 8% in the past five sessions and it remains up over 70% year-to-date.The S&P 500 healthcare index fell on Tuesday, with Johnson & Johnson down despite topping profit estimates.Bumble jumped after the dating-app operator agreed to go private in a $1.3 billion deal.Domino's Pizza declined after scaling back its full-year sales outlook.

item.title: Tyson Fury-Anthony Joshua bout could start after 1 a.m. in Wales
item.description: A request to hold the much-anticipated heavyweight bout between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua in the very early morning hours has been filed in Cardiff, Wales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A request to hold the much-anticipated heavyweight bout between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua in the very early morning hours has been filed in Cardiff, Wales. If approved, the bout would have a ring walk of 1 a.m. local time on Dec. 12, which equates to 8 p.m. on the East Coast of the United States and 5 p.m. on the West Coast on Dec. 11. The 74,000-seat Principality Stadium, home to the Wales national rugby team, is set to host the bout. Both Fury and Joshua have different stipulations as to where the bout can take place, with Cardiff working out as a compromise after locations like Dublin, Las Vegas and New York also were considered, The Athletic reported. Fury, 38, is from Manchester, England, while Joshua, 36, is from Watford, Hertfordshire, England. Cardiff requires boxing and wrestling events to end by 1 a.m., with the request asking for an extension until 3 a.m., with the stadium open until 3:30 a.m. A request to serve alcohol into the early-morning hours also has been submitted. Netflix is set to broadcast the bout, which was announced in September. Elected officials, as well as members of the public, have until Nov. 3 to give their opinion on the time extension to the Cardiff Council. --Field Level Media

item.title: Federal Circuit rejects PTAB's 'ministerial' requirement for prior art priority
item.description: Jonathan Bowser of Haynes Boone discusses the Federal Circuit's rejection of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board's "ministerial" standard for determining when a prior art patent can claim an earlier filing date under the America Invents Act.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Bowser
item.content:encoded: A backdating Issue The scenario recurs often. An inter partes review petitioner wants to use a patent or published application as prior art, but the reference's own filing date is too late. The reference, however, claims priority to a provisional or parent application filed before the challenged patent's effective filing date. If the reference can reach back to that earlier date, it becomes prior art. If it cannot, the petitioner's invalidity ground collapses. Patent claims are governed under the AIA if they have an effective filing date on or after March 16, 2013. Patent claims with an effective filing date before March 16, 2013, are governed under pre-AIA law. Under pre-AIA law, the requirement for proving a reference patent is entitled to the earlier date of its provisional is governed by the Federal Circuit's decision in Dynamic Drinkware, LLC v. National Graphics, Inc., 800 F.3d 1375 (Fed. Cir. 2015). Under Dynamic Drinkware, a reference patent is entitled to its provisional's date only if (1) the provisional provides written description support under 35 U.S.C. § 112 for at least one claim of the reference patent, and (2) the subject matter relied upon in the reference patent is described in the provisional. The rationale was straightforward. A challenger should not be able to backdate prior art by claiming priority from an application that would not itself have supported a patent on the claimed invention. The Board's Penumbra framework In Penumbra, Inc. v. RapidPulse, Inc., IPR2021-01466, 2023 WL 2605070 (P.T.A.B. March 10, 2023), the Board held that Dynamic Drinkware's claim-support requirement was a product of pre-AIA § 102(e) and does not govern prior art determinations under AIA § 102. Instead, the Board announced a two-part test. A reference patent need only satisfy the "ministerial requirements" of AIA §§ 119 and 120 — a proper benefit claim, co-pendency, common inventorship — and the earlier application must "describe the subject matter" relied upon in the reference as prior art. Whether any claim of the reference was actually entitled to priority, the Board said, is not at issue. That framework did not emerge from nowhere. The Board leaned on the AIA's structural distinction between the "effective filing date" of a claimed invention under § 100(i) and the date a reference is "effectively filed" for prior art purposes under § 102(d). It also relied heavily on USPTO guidance, including MPEP § 2154.01(b) and a 2018 memorandum to the examining corps stating that the Dynamic Drinkware claim-support requirement "is not applicable when examining an application subject to the first inventor to file provisions of the AIA." Penumbra was designated precedential, and the Board applied it routinely — including in the IPR on appeal in Dental Monitoring, where the Board treated the reference patent as prior art as of its provisional date without deciding whether the provisional described any of the reference patent's claims. The statute supplies the answer The Federal Circuit based its decision in Dental Monitoring SAS v. Align Technology, Inc., 184 F.4th 1376 (Fed. Cir. 2026), on the text of the AIA. Section 102(d)(2) gives a reference the benefit of an earlier filing date only "if the patent or application for patent is entitled to claim a right of priority under [§] 119." Section 119(e)(1), in turn, extends entitlement to provisional priority only where the invention is "disclosed [in the provisional] in the manner provided by [§] 112(a)." Section 102(d) therefore incorporates a substantive written description requirement, and nothing in its text carves out prior art determinations or supplies a "less demanding 'ministerial' standard." The Court placed particular weight on the words "entitled to claim." That phrasing, it explained, refers to substantive entitlement, not the procedural act of asserting priority. Congress could have written § 102(d)(2) to cover a patent that merely "claims" or "asserts" a right of priority. It did not, and reading the provision the Board's way would render "entitled to" superfluous. The Court also corrected a persistent misreading of Dynamic Drinkware. Align argued that the decision was confined to pre-AIA § 102(e). But Dynamic Drinkware's footnote declining to address "newly designated § 102(d)" was a reservation of decision, not a holding that the AIA abrogated the written description requirement. The court noted that Align "confuses a reservation of decision with a holding on the merits." Even assuming Dynamic Drinkware does not formally control, the underlying principle survives: a reference cannot obtain the benefit of an earlier filing date for subject matter the earlier application did not support. As for § 100(i), the Court agreed that the AIA distinguishes an invention's effective filing date from a reference's effective prior art date, but held that the distinction "identifies which statutory inquiry is being performed" without telling us what substantive requirements "entitled" incorporates. And the Board's statements describing § 102(d) as imposing only "ministerial" requirements could not carry the day, because "the authoritative statement is the statutory text, not the legislative history." Because the Board never made the necessary factual findings, the court vacated and remanded rather than reversing, leaving the written description question for the Board in the first instance. A word on Rule 36 Practitioners who had treated Penumbra as blessed by the Federal Circuit should note a pointed footnote. The Court had earlier affirmed Penumbra by Rule 36 judgment without opinion.RapidPulse, Inc. v. Penumbra Inc., Nos. 2024-1130 and 2024-1131, 2025 WL 2911056 (Oct. 14, 2025). That affirmance, the Court explained, establishes only that the judgment below was correct; it "does not endorse or reject any specific part of the [Board's] reasoning," and "has no precedential value." A Rule 36 win is not an endorsement of the reasoning that produced it. Takeaways Petitioners bear a new burden of proof for prior art reference patents challenging AIA patents. Any ground resting on a reference patent's provisional or parent filing date now requires an affirmative showing that the earlier application provides § 112(a) written description support for at least one of the reference's published claims. That is a claim-by-claim, four-corners analysis — not a citation to the benefit claim on the reference's face. Petitions should build that record up front, with expert support, because the petitioner has the burden of persuasion to establish that a reference patent qualifies as prior art. Patent owners gain a powerful gatekeeping argument. Where the petition is silent on claim support, patent owners can attack the reference's prior art status directly, without engaging the merits of the obviousness theory. In closely spaced priority contests, that argument may be dispositive. Finally, the decision is a reminder about the durability of PTAB precedent. A precedential PTAB decision built substantially on agency guidance and legislative history is vulnerable when the statutory text points the other way — and a Rule 36 affirmance will not insulate it. This article reflects only the present personal considerations, opinions, and/or views of the author, which should not be attributed to the author's current or prior law firm(s) or former or present clients. Jonathan Bowser is a regular contributing columnist on patent law for Reuters Legal News and Westlaw Today.

Oct 13 (Reuters) – Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday he had proposed new talks in the coming days with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner as Washington steps up efforts to bring Kyiv and Moscow back to negotiations.

The proposal follows talks in the United States last week at which Witkoff and Kushner told a Ukrainian delegation that a deal allowing Russian diesel exports was aimed at drawing Moscow back to negotiations.

In his nightly video address, Zelenskiy also said Ukraine supported President Donald Trump’s proposed energy truce as long as Russia observed it.

Show Full Article

“Our team has sent the American side the relevant proposals regarding possible next meetings and conversations. In the coming days, we are ready to meet and I passed this proposal on to Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner through my team.”

item.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI engineer over covert recording device, DOJ says
item.description: US federal agents arrested a Saudi national who was an OpenAI engineer and charged him with installing a hidden audio recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company, the Justice Department said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Singh
item.content:encoded: US federal agents arrested a Saudi national who was an OpenAI engineer and charged him with installing a hidden audio recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company, the Justice Department said on Tuesday. The case highlights growing security concerns around sensitive AI research as companies and governments compete fiercely for the talent and technology that could confer economic and strategic advantages. Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, had worked as an engineer at OpenAI since July 2025, the Justice Department said in a statement. An email sent to an address associated with that name did not elicit a response, and it was not immediately clear who his lawyer was. OpenAI discovered the recording device plugged into a USB port on the back of a television in an executive conference room at one of its San Francisco buildings on September 30, according to the department. The thumb-sized device, which had a microphone and could connect to a camera, was concealed in toilet paper, according to an FBI complaint. It was installed on or about September 28, while its stored data was encrypted and inaccessible. Investigators later found a similar customized device in Alfozan's personal bag. OpenAI said in a post on X that it used its internal AI models to identify the person responsible for planting the device and trace its origins. The company said it had evidence that the employee intended to place additional recording devices in sensitive areas of its offices to secretly record meetings. "At this time, we have no indications of this individual inappropriately accessing or exfiltrating model weights, source code, or customer data. The employee was terminated," the company said. OpenAI referred the matter to the FBI, which is continuing to investigate. The Saudi embassy in the United States did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. "Abdulrahman Alfozan allegedly concealed a covert recording device inside his employer's executive conference room to secretly capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology," FBI Director Kash Patel said in a statement. Alfozan also used an AI productivity agent to seek information about meeting-room calendars and capabilities for about a month through September 16, according to the FBI complaint. He has been a legal permanent resident of the US since September 2020. If convicted, Alfozan faces up to five years in prison, a $250,000 fine and three years of supervised release. A LinkedIn profile showed that Alfozan studied at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and the University of California, Berkeley. He previously worked at Meta and Microsoft, it said. Reuters could not independently verify the details mentioned in his LinkedIn profile. Separately, the Information reported that OpenAI was in early talks to acquire Trail of Bits, a startup that identifies and fixes vulnerabilities in open-source software. The talks were ongoing and could fall apart, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. OpenAI and Trail of Bits did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. OpenAI said on Friday it fired three researchers after an investigation found they had violated company policies on handling sensitive information. The researchers, Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni, had published a letter detailing the circumstances of their dismissal and arguing that the abrupt firings could create uncertainty among employees and undermine a culture in which researchers could raise safety concerns.

item.title: Uber gets green light to pursue racketeering case against Philadelphia lawyer
item.description: Uber Technologies can pursue civil racketeering claims against a Philadelphia-based lawyer even though the company's insurer footed its defense bills in a series of allegedly fraudulent personal injury lawsuits, a federal judge ruled on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: Uber Technologies (UBER.N) can pursue civil racketeering claims against a Philadelphia-based lawyer even though the company's insurer footed its defense bills in a series of allegedly fraudulent personal injury lawsuits, a federal judge ruled on Tuesday. US District Judge Mark Kearney in Philadelphia held that the rideshare giant has standing to pursue its case against Marc Simon and his firm Simon & Simon. Uber alleges the law firm worked with doctors and other providers to file fraudulent personal injury claims against it and Federal Express Corporation (FDX.N) . Simon and his firm have denied wrongdoing. "Uber did not relinquish its standing to sue parties who bring fraudulent claims against it by purchasing liability insurance and permitting its conduit, Farmers, to issue payments on its behalf," Kearney wrote in his 14-page ruling . An Uber spokesperson said in a statement that Kearney's ruling "makes clear that Uber can continue pursuing its racketeering claims, and we remain confident in our case." Daniel Rhynhart of Blank Rome, who represents Simon and his firm, said in a statement that they were disappointed "but will continue to vigorously defend this unfounded lawsuit and believe that our client will ultimately be vindicated.” The case is scheduled to go to trial in March. Uber and FedEx have mounted similar lawsuits against law firms in federal courts in [USN:L1N3TI014 TEXT:"Los Angeles"], [USN:L6N3SE0TU TEXT:"Miami"] and [USN:L6N40R0DN TEXT:"New York"] alleging lawyers worked in conjunction with medical providers to file bogus and exaggerated claims against them. Kearney in May [USN:L6N41O15M TEXT:"denied a motion to dismiss"] Uber and FedEx's case against the Simon & Simon firm. The companies alleged Simon directs clients to certain providers whose unnecessary treatments or false diagnoses inflate the value of their claims, which could result in a larger settlement. FedEx and Uber claim that Simon and his firm direct these medical providers to create fraudulent documents which are then used as the basis of litigation. Simon has argued that the companies are abusing RICO in an effort to put him out of business. He brought [USN:L6N42H0ZU TEXT:"counterclaims"] against Uber and FedEx in June, asserting their RICO allegations are "objectively and subjectively baseless" because some cases they agreed to settle were being cited as evidence of a racketeering scheme. Kearney dismissed the counterclaims in August.

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米特使との追加協議提案 数日内の会談に意欲
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１３日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１３日、米国がウクライナとロシアの交渉再開に向けた取り組みを強化する中、米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使、トランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏との新たな協議を数日以内に行うことを提案したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏の提案は、先週米国で行われた協議を受けたもの。恒例の夜のビデオ演説で「会談や協議に関する提案を米国に送った。われわれは向こう数日以内に会談する用意があり、この提案をウィトコフ氏とクシュナー氏に伝えた」と述べた。トランプ米大統領が発表したエネルギー施設を対象とする停戦については、ロシアが順守する限り支持する考えを改めて示した。

米国、ウクライナ、欧州の交渉担当者は９日、米フロリダ州マイアミで戦争終結に向けた統一提案での合意を目指し、６時間にわたる協議を実施。同日には、トランプ大統領がロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表した。ウィトコフ氏とクシュナー氏はウクライナ代表団に対し、ロシア産ディーゼルの輸出を認める合意は、ロシアを交渉の場に呼び戻すことを目的としていると説明している。

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＦＲＢ利上げ観測後退 ＣＰＩに注目
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。原油価格...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＦＲＢ利上げ観測後退　ＣＰＩに注目 4:55 配信

２０１１年３月撮影　 REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　１３日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。原油価格の下落や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）利上げ観測の後退に加え、米国資産の需要を支えてきた人工知能（ＡＩ）に関連した相場上昇を見直す動きが出ていることがドルの重荷になった。

ＦＲＢの今後の利上げの道筋を巡る新たな手掛かりを見極めようとする動きが出る中、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が、年内にあと１回の利上げを実施することが適切になるとの見方を変えていないものの、２０２７年に一段の利上げは必要ないとの考えを示したことを受け、ドル相場は一段安となった。

終盤の取引で円は対ドルで０．１８％高の１５８．３３円。日銀が発表した９月の企業物価指数（ＣＧＰＩ）速報によると、国内企業物価指数は前年比６．８％上昇し、国内企業物価指数は前年比６．８％上昇し、ロイターがまとめた民間調査機関の予測中央値の７．６％を下回った。ただ、日銀による一段の金融引き締め観測に加え、急激な為替変動に対する政府・日銀の為替介入への警戒感も引き続き円相場の支援材料になっている。

ユーロは対円で０．１９％高の１７７．２９５円。前日には２５年１１月以来の安値となる１７６．２５円を付けていた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３７％安の１０２．１８。前日は１０２．６１まで上昇し、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。コーペイ（トロント）のチーフ市場ストラテジスト、カール・シャモッタ氏は「人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株のバリュエーションの強さや持続性に対する懐疑的な見方が強まり、米金融市場への資本流入が鈍るとの見方からドルは下落している」と述べた。

市場ではＦＲＢの今後の金融政策を見極めようと、１４日に発表される９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が注目されている。ＦＲＢ当局者２人が追加利上げの必要性を判断する前に一段の証拠を見極める必要があるとの考えを示したほか、ウォラーＦＲＢ理事がインフレ期待は「十分に抑制されている」と述べたことを受け、今月の利上げ観測は一段と後退した。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で金利据え置きが決定される確率は約８０％。１カ月前は５１％だった。

終盤の取引でユーロは対ドルで０．４０％高の１．１１９８ドル。前日は１．１１５２５ドルまで下落し、２５年５月以来の安値を付けていた。

item.title: Cornell's sexual-assault investigation aims at transparency, but will findings become public?
item.description: In an attempt to quell the public outcry over Cornell University’s handling of sexual assault allegations, the Ivy League school’s board took a common step: call in the lawyers.
item.dc:creator: Sara Randazzo
item.content:encoded: In an attempt to quell the [USN:L1N45R111 TEXT:"public outcry"] over Cornell University’s handling of sexual assault allegations, the Ivy League school’s board took a common step: call in the lawyers. A team from King & Spalding, led by Justice Department veteran Sally Yates, [USN:L6N45S15B TEXT:"has been tasked"] with conducting an independent investigation into Cornell’s policies and procedures for addressing sexual harassment and assault on campus, including its response to the “Jane Doe” case that has [USN:L6N45O0CP TEXT:"drawn national attention"]. Cornell's board said it “intends to share the results and recommendations with the Cornell community," but education attorneys I spoke to said intentions can change and what's ultimately released could be limited to policy suggestions rather than a full dissection of what King & Spalding finds. Universities pledging transparency after a crisis face a competing interest of protecting themselves from further litigation. That tension, lawyers say, often leads universities to structure investigations to reduce the paper trail and reveal less than the public may expect. Cornell declined to comment beyond its statement announcing the law firm's hire. “The trend lately is: we don’t want anything in writing,” said Scott Schneider, a Texas-based education and employment lawyer who has done internal investigations for universities. He pointed to the recent example of the University of Michigan hiring Jenner & Block last year to conduct a culture review of its athletics department, but releasing only a summary of recommendations and actions rather than a full report. The university said it did so in part to maintain the confidentiality of the 300 witnesses interviewed and to preserve attorney-client privilege. OPENING THE DOOR An investigation a decade ago by Pepper Hamilton, now a part of Troutman Pepper Locke, into sexual assault allegations involving Baylor University football players shows the litigation risks universities face when publicly disclosing even limited results of outside probes. When Pepper Hamilton concluded its work, Baylor's board received an oral report from the lawyers and publicly released a 13-page findings of fact report along with 10 pages of recommendations on how to address the "fundamental failure" by the university to comply with Title IX, the federal law prohibiting sex discrimination in education and governing how schools respond to allegations of sexual harassment and sexual assault. A federal judge later agreed that women suing the university over Title IX violations were entitled to “all materials, communications and information” given to the firm, ruling in 2017 that Baylor waived its attorney-client privilege with the firm by putting out the findings of fact and recommendations. Three years later, another federal judge ordered even more documents related to the investigation to be produced. Universities hiring law firms to conduct investigations start with attorney-client privilege protections, but the release of any facts and conclusions can erode that protection. "Think of it as a door," Nancy Rapoport, a legal ethics professor at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, said in an email. "If no one opens the door, nothing can get out. If someone cracks open the door, lots of stuff can get out." In an earlier high-profile case, former FBI Director Louis Freeh’s 267-page report in 2012 finding Penn State officials covered up child sex abuse by assistant football coach Jerry Sandusky was [USN:620120712 TEXT:"widely viewed at the time"] as increasing the university’s liability. Attorneys called it a “road map” for civil claims, and judges later ordered the release of report materials. BROAD MANDATE In hiring Yates, Cornell chose a lawyer with experience handling investigations in both the government and private practice. Yates served as deputy US attorney general under former President Barack Obama and conducted a review for US Soccer into allegations of abusive behavior and sexual misconduct in women's soccer. Unlike some universities, US Soccer made public King & Spalding's full report, withholding only limited details to protect victims' confidentiality. Yates and a firm spokeswoman didn't respond to requests for comment. King & Spalding's mandate in the Cornell matter is broad, including an examination of how the university [USN:L1N45T0PE TEXT:"handles reports of sexual harassment or assault"], how students are supported, the role of campus police and other law-enforcement agencies and oversight of the Greek life system. Her team will also look at how the university responded to the 2024 incident of a Jane Doe alleging she was plied with drugs and alcohol, then sexually assaulted by members of a fraternity. Cornell President Michael Kotlikoff on Tuesday announced immediate changes to campus policies, including banning fraternity parties this academic year, noting that the university can't wait for Yates' work to be done before taking action. Doe [USN:L6N45Q051 TEXT:"filed a civil lawsuit last month"] against the university, seven fraternity members and other defendants. New York Governor Kathy Hochul then named the state's attorney general, Letitia James, to oversee a [USN:L1N45O00M TEXT:"reopened criminal investigation"]. The men have all [USN:L1N45U11G TEXT:"denied wrongdoing"], with some saying the sexual activity was consensual, while others disputed their participation. “It is imperative that Cornell be willing to examine itself with the same rigor we expect of others,” said Anne Meinig Smalling, chair of the board's special committee, which said the work will be done “as expeditiously and thoroughly as possible” without committing to a timeline. For Cornell, hiring Yates was the easy part. Deciding how much of her work to disclose could prove more difficult.

item.title: サウジアラムコ管理棟に攻撃、小規模火災 リヤドでもミサイル迎撃
item.description:
Timour Azhari Menna AlaaElDin
[リヤド １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Menna AlaaElDin

[リヤド　１３日　ロイター] - サウジアラビアのエネルギー省は１４日、東部ダーランにある国有石油会社サウジアラムコの管理棟が１３日夜に攻撃を受け、小規模な火災が発生したと発表した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジの戦闘が激化している。

同省によると、死傷者は出ていない。

これに先立ち、アラムコの関係者はダーランにある本社施設に弾道ミサイルが着弾したとロイターに説明。オフィス棟が被弾し、上層３階が損傷したと述べていた。複数の関係者は、建物で火災が発生したと述べた。

本社施設には、陸上・海上の石油掘削設備やパイプライン、製油所、輸出ターミナルからなる広大なネットワークを統括する主要な操業管理センターがある。

サウジ主導の連合軍は、ダーランで迎撃・撃破したミサイルの破片が住宅地に落下したと発表したが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

当局は首都リヤドと南部でもドローン（無人機）とミサイルを迎撃・破壊したと発表した。

民間防衛当局が１４日明らかにしたところによると、リヤドでフーシ派のミサイル２発を迎撃・撃破した後、破片が落下し、４人が負傷した。住宅１５棟に軽微な被害が出たという。

フーシ派は、サウジ主導の連合軍によるイエメンの首都サヌアへの攻撃に対し、「厳しく痛みを伴う」対応を取ると警告し、ダーランのアラムコ本社やリヤドの製油所が標的になる可能性があると述べていた。

item.title: DOJ arrests two, seizes 187 devices in North Korean laptop farm crackdown in Texas
item.description: The US Department of Justice on Tuesday announced the arrests of two Americans accused of helping North Korean IT workers to steal identities and obtain fraudulent employment at US companies to earn money for the North Korean government.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: The US Department of Justice on Tuesday announced the arrests of two Americans accused of helping North Korean IT workers to steal identities and obtain fraudulent employment at US companies to earn money for the North Korean government. The agency announced the arrests of Michael James Bostelle, of Pennsylvania, and Juan Cecilio Pena Carrillo, of Texas, on charges of wire fraud, money laundering and identity theft as part of the alleged scheme, the DOJ said in a statement . As part of the crackdown, the DOJ announced that the FBI conducted searches and took other action between September 21 and September 25 at more than 40 residences in Texas thought to be operating as “laptop farms” for North Korean IT workers, the DOJ said. The FBI seized roughly 187 laptops and other devices used to carry out the scheme. The indictment also charged Sun Sheng Ming, Pei Li Guang, Weng Shou Cheng, Han Guo Bin, Wang Jian Jun, Sheng Zhang Kun, Zhang Wei Ping, Zhang Li Ping, Yu Yang and Jin Long, all based in China, for their roles in the operation, according to the statement. According to an indictment unsealed on Tuesday, the Chinese-based operators directed Pena and Tey Michael Nolte, along with at least four other Americans, in the scheme. Nolte was named in the indictment but not charged. Nolte and attorneys for Pena and Bostelle could not immediately be reached for comment. Emails sent to addresses that the DOJ alleged were used by the Chinese-based participants went unanswered. Nolte allegedly recruited, managed and trained Bostelle and other Americans, who allowed their names and personal information to be used to permit the North Korea-directed operation to function, in exchange for proceeds from the scheme, the DOJ said. The Americans’ actions included receiving and hosting laptops belonging to US victim companies at their homes, to make it appear as if the North Koreans were legitimate employees operating in the US. The “massive” fraud impacted more than 70 U. companies, compromised the identities of 25 Americans, caused false information to be sent to multiple US government agencies, and generated at least $3 million in revenue for the overseas IT workers, the DOJ said. The US government has for years warned of North Koreans surreptitiously gaining employment at US companies to raise money for the North Korean government, access company networks and steal data.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（13日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
まちまちで取引を終えた。英国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）や米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）などの発表を控える中...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（13日） 3:54 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。英国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）や米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）などの発表を控える中、様子見姿勢が広がった。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反落。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．０５％高。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は１．３９％、鉱業株指数は１．７１％、それぞれ下落。銅大手アントファガスタは５．６％値下がりした。

ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）は４．７％安。金融データプロバイダーの買収に向けて協議していることを認めた。

石油大手のＢＰは３．７％高。２０２６年７─９月期の精製マージンが前年同期比で約３倍に拡大したとの推計を示し、買われた。

メルローズ・インダストリーズは３．５％高。広告大手ＷＰＰは４．２％高。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は、英国に対して財政赤字縮小を着実に進める必要があると指摘した。ただ、市場からは、今月２８日に発表を予定する英予算案について、増税措置などが限定的なものにとどまるとの見方が出ている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

３営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。ハイテク関連株が売られた。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数とフランスのＣＡＣ４０指数はいずれも０．０７％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は１．６０％下落。中国の長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）の半導体設計を巡る報道を受け、競争激化に伴う業績への懸念が高まった。オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭインターナショナルは６．３％、フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは６．０％それぞれ下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．７３％安。

一部事業の売却で合意したフィンランドの通信機器大手ノキアは３．１％安だった。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は０．６１％下落した。直近四半期の売上高が市場予想を下回ったフランスの高級ブランドＬＶＭＨ（モエ・ヘネシー・ルイ・ヴィトン）は０．１％安。中国での購買意欲が低下したことが響いた。

一方、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種化学株指数は２．０２％高だった。

直近四半期の販売が好調だったスイスの香料・香味メーカーのジボダンは９．４％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

長期債を中心に国債利回りが低下した。ハイテク株の下落を受け、安全資産である国債に資金が流入した。米国債の動きにも追随した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは、終盤に１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の３．４６％。一時は３．４２６％まで低下した。２年債利回りは３．１２５％とほぼ横ばいだった。

債券市場の混乱はここ数営業日でやや和らいだものの、相場はなお不安定だ。９月下旬から１０月上旬にかけての売りで、独１０年債利回りは２００９年以来の高水準となる３．６５％まで上昇していた。

１３日はハイテク株への警戒感が再燃し、典型的な安全資産への逃避として債券に資金が流入した。ナスダック１００先物は０．７％下落した。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルのアナリストはリポートで「米国債と独国債の買い戻しの動きは、リスク資産や半導体株の小幅な変調を受けたものだ。ただ、１４日の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）発表を控えたポジション調整が、買いの勢いをある程度抑えるだろう」とした。

幅広い市場で債券利回りは低下した。指標となる米１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ低下の５．２２％。フランス１０年債利回りは６ｂｐ低下の４．８４％、イタリア１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ低下の４．５５％となった。

仏独国債の利回り格差は、終盤時点で１３８ｂｐ。１０月上旬に付けた約１６０ｂｐという１４年ぶりの高水準を下回った。

イタリア１０年債利回りはフランス１０年債利回りを約３０ｂｐ下回った。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、この差は少なくとも１９９０年代初め以降で最大の水準付近にある。

これは投資家の懸念が特にフランス国債に集中し、ユーロ圏の他国に混乱が広がるとの警戒感がひとまず和らいでいることを示している。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: Berlin coalition talks suspended over antisemitism deal concerns
item.description: Germany's Greens and centre-left Social Democrats (SPD) suspended exploratory talks on forming Berlin's next state government with the far-left Left Party on Tuesday to assess whether antisemitism measures agreed to last week still stand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Germany's Greens and centre-left Social Democrats (SPD) suspended exploratory talks on forming Berlin's next state government with the far-left Left Party on Tuesday to assess whether antisemitism measures [USN:L6N45U0H5 TEXT:"agreed to last week"] still stand. The proposed measures would allow lawmakers accused of antisemitism to be expelled if a panel came to a consensus on the matter. If they disagreed, experts would be called in. The decision comes after the Left admitted lawmaker Vanessa Emde, who has sparked controversy over her stance on Israel, as part of the state of Berlin's new parliamentary group. "We expect the Left to clarify the extent to which they intend to take the agreements we made seriously and implement them," the two parties said in a joint statement after the Left held a constituent meeting. The Left, a hard-left party represented in Berlin by lead candidate Elif Eralp, emerged from the September 20 state election as the largest force, with 25.7% of the votes. Left leader Luigi Pantisano said he was confident that talks could continue, adding that all elected representatives had signed a declaration committing themselves to the fight against antisemitism at their meeting on Tuesday. Tensions over antisemitism and the Israel-Gaza conflict have become a major fault line in German politics, with the SPD and Greens insisting on binding safeguards before entering exploratory coalition talks with the Left.

item.title: Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro reverses course, backs end to six-day workweek
item.description: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro on Tuesday said he would back a popular labor reform to reduce the country's workweek, reversing his position in a bid to avoid handing a political win to President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, his leftist opponent in Brazil's presidential elections.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Cardoso
item.content:encoded: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro on Tuesday said he would back a popular labor reform to reduce the country's workweek, reversing his position in a bid to avoid handing a political win to President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, his leftist opponent in Brazil's presidential elections. The measure, approved by [USN:L1N4230Q1 TEXT:"Brazil's lower house"] in May as a constitutional amendment, would lower working hours in Latin America's largest economy to 40 hours a week from 44, effectively ending a common practice in some sectors, like retail, of requiring employees to work six days a week. Bolsonaro, the son of former right-wing President Jair Bolsonaro, defied pollsters at the start of the month to lead President Lula in the first round of Brazil's election by securing 47% of votes cast. The two men will face each other in a runoff on October 25. Cutting the workweek would mark the biggest overhaul in Brazilian labor rights in decades and a nationwide poll conducted by Quaest in July found nearly 70% of Brazilians support the change. While the senator and his Liberal Party, PL, had long opposed cutting the workweek, arguing the move was designed to boost Lula's reelection prospects, Bolsonaro changed course on Tuesday, just a day before the Senate was expected to vote on the matter. "Most Brazilian workers want to see the end of the six-day workweek, so I'm going to vote in favor of ending it," Bolsonaro told journalists, adding that the government would need to offset impacts on business. Lawmakers aligned with Lula have pushed for a Senate vote before the runoff, hoping to secure approval while the president remains in office. "It seems to me that, following public pressure and street protests, PL decided to vote in favor of ending the six-day workweek," Lula said during an official event on Tuesday. The PL has yet to formally announce a change to its position. "Despite Flavio's lead, the race is still wide open. So it's a smart move by him in avoiding wearing down support on an issue that has broad popular appeal," Leandro Gabiati, director at political consultancy Dominium, said. While business groups say the measure could increase costs and hurt competitiveness, they will not be left too disappointed by Flavio's decision, Gabiati said. "The business community still has many ideological and practical reservations about this government," he said. "It will not feel betrayed by Flavio's change."

item.title: AI limiting European workers' bargaining power, ECB's Lane says

FAST

FRANKFURT, Oct 13 : The increased use of AI by euro zone companies could curb workers' ability to demand higher wages while heavy investment into the new technology may be materially tightening financing conditions, ECB chief economist Philip Lane said on Tuesday. With inflation now running at nearly twice the ECB's 2 per cent target on expensive energy, policymakers are searching for signs of second-round price effects, but have so far concluded there are none, especially in wage growth. While AI has not changed employment trends, hiring plans are muted and this limits workers' ability to demand compensation for high inflation, Lane said, offering a potential explanation for why wage growth is slowing, despite high inflation. "The potential for AI to replace some types of workers may also weaken the bargaining power of workers, moderating wage growth and reducing the labour share in total income," Lane said in a speech in Dublin.

While Lane did not directly discuss current monetary policy, he said that companies around the globe are borrowing so heavily to fund AI that this is pushing up borrowing costs for everyone and tightening financing conditions by a rate that is now relevant for ECB policy. "The spillover to the euro area bond market means that the increase in long-term interest rates constitutes a material tightening of financial conditions for the euro area," Lane said. "This is a relevant factor for the ECB in determining the appropriate monetary policy stance." The comments are significant since the ECB has been raising interest rates to prevent inflation from getting embedded and tighter overall financing conditions could mean the ECB may need to do less to tame price growth, some economists say. AI could also have a relevant impact for the economy over the longer term, raising potential output and trend growth, which would increase the economy's potential 'speed limit,' Lane said. "For Europe, the potential for AI to offset the economic impact of the projected trend decline in the working-age population is especially valuable," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 台湾、欧州の中国依存リスク警告 外交部長「自由や主権の脅威に」
item.description: [ワルシャワ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワルシャワ　１３日　ロイター] - 台湾の林佳龍外交部長（外相）は１３日、訪問先のポーランドで演説し、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が中国によるサプライチェーン（供給網）を通じた支配にさらされないよう促した。「中国の権威主義的イデオロギーは、欧州の民主主義とは相いれない。中国への依存は単なる経済的リスクにとどまらず、欧州の自由や主権にとって脅威となる」と警告した。

１５日に開幕するＥＵ首脳会議では、中国への対応も協議される。ＥＵは対中貿易赤字の縮小のほか、重点分野での中国依存の軽減を目指している。

林氏はワルシャワ・セキュリティー・フォーラムで「台湾と欧州は、民主主義や自由、人権、法の支配という重要な価値観を共有している」と述べ、台湾との貿易拡大が欧州にとっても有益だと主張した。

台湾は、２０２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻以降、欧州との関係強化を目指している。ポーランドは台湾との正式な外交関係はないものの、林氏は外交部長に就任して以降、数回にわたり欧州を訪問している。一方、中国は、台湾当局者が海外を訪問することに非難を繰り返している。

item.title: トルコ大統領、サウジ支持継続を表明 フーシ派攻撃受け
item.description: [アンカラ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ １３日 ロイター] - トルコのエルドアン大統領は１３日、サウジアラビアのムハンマド皇太子と電話会談を行い、 イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が続く中、引き続きサウジアラビアを支持していく方針を伝えた。

トルコ大統領府によると、エルドアン氏はフーシ派による攻撃を強く非難した上で、ムハンマド皇太子に対し、「この試練は乗り越えられると信じている」と述べた。

北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）に加盟するトルコ、核保有国のパキスタン、サウジの３カ国は８月にメッカ共同防衛協定に署名。同協定は集団的抑止力の強化を目的としており、署名国のいずれか１カ国に対する攻撃は３カ国全てに対する攻撃と見なすと定めている。

item.title: 来年は米追加利上げ不要、インフレ鈍化見込む─ＮＹ連銀総裁＝報道
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は、年内にあと１回の利上げが適切との見方を依然として維持...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
来年は米追加利上げ不要、インフレ鈍化見込む─ＮＹ連銀総裁＝報道 3:32 配信

米ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁。2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

[１３日　ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は、年内にあと１回の利上げが適切との見方を依然として維持しているものの、現時点で連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２０２７年に再び利上げする必要があるとは考えていないと述べた。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが１３日に伝えた。

ウィリアムズ総裁はインタビューで、「あと１回の利上げが適切との私の見方は変わっていない」と述べ、年内の追加利上げを支持する姿勢を示した。２７年については「現時点でこれ以上の対応が必要と考える理由はない」と言及。データ次第で見通しが変わる可能性に含みを残し、「来年については様子を見守る必要がある。まだ１０月中旬だ。米経済はさまざまな要因の影響を受けており、われわれはデータを注視し続けなければならない」と語った。

また同総裁は、インフレ率は時間をかけてＦＲＢの目標である２％に向かって鈍化していくと予想していると述べた。ただ、短期的なインフレ圧力は中東での戦争に伴うエネルギー価格の高騰の影響を受けていると指摘。ハイテク部門への投資もインフレ押し上げ要因になっているとの見方を示した。

「依然としてディスインフレの力が働いていると信じている」とした上で、「来年はインフレがかなり鈍化し、通年でみれば、全体のインフレ率は目標の２％近辺になるとみている。これは私が言及した要因、すなわち関税の影響が完全に過去のものとなることを反映している」と語った。

さらに、「来年以降はエネルギー価格がインフレを押し上げることはないと引き続き考えている」とした上で、米国経済は全体として過熱している状況ではないと述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 10/14(水) 4:56 ロイター

item.title: トランプ氏、フーシ派が米中間選挙前に原油価格つり上げと非難
item.description:
Jacob Bogage
[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１３日、米国とイランの戦争を受けて中東地域の紛争が拡大する中、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が１１月の米中間選挙を前に意図的に原油価格をつり上げようとしていると非難した。また、サウジアラビアに対するフーシ派の攻撃を「決して忘れない」と警告した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「フーシ派は非常に悪い振る舞いをしている」と非難。昨年の米国によるイエメン空爆後、比較的平穏な時期が続いていたものの、同派はイランの指示を受けて攻撃を再開したと主張した。

さらに、自身の警告は１１月３日の中間選挙後も続くとの考えを明確にし、「選挙後も私はそこにいるし、決して忘れない！」と述べた。

トランプ氏はこれに先立ち記者団に対し、サウジの国益を守るため、トルコのエルドアン大統領に介入を要請する「可能性がある」とし、「エルドアン大統領は私の要請に応じてくれると思う」と述べていた。

フーシ派はここ数日で、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドにあるキング・ハーリド国際空港を攻撃し、１３人が死亡、３００人以上が負傷したほか、リヤド上空の空域が閉鎖された。

item.title: Edison drops as Muddy Waters alleges willful misconduct in Eaton Fire case
item.description: Edison International shares fell over 3% on Tuesday after short seller Muddy Waters said it had uncovered new information suggesting the utility acted with "conscious" or "willful" disregard in the Eaton Fire.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Edison International (EIX.N) shares fell over 3% on Tuesday after short seller Muddy Waters said it had uncovered new information suggesting the utility acted with "conscious" or "willful" disregard in the Eaton Fire. The investment firm said Edison could face at least $4 billion in fire-related damages, with potential liability reaching about $20 billion if a court determines the firm's conduct amounted to willful misconduct. Here are more details: Muddy Waters said the utility's Southern California Edison unit failed to fix deficiencies in a wildfire risk model despite allegedly knowing for about five years that it could not adequately account for high-wind conditions. The unit faces multiple [USN:L1N3UR0PG TEXT:"lawsuits"] alleging its electrical equipment [USN:L1N4410ZS TEXT:"started"] the Eaton Fire, which ignited on January 7, 2025, in the Los Angeles area. Edison has previously said it is cooperating with investigations into the cause of the fire and denied negligence or wrongdoing. Muddy Waters said the utility's failure to address the modeling issues increased wildfire risks during extreme wind events and was a factor in its assessment of the company's potential exposure. Edison International did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 13 : More than two dozen lawmakers asked the Federal Aviation Administration to pause the use of a new AI tool in the Washington area to assist air traffic controllers, citing safety concerns. The lawmakers, including Democratic Representatives April Delaney, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Don Beyer, said in a letter they were concerned with the FAA pilot project "as we have not seen any safety evaluation and testing reports, nor have we been made aware of any efforts to train aviation safety personnel on how best to use the tool." The letter seeks an answer by Oct. 19. "Air traffic control leaves zero margin for error," Ocasio-Cortez said Tuesday, calling for the pause. The FAA last month began using a new software-based AI tool system that uses predictive analytics to improve how flights are managed.

"We are deeply concerned about the integration of any AI-enabled system into air traffic control systems, where decisions are literally a matter of life or death," said the letter that was also signed by Senator Chris Van Hollen and Representatives Jamie Raskin, Raja Krishnamoorthi and Kweisi Mfume. The FAA in June awarded an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence for a system dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories or SMART, which uses data to analyze airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The FAA is initially using the AI tool in the airspace around Washington, D.C. and plans to gradually expand it to other parts of the country. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Tuesday called the tool essentially "dumb AI" and emphasized controllers remain in charge - not the software. "Air traffic controllers will always control the airspace. This is just giving additional tools for controllers to better manage" weather and other issues," Duffy said on Fox Business' "Big Money in the Morning." The system uses over 200 data streams, creates data visualizations, and produces scheduling recommendations for operations experts to consider passing along but does not involve active management of planes in the sky, USDOT said. "It's going to be transformational," FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford told Reuters earlier. "We'll make much better decisions if we have better decision-making tools." The plan is to initially use it to more effectively reschedule flights that were canceled due to bad weather with plans to expand to other tasks such as strategically coordinating schedules and trajectories before aircraft depart.

Source: Reuters
