item.title: Saudi Arabia plans hybrid format for marquee FII conference after attacks, sources say
item.description: Saudi Arabia plans to make its flagship investment conference a hybrid event, giving executives the option to tune in remotely, after deadly weekend attacks on Riyadh airport prompted a rethink of travel to the kingdom, said two people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia plans to make its flagship investment conference a hybrid event, giving executives the option to tune in remotely, after deadly [USN:L6N45Y0C1 TEXT:"weekend attacks on Riyadh airport"] prompted a rethink of travel to the kingdom, said two people familiar with the matter. Some participants were still expected to fly in and could land at airstrips outside Riyadh, or even in neighbouring Gulf states, and then drive to the capital to attend the Future Investment Initiative scheduled for later this month, said one of the people. The Saudi government media office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Earlier this month organisers [USN:L8N45W01K TEXT:"said the event would go ahead"] despite missile attacks in the kingdom. Asked for comment, an FII media representative pointed Reuters to a statement from the CEO and chairman of the FII Institute sent before Saturday's attacks. "As we prepare to welcome thousands of delegates to Riyadh for the exceptional 10th edition of the Future Investment Initiative, their safety and well-being remain our highest priority," said CEO Maha Al Saud and Richard Attias, chairman of the executive committee. 'DAVOS IN THE DESERT' Major oil bosses [USN:L6N45Y0GT TEXT:"dropped out of an international conference"] on Monday and a hybrid model would allow for more participants to take part. The move shows how Saudi Arabia is trying to maintain its push to attract global investment despite an [USN:L1N45Z0HH TEXT:"escalating war with the Houthis"] that has challenged its efforts to turn Riyadh into a hub for global events. The kingdom has used the FII to showcase its plans to diversify its economy from oil and attract foreign investments. The typical attendance of a large number of world leaders, corporate chieftains and financiers has led the event to be nicknamed "Davos in the desert," in a nod to the World Economic Forum's annual meeting in Switzerland. Global financial titans, including Goldman Sachs (GS.N) CEO and Chairman David Solomon, Standard Chartered (STAN.L) CEO Bill Winters and Citi's CEO Jane Fraser, were scheduled to participate as speakers at the event, according to a draft programme on the FII website dated October 6. Citi (C.N) and Goldman Sachs declined to comment on the executives' attendance, while Standard Chartered had no immediate comment. The FII event, in its 10th edition, is due to be held at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Centre, on the western edge of Riyadh.

item.title: Delaware jury awards Qualcomm $2 in damages, finds Arm breached license agreement
item.description: Chip technology supplier Arm Holdings breached a licensing agreement with Qualcomm and intentionally interfered with the chipmaker's business relationship with Meta Platforms , a Delaware jury found on Tuesday, but awarded nominal damages of just $2.
item.dc:creator: Tom Hals
item.content:encoded: Chip technology supplier Arm Holdings (O9Ty.F) breached a licensing agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM.O) and intentionally interfered with the chipmaker's business relationship with Meta Platforms (META.O) , a Delaware jury found on Tuesday, but awarded nominal damages of just $2. The verdict followed a five-day trial last week, the second in two years between the companies, that highlighted the deterioration of their business relationship after SoftBank Group (9984.T) acquired control of Arm in 2016 and Arm shifted from licensing the technology needed to make chips to selling chips of its own. Shares of Arm were down 1% following the verdict, while shares of Qualcomm rose 1%, although its stock was down slightly from gains of around 2.4% before the verdict. Both companies welcomed aspects of the verdict, which leaves some key issues unresolved. "We are gratified that the jury found Arm breached its long-standing Architectural License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm, failed to honor its commitments, and intentionally acted to disrupt Qualcomm's businesses," Qualcomm said in a statement. Arm said that "despite Qualcomm’s pursuit of this case in an attempt to deprive Arm of billions of dollars under our license agreements, the jury’s verdict confirms that Arm operated in good faith under its technology license agreement and its award of only two dollars confirms the merit of Arm’s arguments in the case." The jury found Arm breached its obligation to provide software patches and tools for its designs. The jury found for Arm on five other breach allegations. The jury also found that Arm intentionally and negligently interfered with Qualcomm's relations with Meta. Qualcomm claimed it had been on the cusp of a deal with Meta in 2024 when Arm allegedly leaked to Bloomberg News that Qualcomm had breached a licensing agreement, delaying the Meta agreement. While the jury awarded a nominal $1 for each of those claims, the findings also keep open Qualcomm's claims ahead of the lawsuit's next phase, in which US District Judge Maryellen Noreika must resolve several disputes. The breach finding leaves open the possibility that Noreika could rule that as a result, Qualcomm can stop paying royalties to Arm for five years, potentially worth billions of dollars. Arm has argued the five-year royalty penalty, which is contained in a clause in the licensing agreement, is unenforceable. The business interference finding by the jury could be used by Qualcomm to support its narrative that Arm refused to negotiate in good faith for Arm's next version of its technology, which the judge also must resolve. The losing side in those decisions would likely appeal.

item.title: UK regulator FCA to publish whistleblower review in early 2027
item.description: Britain's markets regulator plans to publish a report early next year into whether it could have done more in its interactions with a whistleblower, the Financial Conduct Authority said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's markets regulator plans to publish a report early next year into whether it could have done more in its interactions with a whistleblower, the Financial Conduct Authority said on Tuesday. • FCA Chief Executive Nikhil Rathi told lawmakers the death of Simon Andriesz last month was "terribly sad" and that it was important for the regulator to reflect on how it communicated and engaged with whistleblowers. • The FCA had been in contact with Andriesz over many years and his death sparked questions by lawmakers about whether it took his allegations sufficiently seriously. • Andriesz died by suicide last month. John Robertson, one of his representatives, has said he had been recognised as a whistleblower in the US but did not feel he received the same level of engagement from British authorities. • The cross-party Treasury Committee asked whether the FCA had considered asking an external expert to review the case. Rathi said that Lea Paterson, who joined the FCA's board this month, would launch the review as an independent non-executive. • Paterson is expected to examine whether there were things the FCA could have done better and help the organisation learn for the future. • The FCA has said the number of whistleblowing reports rose by 22% last year. Around 42% led to direct action and another 53% informed its wider work and supported harm prevention.

item.title: EPA proposes full reallocation of refinery biofuel exemptions
item.description: The US Environmental Protection Agency proposed on Tuesday to make larger refiners blend more biofuels into their products over the next two years, a move that will likely appeal to farm-state voters ahead of November's congressional elections.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: The US Environmental Protection Agency proposed on Tuesday to make larger refiners blend more biofuels into their products over the next two years, a move that will likely appeal to farm-state voters ahead of November's congressional elections. The proposal would help offset concerns about lost demand for ethanol producers and farmers after the EPA announced in August it would waive renewable fuel volume obligations for 29 [USN:L1N44S0OE TEXT:"small refineries"] that argued the requirements would cause economic hardship. The EPA proposed reallocating 100% of those waived fuel volume obligations and is seeking public comment after putting forward two approaches. One would split the additional 2025 small refinery exemption volume evenly between the 2026 and 2027 compliance years, while the other would allocate all of it to 2027. Comments are due by December 4, 2026, the EPA said in a statement. Renewable credit prices for biodiesel and ethanol fell slightly on the news, according to a refinery trader at the OPIS biofuels conference in Chicago. The EPA in August decided to grant [USN:L1N44S0OE TEXT:"1.76 billion RINs"] worth of small refinery exemptions for the 2025 compliance year, including full exemptions for 18 refineries and partial waivers for 11 others. At the time, the agency said it would seek to reallocate the exempted volumes to other refiners in future years to preserve overall biofuel blending requirements. The exemptions, the [USN:L1N40F0R6 TEXT:"largest ever issued"] under the Renewable Fuel Standard, drew sharp criticism from biofuel producers and farm groups, which argued they would reduce demand for ethanol and biodiesel and undermine markets for agricultural feedstocks. Refiners said compliance costs and elevated RIN prices justified relief for facilities facing economic hardship. "While we believe most of the exemptions were unjustified, EPA's reallocation plan, if finalized as proposed, will help offset the demand loss for ethanol producers and farmers," said Geoff Cooper, CEO of the Renewable Fuels Association, which represents ethanol producers. The EPA also said reallocating the waived obligations could require extending the 2026 compliance year deadline of March 31, 2027.

item.title: US Supreme Court rejects attorney sanctions appeal in Arizona elections case
item.description: The US Supreme Court on Tuesday declined to hear an appeal by lawyers who were sanctioned over a lawsuit they brought challenging Arizona's voting machines in the run-up to the state's 2022 midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court on Tuesday declined to hear an appeal by lawyers who were sanctioned over a lawsuit they brought challenging Arizona's voting machines in the run-up to the state's 2022 midterm elections. Andrew Parker and his firm, Minneapolis-based Parker Daniels Kibort, were ordered to pay $122,000 after a judge found they made "baseless" claims in their lawsuit on behalf of Arizona gubernatorial candidate Kari Lake and former Arizona state representative Mark Finchem. Parker argued in his petition to the Supreme Court that the sanctions could chill lawyers' ability to assert unpopular or difficult claims. "The sanctions in this case have grave implications for our justice system and will deter attorneys from bringing creative, aggressive or novel claims of the sort that are often necessary to shape and reshape our legal landscape," the petition said. Parker and his attorney did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Parker's petition was opposed by the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors, whose members were named as defendants in the lawsuit. Thomas Liddy of the Maricopa County Attorney's Office said the justices had upheld ethical standards in turning away the appeal. "The First Amendment allows politicians to say whatever they want to voters to get votes. Lawyers are required by the ethical canons to speak to judges with only facts," Liddy said. "The Supreme Court by denying cert, upheld that standard." Lake and Finchem, Republicans who had sought statewide offices in the 2022 race, had alleged that the state's voting machines were rife with cybersecurity vulnerabilities and sought a court order requiring Arizonians to cast their votes on paper ballots that would be counted by hand. US District Judge John Tuchi dismissed the lawsuit before the 2022 election, and Lake and Finchem lost their races to their Democratic opponents. Tuchi had [USN:L1N3902LI TEXT:"held"] that the candidates' claims relied on "false, misleading, and unsupported factual assertions," and that Parker and his firm "acted at least recklessly in unreasonably and vexatiously multiplying the proceedings." The San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the sanctions in March 2025. The appeals court [USN:L1N3PX0VK TEXT:"overturned"] related sanctions against retired Harvard Law professor Alan Dershowitz, finding he had a limited role in the case. The Supreme Court on Tuesday declined to hear Parker's challenge to the sanctions without detailing its reasoning. The justices in April 2024 had declined to take up Lake and Finchem's appeal of the dismissal of their case.

item.title: In Yemen's Taiz, shelling worsens and prices spiral
item.description: With their city encircled by Houthi fighters, residents of Taiz say they face intensifying bombardment and dwindling supplies as the Iran-aligned group tightens its grip on surrounding areas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: With their city encircled by Houthi fighters, residents of Taiz say they face intensifying bombardment and dwindling supplies as the Iran-aligned group tightens its grip on surrounding areas. Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, has emerged as a major theatre of the [USN:L1N45Z0HH TEXT:"conflict between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government"], after their war was reignited last month by the U.S.-Iran confrontation in the Gulf. The Houthis cut off a main road from Taiz to Aden last week, leaving [USN:L1N45S0OS TEXT:"government forces encircled."] The International Organization for Migration (IOM) said the situation in Taiz had significantly deteriorated in recent days, and that people, basic supplies and humanitarian goods could not enter the city, driving up prices. Yemen's internationally recognised government [USN:L1N45Q02D TEXT:"launched a campaign"] last week to recapture areas controlled by the Houthis, recovering ground near the [USN:L1N45S0OS TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb Strait"], a global shipping artery. But the Houthis have kept up the pressure near Taiz, seizing the town of Mudiriyat al-Misrakh some 25 km (15 miles) south of the city on Monday, military sources said. Residents reported heavy shelling of Taiz city on Monday night. Government sources said the Houthis were to blame. A spokesperson for the Houthis did not immediately respond to a request for comment. "We lived a night of terror because of the continuous bombardment," said Ahmed Mahmoud, a resident reached by phone. "This morning there is calm and worry. The streets are empty." Yassine Muqbil, another Taiz resident contacted by phone, said there had been widespread shelling and his child was too afraid to go outside. Taiz city had an estimated population of almost 600,000, Katja Juric, IOM's Aden-based Head of Programmes, told Reuters. Government sources said 80,000 had fled in the latest fighting. INCREASING PRESSURE Military sources reported fighting in al-Dabab, 10 km (6 miles) from Taiz, and on Sabar Mountain, which overlooks the city to the south, saying government forces who had withdrawn from surrounding areas had regrouped in the city. Yemeni government warplanes targeted Houthi fighters and equipment in Dabab and Misrakh, government forces said in a statement on Tuesday. For the Houthis, seizing Taiz city would be a big boost 12 years since the war first erupted. It would leave oil-rich Marib as the last city under government control in northern Yemen. Mohammed Al-Qadhi, a political and conflict analyst, said Monday evening's heavy shelling and the “tight siege” imposed by Houthi fighters indicated increasing pressure on the city. "The Houthis know the value of Taiz governorate," he said, noting that its countryside overlooks the coastline and Bab el-Mandeb and that it had served as a bastion of "resistance against the Houthis and their ideology". The Yemen war erupted in 2014 when [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"the Houthis"] seized the capital Sanaa, driving the government south. Fearful of growing Iranian influence and chaos on its borders, Saudi Arabia led a military intervention against the Houthis in early 2015 to restore the government. The resulting civil war triggered one of the world's biggest humanitarian crises and led to years of fighting and devastating airstrikes by the Saudi-led coalition. The UN brokered a 2022 truce between the warring sides in Yemen that maintained peace until this year. 'CANNOT FIND FOOD' In Taiz city, prices of basic goods have shot up. "By God, we know families who cannot find their daily food," resident Nashwan Saad said on Sunday, adding that a sack of wheat had gone up by as much as some 40%. IOM's Juric said access to Taiz city had been "significantly constrained", noting that a small bottle of water now cost up to $4. "The prices of basic commodities that are still available in the city have gone up significantly," she said. "People are rushing to purchase and to stockpile basic commodities as they're anticipating a prolonged conflict and also further supply disruptions in the city." Abdulrahman al-Qulaia, director general of the Ministry of Industry and Trade Office in Taiz, cautioned against panic. "We appeal to the entire international community concerned with this matter, to humanitarian organisations and civil society organisations, to work seriously to provide these needs ... and lift the siege on the province."

item.title: トランプ氏「ウクライナと情報共有継続」、ロの停戦違反には言及せず
item.description:
Olena Harmash Daniel Flynn
[キーウ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olena Harmash　Daniel Flynn

[キーウ　１３日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１３日、ウクライナが事前の警告なしに行われたロシアによる新たなミサイル攻撃を報告し、ロシアのエネルギー停戦違反を非難したにもかかわらず、米国は依然としてウクライナと情報を共有していると述べた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシア軍が１３日に弾道ミサイルで首都キーウを攻撃し、エネルギー施設を標的にしたと明らかにした。キーウのクリチコ市長によると、高層集合住宅ビルへの攻撃により２人が死亡した。

ゼレンスキー氏はテレグラムで「今回もまた、パートナー国からの事前警告はなかった」と述べたが、なぜ警告が出されなかったのかについては説明しなかった。

「われわれの情報によると、ロシアはさらなる弾道ミサイルの発射を準備している」と指摘。「事実はロシア側が米大統領の発言を順守する義務を負っていないと考えていることを示している」と付け加えた。

一方、トランプ氏は、米国は引き続きウクライナと情報共有を行っており、ロシアとウクライナの戦争終結を望んでいると述べた。

記者団に対し「われわれはウクライナを支援しており、情報も共有している」とし、「戦争の終結を望んでいる。戦争を終わらせるためにウクライナともロシアとも協議を続けている」と語った。

ロシアが停戦に違反したかどうかを問われると、「それについては後で知らせる」と答えた。

＜軽油合意でも米国内の物価は下がらず＝ゼレンスキー氏＞

トランプ氏がロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）輸出に対する制裁を緩和した後、ゼレンスキー氏はロシアの石油精製所への攻撃を停止するようトランプ氏から圧力を受けている。

ゼレンスキー氏はＮＰＲとのインタビューで、トランプ氏への直接的な批判を慎重に避けつつ、ディーゼル制裁に関する決定が米国の物価に影響を与えることはないと指摘。「量が十分ではないためだ」と説明した上で、「しかし、ロシアが戦争により多くの資金を費やすには十分すぎるほどだ」と付け加えた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、１１日のトランプ氏の発表以降、ウクライナはロシアの製油所を標的にしていないと述べた。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は、依然として米国から軍事情報を提供されていると述べ、遅れはロシアが使用した兵器の種類に起因すると説明した。

item.title: 米債利回りに上昇余地、ＦＲＢあと1─2回利上げも＝ＰＩＭＣＯのＣＩＯ
item.description:
Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 世界最大の債券運用会社ＰＩ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米債利回りに上昇余地、ＦＲＢあと1─2回利上げも＝ＰＩＭＣＯのＣＩＯ 1:12 配信

Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss

[ニューヨーク １３日 ロイター] - 世界最大の債券運用会社ＰＩＭＣＯの最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ダニエル・アイバシン氏は１３日、米国債利回りには一段の上昇余地があるとの見方を示した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は現在の金融引き締めサイクルを終える前にあと１回か２回の利上げに踏み切る可能性が高いという。

アイバシン氏はグランツ秋季会議の合間に取材に応じ、ＦＲＢが今月下旬の会合では金利を据え置くと予想する一方、追加で１─２回の利上げの余地があるとの見方を提示。「ＦＲＢはひとまず金利を据え置き、２０２６年中におそらくもう１回利上げするだろう。現在の見通しを踏まえると、われわれはあと１─２回の引き締めを予想している」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：米国債の「ベーシス取引」、軟着陸は可能か 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 最終更新: 10/14(水) 1:12 ロイター

PARIS, Oct 13 : France's cybersecurity agency said on Tuesday that the refrigeration systems of Copeland and Dixell were also hacked during a cyberattack that targeted supermarket refrigerators and freezers. A spokesperson for Copeland, which owns Dixell, declined to confirm the information and said the company's top priority is to protect customers' operations. Hackers raised temperatures of refrigerators in hundreds of supermarkets to as high as 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit), causing fires and spoiling food.

Oct 13 : Alphabet's Google on Wednesday released its flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon to developers and businesses worldwide, seeking to regain ground against rivals OpenAI and Anthropic after months of delays and a leadership shakeup at its DeepMind lab.  The model excels at "deep work" on complex, multi-step tasks in coding, finance, law, cybersecurity and science, Google said. API pricing at launch starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with rates set to double after November 30.  The release follows a rocky stretch in Google's AI efforts. The company announced in September that it no longer planned to release Gemini 3.5 Pro, which CEO Sundar Pichai had originally said would be released in June. It also overhauled DeepMind after the AI lab's co-founder and CEO Demis Hassabis stepped aside and several leaders of its Gemini model left the company.

Argon is available to paying customers through the company's AI application building tools. Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can access it through the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, while the Antigravity coding tool is limited to Ultra subscribers. Teams using Argon in Antigravity increased agentic code submissions by more than 35 per cent, while reducing code rollbacks by nearly a third, Google said.   Customers testing the model early include Deloitte, LexisNexis, Ambience Healthcare and Isomorphic Labs. Meanwhile, Google said it would open its Fairwind Program to hundreds of additional partners. The program gives vetted cybersecurity defenders a version of Argon without its cyber guardrails. In September, the company had said it was providing the model to select cybersecurity partners. Separately, Google will offer 10,000 scientists six months of free access to Antigravity's highest usage tier.

item.title: ＯＰＥＣプラス産油量、9月は日量90万バレル増 サウジが出荷拡大
item.description:
Alex Lawler Olesya Astakhova
[ロンドン １３日] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alex Lawler　Olesya Astakhova

[ロンドン　１３日] - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）が１３日公表した月報によると、ＯＰＥＣ加盟国とロシアなど非加盟産油国で構成する「ＯＰＥＣプラス」の９月の産油量は日量平均３９０７万バレルで、８月から日量約９０万バレル増えた。ホルムズ海峡の混乱が続く中でも、サウジアラビアからの出荷が拡大した。ただ、今年２月末のイラン交戦開始前の水準は依然として下回っている。

湾岸地域からの供給は、ここ数週間回復傾向が見られる。サウジの９月の産油量は日量８３７万２０００バレルと、８月より２００万バレル超増えた。東西パイプラインへの攻撃で紅海経由の出荷が一時混乱した後、国有石油会社サウジアラムコが湾岸の輸出ターミナルからの積み出しを拡大した。一方、ウクライナによる製油所などへの攻撃を受けるロシアの生産量は日量３万８０００バレル減った。

ＯＰＥＣは、２０２６年の世界石油需要の見通しを日量１８万バレル増に引き下げた。６カ月連続の下方修正。一方、２７年は石油備蓄の放出分を補充する必要があるとして、前年比日量２５５万バレル増の日量平均１億８３０万バレルと予測した。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 13 : A US Senate committee report released on Tuesday said consultants who assist schools and libraries in winning funding from a $3 billion annual internet subsidy program receive between $200 million and $400 million annually. Senate Commerce Committee chair Ted Cruz said consultants help the applicants for the Federal Communications Commission E-Rate program "comply with a Byzantine process that has become a costly feature of the program."  He added that the high fees should "prompt greater scrutiny of how E-Rate funds move, who benefits and whether the program's current structure delivers value to schools, libraries and taxpayers." The FCC has been subsidizing connectivity to and within schools for almost 30 years.

The report found that some consultants charge school districts $100,000 or more per year. Milwaukee Public Schools has participated in E-Rate for more than two decades and has received more than $115 million in funding but is still paying more than $250,000 annually in consulting services, the report said. "The continued need for significant consultant support raises questions about the extent to which long-term participants remain dependent on outside expertise to navigate the program," the report said. The school district and the FCC did not immediately comment. The report added that the consultants are subject to limited oversight and cited a number of criminal cases in E-Rate fraud cases and recommended the FCC require public disclosure of consultant compensation associated with E-Rate and urged the commission to stop expansion of E-Rate until its vulnerabilities are addressed. In June, FCC Chair Brendan Carr said the commission was launching a comprehensive review of the E-Rate program, adding that it could reform the scheme or end it. The FCC is reviewing whether the program has fulfilled its mission and whether continued funding is consistent with Congress' objective. E-Rate is funded by fees paid by telecom companies that are collected from consumers through the "Universal Service Fee" on monthly phone bills.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Explosions en Arabie saoudite, les Houthis répondent aux frappes de Ryad au Yémen
item.description: De lourdes explosions ont retenti mardi soir près du siège de la compagnie pétrolière Saudi Aramco, pilier de l'économie saoudienne, ont rapporté six sources, dans un contexte d'escalade des hostilités entre l'Arabie saoudite et les Houthis, lesquels ont dit répondre à une attaque de Ryad contre la capitale yéménite Sanaa, qu'ils contrôlent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: De lourdes explosions ont retenti mardi soir près du siège de la compagnie pétrolière Saudi Aramco, pilier de l'économie saoudienne, ont rapporté six sources, dans un contexte d'escalade des hostilités entre l'Arabie saoudite et les Houthis, lesquels ont dit répondre à une attaque de Ryad contre la capitale yéménite Sanaa, qu'ils contrôlent. Aucun commentaire n'a été effectué dans l'immédiat par Saudi Aramco, principal groupe pétrolier au monde, détenu par l'Etat saoudien. Une source informée de la question a déclaré à Reuters que le siège de l'entreprise à Dhahran, dans l'est du pays, a été atteint, sans préciser dans l'immédiat si le bâtiment a été frappé directement ou touché par des débris. D'après une autre source, le siège d'Aramco était en feu. Ordre a été donné d'évacuer le bâtiment, ont dit quatre sources. Les autorités saoudiennes ont annoncé que des fragments d'un missile intercepté et détruit au-dessus de Dhahran avaient atterri contre une zone résidentielle, sans davantage de détails. Elles ont par ailleurs émis dans la soirée des alertes concernant plusieurs villes du royaume, faisant état de drones et de missiles détruits dans le ciel de la capitale Ryad. Ces explosions sont survenues après que les Houthis ont prévenu plus tôt dans la journée qu'ils répondraient à une attaque effectuée par l'Arabie saoudite contre un site situé en périphérie de Sanaa. Le mouvement armé aligné sur l'Iran contrôle la capitale du Yémen et de grandes parties du pays. OFFENSIVES ET CONTRE-OFFENSIVES La coalition militaire sous commandement saoudien, qui intervient au Yémen depuis 2015, a averti mardi matin les civils d'évacuer un site pétrolier à Sanaa et a confirmé ensuite avoir frappé ce site, qu'elle a décrit comme étant utilisé par les Houthis dans le cadre de leurs attaques au Yémen. Entre-temps, la chaîne de télévision Al-Massirah, contrôlée par les Houthis, a déclaré que la coalition dirigée par Ryad a frappé la station centrale de Sabah, qui appartient à la Compagnie pétrolière yéménite (YPC). YPC a déclaré qu'aucun produit pétrolier n'était alors stocké sur ce site et qu'il n'y avait aucun impact sur les réserves pétrolières ou les chaînes d'approvisionnement. Les Houthis avaient prévenu d'une réponse "douloureuse" à tout bombardement contre Sanaa. Un porte-parole du mouvement armé chiite a indiqué que les cibles pourraient inclure le siège de Saudi Aramco et une raffinerie de pétrole à Ryad, appelant les employés du secteur à rester à l'écart des sites pétroliers. Reprochant à l'Arabie saoudite de soutenir les forces gouvernementales yéménites, qui ont lancé ce mois-ci une "[USN:L8N45Q054 TEXT:"offensive d'envergure"]" afin de [USN:L8N45R15C TEXT:"reprendre Sanaa"] et d'autres zones, les Houthis ont ciblé lors de la semaine écoulée des aéroports du royaume wahhabite. Une frappe samedi contre [USN:L8N45Y0AW TEXT:"l'aéroport"] de la capitale saoudienne Ryad a tué 13 personnes, soit l'attaque la plus meurtrière en Arabie saoudite en dix ans. Cinq mois après le début de la guerre déclenchée par les bombardements des Etats-Unis et d'Israël en Iran, les Houthis avaient annoncé en juillet dernier un [USN:L6N43M0MM TEXT:"blocus maritime"] de l'Arabie saoudite et ont entrepris de [USN:L8N4520HR TEXT:"renforcer leur contrôle"] du détroit de [USN:L8N43T289 TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb"], en mer Rouge, voie cruciale - comme le détroit d'Ormuz - pour les livraisons énergétiques mondiales. Le mouvement chiite a effectué en septembre [USN:L8N4530M9 TEXT:"une avancée éclair"] le long du littoral du Yémen, prenant la ville de Mokha, dans le sud-ouest du pays. ENTRETIENS DE "MBS" AVEC ERDOGAN ET TRUMP Face aux progrès territoriaux des Houthis, la coalition militaire sous commandement saoudien est de nouveau venue en renfort du gouvernement yéménite reconnu par la communauté internationale. La trêve au Yémen instaurée en 2022, parfois fragile, a volé en éclats. Ryad cherche également à obtenir l'aide supplémentaire d'alliés pour sa campagne militaire face aux Houthis et pour repousser les attaques du mouvement chiite contre le royaume. Le président turc Recep Tayyip Erdogan a déclaré mardi au prince héritier saoudien Mohammed ben Salman, dit "MbS", qu'Ankara se tiendrait au côté de l'Arabie saoudite, ont rapporté ses services, sans donner de précisions sur un quelconque soutien spécifique. Turquie, Arabie saoudite et Pakistan ont signé durant l'été un pacte de défense mutuelle. Le Parlement turc ne l'a cependant pas encore ratifié. A Washington, Donald Trump a dit aux journalistes s'être entretenu dans la journée avec Mohammed ben Salman. Le président américain a reproché aux Houthis de se "comporter très mal". Il a ajouté qu'il pourrait demander à Recep Tayyip Erdogan d'intervenir pour protéger les intérêts de l'Arabie saoudite, dont les Etats-Unis sont un allié sécuritaire de longue date. L'administration Trump refuse toutefois, pour l'heure, de répondre favorablement à la demande de Ryad d'intervenir directement contre les Houthis, dans ce qui constitue un front supplémentaire au conflit entre les Etats-Unis et l'Iran. D'après le ministère iranien des Affaires étrangères, le chef de la diplomatie iranienne Abbas Araqchi a proposé dimanche que Téhéran serve de médiateur entre Ryad et les Houthis. L'Iran et l'Arabie saoudite sont de longue date des ennemis régionaux.

item.title: ＡＩ投資、経済全体の過熱招く恐れ─シカゴ連銀総裁＝報道
item.description: [１３日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１３日、インフレについて、自然に収束する供給ショックの副...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ投資、経済全体の過熱招く恐れ─シカゴ連銀総裁＝報道 0:46 配信

2026年8月27日、シカゴ連銀のグールズビー総裁。REUTERS/Ann Saphir/File Photo

[１３日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１３日、インフレについて、自然に収束する供給ショックの副産物が中心というよりも、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームの波及による「経済全体の過熱」の様相を呈し始めているとの見方を示した。

ニュースサイト「セマフォー」のインタビューで「経済全体の過熱のように感じられ始めている。ＡＩデータセンターのコスト上昇がその分野の枠を超え、データセンターの部品や直接関連する産業以外の分野でも価格が上がっている」と述べた。

「こうした動きがサービス全般にさらに広がり、設備投資によって国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の成長率が潜在成長率を上回り、インフレの波及を引き起こすようになれば問題だ。供給ショックは比較的短期間で自然に収束すると考えがちだが、需要の過熱についてそう考える人はいない」と語った。

また「需要の過熱が本格化するには長い時間がかかるが、いったん本格化すると解消するのは難しい」と指摘。「だからこそ、需要の過熱が見られたら、断固として迅速に行動するというのが通説になっている。インフレ期待に波及し、インフレはいつまでも収まらないと人々が当然視するようになるのを防ぐためだ」と述べた。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げを続けるべきかとの質問に対し、グールズビー氏は「インフレが根強く続くなら、ＦＲＢが何をすべきかは明らかだと思う。関税によるインフレや原油ショックによるインフレが収まりつつあるという証拠が得られればよい。必要なのは大幅な改善ではないが、以前のような利下げ路線に戻るには、何らかの改善が見え始める必要がある」と述べた。

グールズビー氏は２０２６年の金融政策決定で投票権を持たない。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/14(水) 0:46 ロイター

item.title: 米シティ、第3四半期利益は予想上回る 投資銀行・ウェルス部門が寄与
item.description:
Tatiana Bautzer Prakhar Srivastava
[１３日 ロイター] - 米金融大手シティグルー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米シティ、第3四半期利益は予想上回る　投資銀行・ウェルス部門が寄与 0:41 配信

米シティのロゴ。2025年12月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Tatiana Bautzer　Prakhar Srivastava

[１３日　ロイター] - 米金融大手シティグループが１３日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（７─９月期）決算は利益が予想を上回った。投資銀行部門の収入や多国籍企業向け取引の増加、ウェルスマネジメント（富裕層向け資産運用）部門の収益拡大に支えられた。

第３・四半期の利益は５２億５０００万ドル、１株当たり利益は２．８５ドルだった。前年同期はそれぞれ３８億ドル、１．８６ドルだった。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は２．６６ドルだった。

ジェーン・フレーザー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「短期目標である１１─１３％に向けて投資を前倒ししているにもかかわらず、当社は今年の収益目標を上回ると見込んでいる。この短期目標は、１４─１５％の持続可能な収益率達成に向けた次の節目だ」と述べた。

投資銀行部門の収入は前年同期比９％増の１３億５０００万ドル。一方、株式・債券の引き受け業務の減速で前期比では１３％減少した。

法人向け融資を含む銀行部門全体の収入は６％増の１７億４０００万ドルだった。株式引き受け収入は前期比で１９％減少したものの、前年同期比では７７％増となった。

ザックス・インベストメント・マネジメントのチーフマーケットストラテジスト、ブライアン・マルベリー氏は「高金利と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ継続の可能性が、トレーディングや投資銀行業務に明らかにマイナスの影響を及ぼしていることは間違いない」と指摘。その上で「ただ、シティが複数の事業部門からプラスの成長を引き出していることが、現在のバランスシートの強みだ。サービス、ウェルスマネジメント、堅調な純金利収入（ＮＩＩ）の成長が、トレーディングの短期的な軟調さを相殺し、２０２７年にかけて有形自己資本利益率（ＲＯＴＣＥ）が目標の１１％以上を維持し続ける支えとなる」と述べた。

第３・四半期のＲＯＴＣＥは１１．５％、年初来では１２．６％と、目標の１１％を上回った。

トレーディング部門の利益は前年同期比で２％の増加にとどまり、前期比では株式トレーディング収入の減少を主因に２７％減少した。

一方、トレーディング部門の収入ベースでは前年同期比６％増の６１億１０００万ドルとなった。株式トレーディング収入が１４％、債券トレーディング収入が４％それぞれ増加した。

ただ、トレーディング収入は前期比では１３％減少した。前出のマルベリー氏は「債券やコモディティー（商品）の収入が減少し、今四半期のトレーディング収入は低調だった」と述べ、この傾向が今朝発表された他行の決算にも共通して影響していると指摘した。

シティの５部門の中で第３・四半期の成長率が最も高かったのはサービス部門で、収入は１５％増、利益は２７％増加した。ウェルスマネジメントも収入が１５％増加した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：中国が海外信託への課税強化、富裕層は対応に奔走 コラム：広がる米「大衆富裕層」、消費主導経済の底力に アングル：欧州高級ブランドが米市場に熱い視線、狙いは「ＡＩ長者」 アングル：インドへの高級ブランド進出、実店舗スペース不足が壁に コラム：2026年日米金利差の行方と日銀の新たな課題＝井上哲也氏 最終更新: 10/14(水) 0:41 ロイター

item.title: Goldman CEO watching for election-driven volatility around data centers
item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 13 : Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections.Speaking at an analysts' call for quarterly earnings, he also said as the financing needs for AI projects grow and there is pressure on rate
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Goldman CEO watching for election-driven volatility around data centers

David Solomon, CEO of Goldman Sachs, arrives for a state dinner held by US President Donald Trump and first lady Melania Trump for Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, in Washington, D.C., US, September 24, 2026. REUTERS/Aaron Schwartz

NEW YORK, Oct 13 : Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections. Speaking at an analysts' call for quarterly earnings, he also said as the financing needs for AI projects grow and there is pressure on rates, it could affect the returns and the viability of certain projects. "Localized political volatility around data centers. You know, we've got an election coming up. It'll be interesting to see," Solomon said. "Obviously there's a lot of political discussion coming into an election, but then you also have to see how states and localities act coming out of elections. All these things can create you know volatility, and there's uncertainty around them."

Data centers, which provide the computing power needed to train and run AI models, have faced growing opposition from communities across the United States. Residents have raised concerns about their rising electricity demand, the potential for higher utility bills and other environmental impacts on local communities. The artificial intelligence buildout is on track to require a larger share of U.S. output than the rollout of electricity, railroads, interstate highways or the internet, with an increasingly complicated financial structure that poses potentially systemic risks, according to a new study. The expansion will consume around 3.6 per cent of gross domestic product annually through 2032, or more than $10 trillion, and is using ever more intricate financing arrangements, Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a finance and real estate professor at Columbia Business School, wrote in a paper prepared for a Brookings Institution conference last month. "There's going to be infrastructure built around it that's going to be quite significant," Goldman's Solomon. "But we feel very well positioned to bring the full range of services and participate actively, and we still see an enormous amount of activity." Goldman is a financial partner with Nvidia, which in August announced it has partnered with six major financial institutions to launch compute platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure.

Source: Reuters

item.title: サウジ、イエメン首都の石油施設を攻撃か フーシ派が報復を警告
item.description: ［リヤド １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［リヤド　１３日　ロイター］ - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１３日、サウジアラビアが首都サヌアを攻撃していると発表した。これに先立ち、サウジアラビア主導の連合軍は、サヌアにあるイエメン石油会社のサバハ中央給油所について、安全確保のため周辺住民に退避するよう呼びかけていた。双方の戦闘が急速に激化している。

フーシ派が運営するアルマシラ・テレビは、サウジ主導の連合軍がサヌア郊外にあるイエメン石油会社の石油貯蔵施設、サバハ中央給油所を攻撃したと報じた。

同社は、施設には現在、石油製品の在庫がなく、攻撃による石油備蓄や供給網への影響はないと説明した。

フーシ派のサリーア軍報道官は、サヌアに対するいかなる攻撃もサウジの首都リヤドに対する「厳しく痛烈な」報復を招くと警告。フーシ派はサウジ国営石油会社サウジアラムコの石油施設について、自らの攻撃対象として正当化されると主張し、従業員や民間人に対しアラムコの施設に近づかないよう呼びかけている。

一方、ムハンマド・ビン・サルマン皇太子が議長を務めるサウジ閣議は声明を出し、サウジに対する度重なる攻撃についてフーシ派は代償を払うことになると表明した。

item.title: Nasdaq cierra en baja ya que fabricantes de chips caen y en medio entrega resultados de bancos
item.description: El Nasdaq cerró a la baja el martes, ya que las acciones de fabricantes de chips profundizaron sus pérdidas recientes y los inversores analizaban los resultados trimestrales mixtos de Citigroup y otros grandes bancos estadounidenses.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: El Nasdaq cerró a la baja el martes, ya que las acciones de fabricantes de chips profundizaron sus pérdidas recientes y los inversores analizaban los resultados trimestrales mixtos de Citigroup y otros grandes bancos estadounidenses. * El índice de semiconductores PHLX (.SOX) cayó por quinta sesión consecutiva, después de que el lunes el presidente ejecutivo de Broadcom (AVGO.O) , Hock Tan, comparara parte del flujo de inversión hacia el sector con "apuestas de casino". Además, los informes sobre avances tecnológicos de la empresa china de chips de memoria CXMT acentuaron la preocupación por la creciente competencia. * Micron Technology (MU.O) y Applied Materials (AMAT.O) sufrieron fuertes caídas, mientras que Broadcom avanzó. * Citigroup (C.N) bajó y Goldman Sachs (GS.N) ganó después de que ambos bancos superaran las estimaciones de beneficios. * Wells Fargo (WFC.N) cayó tras no alcanzar las previsiones de margen de interés neto, mientras que JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) osciló entre ganancias y pérdidas después de no cumplir con las expectativas de beneficios, algo poco habitual en la entidad. * Apple (AAPL.O) alcanzó un máximo histórico intradía. * Las expectativas de una sólida temporada de resultados han contrarrestado la preocupación por un posible conflicto bélico entre Estados Unidos e Irán, el aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos y la inflación derivada de los elevados precios del petróleo. * Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 1,41 puntos, o un 0,02%, a 7.805,83 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cedió 42,37 puntos, o un 0,15%, a 27.203,53 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 173,10 puntos, o un 0,33%, a 51.677,45 unidades. * El S&P 500 ha subido alrededor de un 14% en 2026, impulsado por las acciones tecnológicas relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial. Sin embargo, la mediana de las acciones del índice ha subido menos de un 5% y más de 200 componentes del S&P 500 registran pérdidas en lo que va de año.

item.title: Albanian students protest over education, jobs, clash with police
item.description: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent. Police officers detained several protesters. Student organisers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, financial support and employment prospects after graduation. Some protesters added they wanted to express their frustration with inequality and the government. "What Albania needs is a revolution, a change, a complete overthrow of the system because it can't go on like this," protester Luljeta Kola said, adding there was deep social injustice and a gulf between rich and poor in the country. The demonstration comes amid a broader wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students have staged weeks of [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education. Albania's Deputy Prime Minister Albana Koçiu wrote on Facebook: "Violence has not been, is not, and will never be a solution. Throwing stones, attacking institutions and the state police, as well as the senseless destruction of public property, are not how youth should express themselves."

item.title: ロシア、北海道新聞記者を「スパイ容疑」で拘束 極東サハリンで
item.description:
[モスクワ １３日 ロイター] - ロシア連邦保安局（ＦＳＢ）は１３日、北海道新聞の日本人記者をスパイ容疑で拘束したと発表した。ロシア外務省は、日本政府が記者をスパイ活動に利用しているのは遺憾だとした。
ＦＳＢがウェブサイトに掲載した声明によると、記者はロシア出国を予定していた日の前日に極東サハリン州で拘束された。具体的な拘束日は明らかにしていない。
ロシア外務省のザハロワ報道官は声明で、拘束した記者の氏名を「Imai
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　１３日　ロイター] - ロシア連邦保安局（ＦＳＢ）は１３日、北海道新聞の日本人記者をスパイ容疑で拘束したと発表した。ロシア外務省は、日本政府が記者をスパイ活動に利用しているのは遺憾だとした。

ＦＳＢがウェブサイトに掲載した声明によると、記者はロシア出国を予定していた日の前日に極東サハリン州で拘束された。具体的な拘束日は明らかにしていない。

ロシア外務省のザハロワ報道官は声明で、拘束した記者の氏名を「Imai Yuki」とした上で、今回の拘束が日ロ関係に新たな影を落とすと述べた。

日本人記者の拘束について、在モスクワ日本大使館からコメントは得られていない。

ロシア国営テレビは、床に横たわった男性が黒い制服を着た覆面姿の３人に手錠をかけられている映像を放映。映像では、この男性がスパイ活動の疑いをかけられていると説明されている。このほか、この男性がＦＳＢ職員２人に付き添われて航空機に搭乗する様子や、モスクワの裁判所で被告人用の囲いの中にいる様子も放映した。裁判所は約２カ月間の勾留を命じた。

ＦＳＢは、記者の「違法行為を阻止した」と表明。「記者がロシアの防衛能力に関する情報を収集・保管し、ロシア連邦の安全保障に反する形で利用するため国家の情報活動目的で引き渡そうとしていたことが判明した」とした。

ザハロワ氏は「日本が外国人記者の立場にあるロシア駐在特派員を利用し、わが国の安全保障を損ねる目的で情報収集しようとしたのは遺憾だ」と表明。また、ロシアによるウクライナでの軍事作戦の間、日本は反ロシアの立場を取り、日本の再軍備を巡るロシア側の懸念に耳を傾けようとしていないと主張した。

その上で「今回の出来事が、日ロ関係の雰囲気を曇らせる新たな要因になると言わざるを得ない」と述べた。

ロシアはウクライナ侵攻を巡り西側諸国による対ロシア制裁に日本が加わったことを理由に、日本を「非友好国」と位置付けている。

item.title: Rendimientos bonos del Tesoro EEUU a 10 años caen en línea con Europa, retornos a dos años suben
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a más largo plazo registraron un ligero descenso el martes, siguiendo la tendencia de sus homólogos europeos, mientras que los rendimientos a dos años subieron en vísperas de la publicación de datos clave sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a más largo plazo registraron un ligero descenso el martes, siguiendo la tendencia de sus homólogos europeos, mientras que los rendimientos a dos años subieron en vísperas de la publicación de datos clave sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos. Los rendimientos de referencia a 10 años tocaron el martes sus niveles más bajos desde el 2 de octubre, antes de recortar sus pérdidas. La semana pasada, el índice de referencia alcanzó su máximo en 24 años, ante la preocupación de los inversionistas por la perspectiva de un aumento de la inflación. Los rendimientos de la zona del euro, especialmente los de los bonos a más largo plazo, cayeron, ya que la ola de ventas de acciones tecnológicas en Asia llevó a algunos inversionistas a refugiarse en la deuda pública. "Una de las razones por las que el mercado estadounidense se mantenía más o menos estable era lo que está ocurriendo en Europa. Y parece que, en general, simplemente estamos siguiendo las tasas europeas", afirmó Tom di Galoma, director general de Mischler Financial. El presidente de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York, John Williams, afirmó que sigue considerando adecuada una subida más de las tasas de interés este año, informó Bloomberg News el martes, añadiendo que, por el momento, no cree que sean necesarias otras alzas en 2027. El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro estadounidense a 10 años cerró con caída de 2,1 puntos básicos, hasta el 5,223%, tras haber caído anteriormente hasta el 5,1727%, su nivel más bajo desde principios de octubre. El retorno del bono a 30 años cayó 3,3 puntos básicos, hasta el 5,566%, tras tocar el 5,5355%. El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro a dos años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Fed, subió 0,9 puntos básicos hasta el 4,8%, tras haber caído al 4,7574%. A dos semanas de su reunión del 27 y 28 de octubre, los operadores siguen esperando que la Fed mantenga las tasas sin cambios y reserve su próxima alza para diciembre. La probabilidad implícita de una subida en octubre se situaba en 21,6%, mientras que las apuestas por un aumento de 25 puntos básicos en diciembre en 70,8%, según FedWatch. El miércoles se publicará el reporte del índice de precios al consumo de septiembre, un barómetro de la inflación muy seguido. Los precios al consumo siguen elevados, en parte debido a la guerra en Oriente Medio que dura ya varios meses y ha impulsado el precio del petróleo.

item.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying
item.description: Russia's FSB security agency said on Tuesday it had detained a Japanese journalist for alleged espionage, and Moscow's Foreign Ministry said it regretted that Tokyo was using correspondents to carry out spying.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's FSB security agency said on Tuesday it had detained a Japanese journalist for alleged espionage, and Moscow's Foreign Ministry said it regretted that Tokyo was using correspondents to carry out spying. In a statement on its website, the FSB said the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper journalist was detained in the far eastern Sakhalin region on the day before he planned to leave Russia. It did not specify when this was. Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova in a statement identified the journalist as Imai Yuki, according to the Russian transliteration of his name, and said his detention cast a new pall on relations with Tokyo. Japan's embassy in Moscow did not answer phone calls outside of business hours. In a Russian state TV video report on the case, three masked men in black uniforms handcuffed a man lying on the ground as a voice off camera said he was suspected of spying. The video showed the man being accompanied by two FSB servicemen onto a plane, then in a cage in a Moscow court, which ordered him detained for nearly two months. The agency "thwarted the illegal activity" of the journalist, the FSB said. "As a result of intelligence operations, it was established that he gathered and stored information related to the country's defence capabilities in order to pass it on for national intelligence purposes to be used against the security of the Russian Federation," the statement said. The foreign ministry spokeswoman said, "Tokyo's attempts to use its correspondents in Russia with the status of foreign journalists to gather information for undermining our state's security are regrettable." Japan, she said, had adopted an anti-Russian position during Russia's military campaign in Ukraine and refused to consider Moscow's concerns about Tokyo's "remilitarisation". "We have to note that what has occurred will become an additional factor clouding the atmosphere of Russian-Japanese relations," Zakharova said. Russia regards Japan as an [USN:L8N3ZG0NU TEXT:""unfriendly" country"] because it has joined Western sanctions against Moscow over the war in Ukraine. Russia and Japan, which never signed a formal World War Two peace treaty, have a territorial dispute over the Kuril Islands, known in Japan as the Northern Territories. Russian President Vladimir Putin [USN:L8N44F0CG TEXT:"visited"] one of the disputed islands in August, causing an uproar in Japan. Tokyo has said it would continue implementing sanctions against Russia and supporting Ukraine. One of the most prominent cases of a foreign journalist arrested in Russia was the detention of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich in 2023. He was found guilty of espionage by a Russian court, sentenced to 16 years and then freed in an East-West prisoner swap in August 2024.

item.title: Monedas cierran dispar en medio de baja del dólar y en espera de datos cruciales de EEUU
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina cerraron dispares el martes, en medio de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales, mientras la atención de los mercados comienza a centrarse en datos de la economía de Estados Unidos, cruciales para evaluar los futuros movimientos de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina cerraron dispares el martes, en medio de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales, mientras la atención de los mercados comienza a centrarse en datos de la economía de Estados Unidos, cruciales para evaluar los futuros movimientos de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * Para el miércoles se espera que se divulgue el IPC de Estados Unidos de septiembre, previo al dato del índice de precios al productor y las ventas minoristas un día después, para concluir la semana con la intervención del presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, en el FMI el viernes. * [USN:L6N45Z0PF TEXT:"El gobernador"] de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller dijo el martes que el reciente aumento del rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense refleja un mayor crecimiento económico más que unas mayores expectativas de inflación, que siguen "bien ancladas". * Los operadores ven ahora solo un 17% de probabilidades de que la Fed suba las tasas este mes, mientras que la posibilidad de un alza en diciembre asciende al 87%, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde ante una canasta de seis importantes monedas, retrocedió un 0,37%, en consonancia con el descenso de los precios del petróleo y luego de que, en la víspera, la divisa estadounidense alcanzara un máximo de 18 meses. * El dólar amplió aún más sus pérdidas después de que el presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, afirmara que sigue esperando una subida más de las tasas este año, pero que no ve necesidad de nuevas subidas en 2027. * En tanto, el Fondo Monetario Internacional recortó en la víspera sus previsiones de crecimiento para América Latina y el Caribe para 2026 y 2027, y dijo que la mayor parte de la región está recibiendo poco impulso del auge de la inteligencia artificial que ha ayudado a otras economías a absorber el choque energético de la guerra en Oriente Medio. * El peso mexicano cotizaba en 18,3771 por dólar, con una caída del 0,70%, reanudando una racha de pérdidas que había interrumpido en la víspera, mientras los inversionistas evaluaban señales sobre el futuro del diferencial de tasas entre México y Estados Unidos, con la mira puesta en la trayectoria monetaria de la Reserva Federal. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subió un 0,33%, a 66.965 unidades, impulsado principalmente por firmas del sector financiero. * El real brasileño se depreció un 0,74%, a 5,0227 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo retrocedió un 1,08%, a 206.804,23 puntos. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista avanzó un 0,2% a 1.514 por dólar , el nivel más alto en casi un mes, en momentos en que el banco central (BCRA) busca sumar divisas a diario para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. * Con la idea de cubrir vencimientos de deuda interna a corto plazo, el Tesoro argentino realizará el miércoles su primera licitación mensual, una movida habitual debido a que tiene cerrada la posibilidad de financiamiento externo por los altos costos a pagar. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires escaló un 1,45%. * El peso chileno , sumó un ligero 0,04%, a 981,50/981,80 por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , cayó un 0,21%, a 11.020,01 unidades. * El peso colombiano ganó un 0,20% a 3.182,50 unidades por dólar y en la bolsa el índice accionario COLCAP (.COLCAP) subió 1,55% a 2.570,29 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , finalizó con una apreciación de 0,12% a 3,4340/3,4370 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) retrocedió un 0,49% a 1.587 puntos.

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナのエネルギー施設攻撃せず トランプ氏「停戦」発表後初
item.description:
Olena Harmash Daniel Flynn
[キーウ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olena Harmash　Daniel Flynn

[キーウ　１３日　ロイター] - ロシアは１３日、トランプ米大統領が週末の間に「エネルギー停戦」を発表して以来初めて、ウクライナのエネルギー関連施設への攻撃を実施しなかった。ただ、ウクライナ各地の輸送・物流インフラを標的にした攻撃は続けた。

トランプ米大統領は１１日、ロシアとウクライナが双方のエネルギー関連施設への攻撃停止で「合意した」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿。即時発効するとしたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。ロシア大統領報道官はこの件について協議は続けられていると述べるにとどめ、詳細な説明は避けているが、 ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１３日、トランプ米大統領が「エネルギー停戦」を発表したことを受け、ロシアの製油所などのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を２日間停止したと明らかにしていた。

ロシア国防省は１３日に公表した夜間攻撃に関する日次報告でウクライナのエネルギー施設に対する攻撃について言及していない。ただ、今回の攻撃でロシアがエネルギーインフラを意図的に攻撃対象から外したかどうかは現時点では明らかになっていない。

＜輸送・物流インフラへの攻撃続く＞

ウクライナ空軍は１３日、夜間のロシア軍による攻撃で国内１７カ所で被害が確認されたと明らかにした。防空部隊がロシア軍のドローン（無人機）１０８機のうち８８機を撃墜したとしている。

西部リビウで市内の大部分に熱供給を行う施設から１キロ余り離れた場所にミサイル１発が着弾したほか、南部ミコライウ州では貨物ターミナルが被害を受け、南東部ドニプロペトロフスク州では輸送インフラが損傷した。ウクライナ第２の都市ハリコフでは集合住宅への攻撃により４人が死亡し、少なくとも１１人が負傷した。西部フメリニツキー州では病院が被害を受けた。

ウクライナ空軍は、ロシアが１２日夜に首都キーウに向けて弾道ミサイル６発を発射した際、事前の監視・警戒情報がなかったと表明。空軍は声明で「原因を調査している」としている。

ロイターなどは、米当局者がウクライナに対しロシアの製油所への攻撃を停止しなければ、情報共有や武器売却を打ち切る可能性があると警告したと報道。ただ、ウクライナのシビハ外相はこの日、ウクライナは米国から引き続き情報提供を受けていると表明。ワルシャワ安全保障フォーラムで「ウクライナと米国は協力を継続している」と述べた。

item.title: 米中古住宅販売、9月は予想外の1.5％増 住宅ローン金利上昇で先行き懸念も
item.description: [ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１３日発表した９月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整済...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅販売、9月は予想外の1.5％増　住宅ローン金利上昇で先行き懸念も 10/13 23:43 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの住宅に掲げられた「売家」の看板。１月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ワシントン　１３日　ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１３日発表した９月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１．５％増の３９９万戸だった。在庫の増加により買い手の選択肢が広がったことから予想（３９５万戸）に反して増加した。ただ、住宅ローン金利の上昇を背景に伸びは依然として鈍い。

９月は前年同月比では２．２％減少した。

地域別では、南部と西部で増加した一方、北東部では減少し、中西部では横ばいだった。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「季節調整済みベースでは前月比で小幅な増加が見られたものの、８月と９月は今年に入って住宅販売が最も低調な２カ月となった」と指摘。「ここ数週間の住宅ローン金利の一段の上昇により、住宅購入の資格を満たせる買い手は減少している」と述べた。

中古住宅の在庫は１．９％増の１６０万戸と、２０１９年１１月以来の高水準となった。前年同月比では４．６％増加した。

９月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は４．８カ月と、前月から横ばいだったが、前年同月（４．５カ月）の水準を上回った。

中古住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比１．３％上昇の４１万７５００ドルと、同月としては過去最高となった。初めて住宅を購入する人の割合は全体の３１％と、前月および前年同月の３０％から上昇した。

住宅が市場に出ていた期間の中央値は３３日。前月の３１日からは延びたものの、前年同月からは横ばいとなった。

差し押さえ物件を含む不良債権売却は取引全体の２％と、変わらずだった。

現金のみによる販売の割合は２７％と前月から横ばい。前年同月は３０％だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 最終更新: 10/13(火) 23:43 ロイター

item.title: Goolsbee says AI-induced inflation is 'jumping out of its lane,' Semafor reports
item.description: Oct 13 : Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Tuesday that inflation is starting to feel like "aggregate overheating" fueled by spillovers from the artificial intelligence investment boom rather than largely being a byproduct of supply shocks that will pass on its own."This is sta

item.content:encoded:

Goolsbee says AI-induced inflation is 'jumping out of its lane,' Semafor reports

FILE PHOTO: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee is interviewed on the sidelines of the Kansas City Fed's annual economic symposium, in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, U.S. August 27, 2026. REUTERS/Ann Saphir/File Photo

FAST

Oct 13 : Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Tuesday that inflation is starting to feel like "aggregate overheating" fueled by spillovers from the artificial intelligence investment boom rather than largely being a byproduct of supply shocks that will pass on its own. "This is starting to feel like aggregate overheating, that the AI data center cost increases are jumping out of its lane, that prices are going up in spaces that are not just components in data centers and the directly adjacent industries to data centers," Goolsbee said in a Semafor interview. "If you start to see more of this spreading into general services, that investment goods are just getting GDP (gross domestic product) growth up faster than potential and generating this kind of spillover inflation, that’s problematic because unlike supply shocks where we tend to assume they’re going to go away on their own in a relatively short period of time, nobody thinks that of overheating demand." "It takes a long time for overheated demand to get going, and once it’s going, it’s hard to get rid of that," Goolsbee said. "So that’s why the conventional wisdom among economists has been if you see overheating demand, you act decisively and you act quickly to prevent that from rolling into inflation expectations, rolling into people taking for granted that it’s never going to go away." Asked whether the Fed should continue raising interest rates, Goolsbee, who does not have a vote on rate policy this year, said: "So if inflation remains persistent, then I think it’s clear what the Fed has to do. If we can get some evidence that this tariff inflation is going away, that the oil shock inflation is going away, it’s not too much progress that we need to show, but we need to start showing some progress if we’re going to get back on the kind of rate cutting path that we were on." The Fed cut rates three times in 2025 but last month raised rates for the first time in three years in the face of stubborn inflation, bumping its short-term policy rate up by a quarter percentage point to a range of 3.75 per cent-4.00 per cent. Rate futures markets expect it will forego another increase at the coming October 27-28 meeting but will lift rates by another quarter point in December.

Source: Reuters

Saeed Azhar Pritam Biswas
[１３日 ロイター] - 米銀大手が１３日発表した第３・四半期（７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米銀決算まちまち、ディールメーキング失速　株式部門は好調 10/13 23:18 配信

米ゴールドマン・サックスのロゴ。2025年12月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Saeed Azhar　Pritam Biswas

[１３日　ロイター] - 米銀大手が１３日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）決算は、イラン戦争やインフレ加速、人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラへの巨額投資を巡る懸念を背景に株式・債券市場が動揺する中、強弱まちまちの内容となった。

ＪＰモルガン・チェース、シティグループ、ゴールドマン・サックス、ウェルズ・ファーゴの決算は、上半期の記録的な収益を支えたディールメーキングやトレーディングの活況に陰りが出ている可能性を示した。特に９月下旬にかけ、債券市場の下落（金利上昇）と株式市場のボラティリティーが重しになったと幹部らは指摘した。

それでも、第３・四半期のディールメーキングは全体として堅調で、今後予定される案件も豊富だという。消費者や融資先企業、経済全体も引き続き健全な状態にあると各行幹部は説明した。

ゴールドマンのデービッド・ソロモン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はアナリスト向け説明会で「いくつかの逆風にもかかわらず、経済は引き続き非常に底堅い」と述べた。「テクノロジー分野では並外れたスーパーサイクルを迎えている。規制環境も戦略的な活動を後押ししている。かなり良好な環境だ」と語った。

長引く債券売りによって世界各地の利回りが数十年ぶりの高水準に上昇し、株式のバリュエーションにも一段の圧力がかかる中、ディールメーキングが失速している。新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）市場もここ数週間、勢いを失い、好調な１年となるはずだった同業務に影を落としている。

特にＪＰモルガンは、市場の変動と経済見通しの不透明感がここ数カ月のディールメーキングを鈍らせ、債券トレーディングも減少させたと指摘した。ただ、ジェレミー・バーナム最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団に対し、今後予定される案件は引き続き「非常に堅調」だと述べた。

同氏は、市場が混乱している局面では売り手と買い手の価格認識の差が一時的に拡大することがあるものの、大半の案件は中止ではなく延期されていると説明した。アナリストも、ＩＰＯ市場では案件が選別されているものの、市場自体が閉ざされたわけではなく、第４・四半期に状況が安定すれば、延期された上場が実現する可能性があると指摘している。

ゴールドマンのソロモン氏も同様の見方を示し、「待つという選択をする企業もあるだろうが、ＩＰＯ市場は依然としてかなり良好な状態にある」と述べた。

シティのゴンサロ・ルケッティＣＦＯは、第３・四半期の投資銀行業務が軟調だったと説明した。ウェルズ・ファーゴのマイク・サントマッシモＣＦＯも９月の減速に言及し、１０年債利回りの急上昇が影響したとの見方を示した。

ザックス・インベストメント・マネジメントのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、ブライアン・マルベリー氏は「高金利と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げが続く可能性が、トレーディングと投資銀行業務に明らかなマイナス要因として重くのしかかっていることは間違いない」と述べた。

ＪＰモルガンとウェルズ・ファーゴの幹部によると、物価や借り入れコストが上昇しているにもかかわらず、消費者や融資先企業は底堅さを維持しており、信用の質はほとんど悪化していない。

サントマッシモ氏は「ストレスが生じていることを示すような兆候は全く見られない」と述べた。

＜株式部門は好調維持＞

株式トレーディングは好調だった。金利の先行き不透明感とエネルギー価格の急騰を背景に、顧客がポートフォリオを組み替えた。ＪＰモルガンのマーケット部門収入は前年同期比１５％増加し、株式市場関連収入は４９％急増した。

ゴールドマンの第３・四半期利益は市場予想を上回った。債券・通貨・商品（ＦＩＣＣ）部門の収入が１％減少したものの、中東紛争に絡む市場のボラティリティーで株式部門の収入が押し上げられた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：ドル高支える年金基金のヘッジ巻き戻し、市場環境変化で懸念後退 アングル：今年はバリュー投資が活発化か、ＡＩバブル懸念で着目点変化 アングル：米株のテック依存、「ＩＴバブル期」上回る　市場を不安定に アングル：米国株、人気は株主還元よりＡＩ技術革新投資の企業 最終更新: 10/14(水) 8:43 ロイター

item.title: UK police arrest three suspected of involvement in insider dealing ring
item.description: Three people have been arrested in Britain on suspicion of being involved in a criminal insider dealing and money laundering plot, the Financial Conduct Authority said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Three people have been arrested in Britain on suspicion of being involved in a criminal insider dealing and money laundering plot, the Financial Conduct Authority said on Tuesday. More than 100 staff and officers searched five residential premises in London and the northern English city of Manchester in a joint operation with the National Crime Agency, seizing more than 30 mobile phones, laptops and tablets, the FCA said. "Insider dealing is a serious threat to the integrity of our markets," the FCA's joint enforcement head, Steve Smart, said in a statement. "Working with partners, we will continue to use all the powers at our disposal to crack down on serious and organised crime groups engaged in market abuse." The FCA, which said it could not comment further at this stage, secured four insider dealing convictions last financial year, with two resulting in record, [USN:L1N3T10JD TEXT:"combined prison sentences"] of 11 years. The regulator has stepped up enforcement action on suspected insider dealing, with recent cases involving an [USN:FWN3YG1OG TEXT:"oil rig consultant"], [USN:L1N3LF0N0 TEXT:"traders"] and a financial adviser .

FAST

Oct 13 : Hyundai Motor Group said on Tuesday it would invest $15.5 billion in India through 2032, deepening its bet on the world's third-largest car market as a key driver of future growth.  The South Korean automaker's seven-year plan includes about $700 million of investment in its Indian research and development centre, expansion of production capacity and a dedicated investment entity. India, the world's third-largest car market, is attracting billions of dollars in investment from global automakers seeking to tap rising demand and expand local manufacturing capacity, underscoring its position as a major automotive production hub.  Hyundai said last year it would invest $5 billion to expand its manufacturing and research operations in India.

Japan's Suzuki Motor , the majority owner of India's largest carmaker by volume, Maruti Suzuki, also laid out plans in 2025 to invest about $8 billion in the country. Carmakers such as Toyota and Honda have committed to expanding their manufacturing ambitions in India as well.  Hyundai Motor, which employs more than 24,000 people in India, said the investment would create additional jobs across manufacturing, research, engineering and supply chains, but did not disclose a number.  The firm said the investment plan, covering 2026 to 2032, would expand manufacturing capacity at Hyundai Motor India and Kia India to support significant volume growth. The investment also includes a vehicle testing track, as part of efforts to develop next-generation automotive technologies. The investment announcement followed a meeting between Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Euisun Chung and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on Tuesday. The group currently has an annual production capacity of more than 1.4 million vehicles in India, comprising 824,000 units at Hyundai's Chennai facilities, 170,000 units at its Pune plant and 431,000 units at Kia's Anantapur facility.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Rams' Alaric Jackson gets 2-game ban for punching Bills' Bradley Chubb
item.description: Rams offensive lineman Alaric Jackson was suspended two games by the NFL for punching Buffalo Bills linebacker Bradley Chubb after Los Angeles lost Monday night in overtime.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rams offensive lineman Alaric Jackson was suspended two games by the NFL for punching Buffalo Bills linebacker Bradley Chubb after Los Angeles lost Monday night in overtime. Chubb was spotted talking to players on both teams near midfield after the Bills' 37-34 overtime victory over the Rams when he appeared to say something to Jackson. The 6-foot-7, 338-pound Jackson walked toward Chubb -- 6-4 and 268 pounds -- and punched him in the jaw. "It's just emotions, you know what I mean? Emotional game, it was a close game," said Chubb, who was pulled away from the confrontation. "They always catch the second guy, so I let him swing, and then my teammates held me back, and I just chilled." Jackson, 28, was pulled away by Rams tight end Colby Parkinson after the punch. He will lose paychecks while missing the Rams' next two games -- against the Arizona Cardinals this week and at the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7. He is eligible to rejoin the Rams following the Raiders game Oct. 25. Chubb, 30, said he was fine after the incident. "I'm just ready for next week," he said. "You see me, I'm smiling, I'm with my team. I'll be ready for next week." Chubb and the Bills (4-1) will visit the Raiders on Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saudi Aramco administrative building attacked, limited fire reported
item.description: An administrative building belonging to Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco in the eastern city of Dhahran was attacked, causing a limited fire, the Energy Ministry said in a statement on Wednesday as fighting between Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis and the kingdom intensified.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Menna Alaaeldin
item.content:encoded: An administrative building belonging to Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco (2223.SE) in the eastern city of Dhahran was attacked, causing a limited fire, the Energy Ministry said in a statement on Wednesday as fighting between Yemen's [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"Iran-allied Houthis"] and the kingdom intensified. Authorities responded to the incident late on Tuesday and took necessary measures, the ministry said, adding that there were no injuries or deaths. A company source told Reuters earlier that a ballistic missile hit the Aramco headquarters complex in Dhahran. The source said an office tower in the complex was struck and that its top three floors were damaged. The source and two other people with knowledge of the matter said the building was on fire. The complex hosts a major operations centre for Aramco, which oversees a vast network of onshore and offshore oil rigs, pipelines, refineries and export terminals. The Houthis have for a week been firing ballistic missiles and drones at key Saudi sites in retaliation for the kingdom's backing of government forces in Yemen's reignited civil war. Riyadh’s international airport has received four strikes, including one on Saturday that killed 13 people. Saturday's ballistic missile strike on Riyadh airport was the deadliest in Saudi Arabia in a decade, with further attacks grounding flights across the country. Earlier, six sources told Reuters they heard loud booms near the Aramco complex. The Saudi-led coalition said fragments of a missile that it had intercepted and destroyed in Dhahran had fallen on a residential area, without providing further details. Authorities also reported that drones and missiles were intercepted and destroyed in the capital, Riyadh, and the country's southern region. Four people were injured in Riyadh after fragments from two Houthi missiles fell following their interception and destruction, Saudi Civil Defense said on Wednesday. The debris caused limited damage to 15 homes in the capital, the Civil Defense spokesperson said, adding that the injured were two women, a man and a child. The Houthis had threatened a "harsh and painful" response to Saudi-led strikes on the Yemeni capital Sanaa, with spokesperson Yahya Saree saying targets could include the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran and an oil refinery in Riyadh. The group has warned oil workers in Saudi Arabia to stay away from sites that could be targets. The Houthis earlier on Tuesday said Saudi Arabia was attacking Sanaa, and the Saudi-led coalition warned civilians to stay away from an oil depot on the city's outskirts. Houthi-run Al-Masirah television reported that the Saudi-led coalition had targeted the Yemen Petroleum Company's Sabah central station, a fuel depot on the outskirts of Sanaa. The coalition said in a statement on Tuesday evening that it attacked the station and other sites in an operation aimed at "neutralizing the capabilities of Houthis" to threaten Saudi Arabia, Yemen and international waterways. The Saudi cabinet, chaired by de facto ruler Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, issued a statement on Tuesday before the strike on Saudi Aramco saying the Houthis would face consequences for their repeated attacks on the kingdom. REIGNITED YEMEN WAR Saudi Arabia resumed its military campaign in Yemen in support of the internationally recognised government in a bid to reverse the Houthis' sudden gains last month, when they swept down the Red Sea coast to the critical Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The strait, the southern gateway to the Red Sea, has become a more vital route for Saudi and other global energy supplies since the start of the Iran war in February, when Tehran closed the Strait of Hormuz leading from the Gulf to the Indian Ocean. While a government offensive that began a week ago pushed the Houthis from the area closest to the strait, the group remains embedded nearby and has made gains around the city of Taiz this month. Saudi Arabia has been seeking wider support from allies for its campaign against the Houthis and to help it ward off their missile and drone attacks. Washington, Saudi Arabia's strongest ally and longtime security guarantor, has so far rebuffed Saudi efforts to bring it directly into the war against the Houthis. The Yemen conflict has resumed as a spillover from the wider US-Iran war that began with the US-Israeli attack on the Islamic Republic on February 28. Iran, Saudi Arabia's longtime regional rival, has offered to mediate between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, its foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday in statements reiterated by the ministry on Monday.

item.title: Le pape Léon XIV a subi l'ablation d'un lobe pulmonaire, un cancer détecté-Vatican
item.description: Le pape Léon XIV a subi mardi une intervention chirurgicale lors de laquelle le lobe inférieur de son poumon droit a été retiré, alors qu'un adénocarcinome - une forme courant de cancer pulmonaire - a été détecté, a fait savoir le Vatican dans un bulletin médical.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le pape Léon XIV a subi mardi une intervention chirurgicale lors de laquelle le lobe inférieur de son poumon droit a été retiré, alors qu'un adénocarcinome - une forme courant de cancer pulmonaire - a été détecté, a fait savoir le Vatican dans un bulletin médical. Des analyses moléculaires réalisées durant l'opération ont confirmé ce que les médecins suspectaient au regard des résultats des examens préparatoires à cette intervention, a ajouté le Vatican. Un peu plus tôt dans la soirée, le Vatican a déclaré que l'opération s'était bien passée. Le souverain pontife, âgé de 71 ans, a annoncé dimanche qu'un nodule pulmonaire, détecté à un stade précoce, avait été localisé lors d'un récent bilan de santé et qu'il était "bien circonscrit". Léon devrait rester en convalescence environ une semaine. Tous ses engagements publics ont été annulés jusqu'au 20 octobre.

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 13 : Dutch supermarket company Ahold Delhaize has no indication that client data has been stolen in the cybersecurity incident that forced it to shut down several systems in recent days, it said in a statement on Tuesday. The Dutch retailer, which operates the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain Albert Heijn and has major operations in other European countries as well as the United States, said on Monday that it was dealing with a "security issue" on its network and had taken several systems offline as a precaution. The incident coincided with a cyberattack in France which saw refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of stores heating up to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, sparking fires and spoiling food. The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre has said that there is no reason to believe that there is a link between the incident in the Netherlands and similar incidents in other countries.

Source: Reuters

item.title: AI may be rocket fuel for US stocks, less so for GDP: McGeever
item.description: Wall Street is not the economy, so we are told. Nowhere is this clearer than the AI revolution, which is firing US stocks to record highs while, simultaneously, weighing on real gross domestic product (GDP) growth.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded: Wall Street is not the economy, so we are told. Nowhere is this clearer than the AI revolution, which is firing US stocks to record highs while, simultaneously, weighing on real gross domestic product (GDP) growth. Demand for all the equipment that goes into building US AI data centers and infrastructure is surging, but much of it is directed toward imports. This is widening the trade deficit, which, in turn, is a drag on growth, not enough to slow the economy to a halt, but enough to ensure it doesn't accelerate too fast. Politically, it's a double-edged sword. On the one hand, the Trump administration can claim it is presiding over the biggest investment boom in US history, which is powering the stock market to all-time highs. The market's resilience is all the more remarkable, given years of above-target inflation and now rising interest rates and the highest bond yields in 25 years. Yet headline economic growth is pretty soft. It's certainly not as strong as one might expect given record levels of capital expenditure (capex), corporate earnings, and stock prices, with a labor market essentially at full employment. There's little indication of this negative feedback loop breaking in the coming quarters. If anything, it is liable to tighten. TRADE DEFICIT HEADED FOR 4% OF GDP? According to UN Trade and Development, around three-quarters of the rise in US goods imports last year was in "AI-related hardware" such as "servers and high-performance computing equipment". A Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis paper published in August estimated that around 70% of AI-related capital spending is on imported goods. Figures last week showed that the US trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion in August, the widest in 17 months, driven by record imports as purchases from abroad rose 4.3% to an all-time high of $420.8 billion. The trade deficit was 2.7% of GDP in the first quarter and 3% in the second, with business spending on equipment, mostly related to AI, playing a key role. The August data and strong orders that month for non-defense capital goods, excluding aircraft, suggest these dynamics have spilled over into the third quarter. Could the trade deficit be heading toward 4% of GDP? Dean Maki, economist at hedge fund Point72, reckons it is. “This is structural. We think these levels of trade deficits are going to continue, and probably expand over the next year.” Maki says that the rise in capital goods imports is almost all down to growing AI-related demand for computers, semiconductors, peripherals, and telecommunications equipment. The volume of these imports helps explain why annual GDP growth in the second quarter was only just above 2%, even as business equipment spending growth accelerated more than 16%, the fastest pace in five years. As long as the AI spending spree continues apace, the US trade deficit will stay wide, pointing to only "moderate" real underlying growth, Maki reckons. ASIA'S SOARING SURPLUSES Where are these imported AI-related goods coming from? Asia. Last week, Asia's AI darlings Samsung (005930.KS) and TSMC (2330.TW) showed the positive flip side of the flows. Samsung, the world's largest memory chipmaker, said it expected to announce third-quarter earnings of around [USN:P8N44T045 TEXT:"$80 billion,"] a record quarterly profit for any tech company, and TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, unveiled record third-quarter revenue of $46.7 billion. Brad Setser, global capital flows watcher and senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, notes that South Korea and Taiwan ran a combined annualized trade surplus of $800 billion in September, up from $100 billion two years ago. If this is sustained, the two countries are on course to post a combined current account surplus next year of $1 trillion. "Crazy," Setser posted on X last week. This is also a challenge for US President Donald Trump, whose global trade wars were aimed at reducing the trade deficit and punishing the rest of the world for "ripping off" the US for decades. Record imports and a widening deficit, coupled with record trade surpluses in key trading partners abroad, including China, show these policies aren't working as intended. They might in time, just as the AI productivity boom could spark into life at some point. But it's unlikely to be soon. For now, the AI boom is boosting Wall Street more than GDP. (The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary.
